documents.title: Error Catalog
documents.summary: Stable error identities, diagnosis and precise safe remediation.

documents.title: SMTO-API-0001 — A step was rejected because its details were in the wrong form
documents.summary: SMTO checks the details of every action before using them. A value was missing or in the wrong form, either something you entered or something the AI model filled in, so SMTO refused it.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0001 — A step was rejected because its details were in the wrong form

documents.title: SMTO-API-0002 — Command or gateway execution failed
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't finish an action in your task, such as running a command on a computer. Part of it may already have run, so check what happened before doing it again.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0002 — Command or gateway execution failed

documents.title: SMTO-API-0003 — Request blocked by safety policy
documents.summary: SMTO's safety rules stopped one or more actions in your task before they ran, because they could be harmful or aren't allowed here. Those blocked actions were not carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0003 — Request blocked by safety policy

documents.title: SMTO-API-0004 — Runtime validation failed
documents.summary: SMTO rejected a value it needed to continue, such as a setting, an option, or something in your request. This is a general message; the technical details usually name the value.

documents.title: SMTO-API-0005 — A request to SMTO was missing details or in the wrong form
documents.summary: SMTO or a Gateway received a request it couldn't read, so it turned it down. This can come from an out-of-date page, SMTO and a Gateway being on different versions, or a typed terminal command.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0005 — A request to SMTO was missing details or in the wrong form

documents.title: SMTO-API-0006 — SMTO needs you to sign in again
documents.summary: SMTO didn't accept this request because it couldn't confirm who you are. Your sign-in may have ended, or another tab may be signed in with a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0006 — SMTO needs you to sign in again

documents.title: SMTO-API-0007 — Your account isn't allowed to do this
documents.summary: SMTO knows who you are but turned down this request. The action may need an administrator account, this page's security check may have expired, or you may need to change your password first.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0007 — Your account isn't allowed to do this

documents.title: SMTO-API-0008 — SMTO couldn't find what you asked for
documents.summary: The item or page you tried to open isn't there. It may have been deleted or cleaned up automatically, the link may be old, or this page may be out of date.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0008 — SMTO couldn't find what you asked for

documents.title: SMTO-API-0009 — Your action doesn't fit the item's current state
documents.summary: The item you were working on has changed since this page last showed it. For example, it may already be running, finished, or edited in another tab, so SMTO turned the action down.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0009 — Your action doesn't fit the item's current state

documents.title: SMTO-API-0010 — What you sent is too large for SMTO to accept
documents.summary: SMTO turned down this request because it was bigger than allowed, such as a large attached file, a big export, or very long text in a setting.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0010 — What you sent is too large for SMTO to accept

documents.title: SMTO-API-0011 — API validation failed
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use a value sent from this page, such as a search filter, a name or an option. When it can, this panel lists which value to fix.

documents.title: SMTO-API-0012 — Too many attempts, so SMTO is pausing this for a moment
documents.summary: SMTO is briefly refusing more requests of this kind because too many arrived in a short time, for example several sign-in or password attempts in a row.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0012 — Too many attempts, so SMTO is pausing this for a moment

documents.title: SMTO-API-0013 — API internal failure
documents.summary: Something went wrong inside SMTO or a Gateway (the helper program that runs commands for SMTO). Your action may or may not have finished. This message does not tell us what caused the problem.

documents.title: SMTO-API-0014 — API service unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO, or a part it depends on, couldn't handle this request right now. It may be starting up, stopping, updating, or unreachable from where you are.

documents.title: SMTO-API-0015 — This text can't be sent as a task
documents.summary: Text that starts with / is an SMTO command, not a task, and an empty message has nothing to do. SMTO didn't start or queue anything from it.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0015 — This text can't be sent as a task

documents.title: SMTO-API-0016 — SMTO couldn't find the result of that request
documents.summary: A program connected to SMTO asked for the result of an earlier request, but SMTO has no saved result under that request ID. The ID may be wrong, or the result may have been deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0016 — SMTO couldn't find the result of that request

documents.title: SMTO-API-0017 — SMTO couldn't confirm a request from a connected program
documents.summary: A program connected to SMTO sent it work, but SMTO either wasn't ready to take it or didn't report which request it started. The work may or may not have started.

headings.title: SMTO-API-0017 — SMTO couldn't confirm a request from a connected program

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0001 — SMTO couldn't get ready to save this step's files
documents.summary: Before a step that can create files, SMTO gets ready to keep those files in the task's Artifacts. That preparation failed, so SMTO didn't run the step.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0001 — SMTO couldn't get ready to save this step's files

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0002 — SMTO couldn't add or list files in the task's Artifacts
documents.summary: During the task, SMTO tried to add a file to the task's Artifacts, or to list them, and that step failed. The file itself may still be where the task created it.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0002 — SMTO couldn't add or list files in the task's Artifacts

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0003 — A Gateway couldn't set up a temporary folder for a command
documents.summary: Before running a command, the Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) prepares private folders for the task. It couldn't set them up, so the command didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0003 — A Gateway couldn't set up a temporary folder for a command

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0004 — SMTO can't show a preview of this file
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't display this saved file inside the app. A failed preview does not establish that the file itself is damaged, and the Task's result hasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0004 — SMTO can't show a preview of this file

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0005 — SMTO can't reach the saved files for this Task
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't open the place where it keeps this Task's saved files. They may have been deleted, a scheduled cleanup may be checking them, or the server can't read its storage right now.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0005 — SMTO can't reach the saved files for this Task

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0006 — This file belongs to a different conversation
documents.summary: SMTO only opens a Task's saved files from the conversation where that Task ran. This file is tied to another conversation, or its files were deleted, so SMTO didn't open it.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0006 — This file belongs to a different conversation

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0007 — A file changed while SMTO was saving it
documents.summary: SMTO was saving a copy of a file from your Task, but the file changed, moved or disappeared during the copy. SMTO didn't keep the half-finished copy.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0007 — A file changed while SMTO was saving it

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0008 — These files are too large or too many for SMTO to save
documents.summary: SMTO limits how big and how many saved files a Task can keep or download at once. This file, Task or download went over one of those limits, so it wasn't saved or downloaded.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0008 — These files are too large or too many for SMTO to save

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0009 — SMTO can't add new files to this Task anymore
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save a new file from this Task, but the Task's files were deleted, are being checked by a cleanup, or its conversation was removed. The new file wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0009 — SMTO can't add new files to this Task anymore

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0010 — SMTO couldn't confirm a saved file is intact
documents.summary: The stored copy of this file, or a copy being moved between computers, didn't match what SMTO recorded when it saved it. SMTO stopped rather than hand you a file that might be wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0010 — SMTO couldn't confirm a saved file is intact
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0011 — SMTO won't save a file from this location
documents.summary: This file's location isn't safe for SMTO to collect. It's outside the Task's own folders, goes through a shortcut link, or isn't a normal file, so SMTO didn't copy it.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0011 — SMTO won't save a file from this location

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0012 — A file copy stopped before it finished
documents.summary: SMTO was copying a file between the computer that ran the Task and the SMTO server, but the copy ended early or stopped moving. The incomplete copy wasn't kept.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0012 — A file copy stopped before it finished
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0013 — This Gateway can't send saved files to SMTO
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) is a version that can't share files with SMTO. Files from this step weren't added to the Task.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0013 — This Gateway can't send saved files to SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0014 — SMTO got an unusable reply while saving files
documents.summary: While saving files from a Task, SMTO got a reply from the Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) that it couldn't use, or no proper reply at all. The files weren't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0014 — SMTO got an unusable reply while saving files

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0015 — This saved file has been deleted or set aside
documents.summary: SMTO no longer gives out this file. It was deleted, or SMTO set it aside because its stored copy was missing or damaged.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0015 — This saved file has been deleted or set aside

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0016 — Artifact unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find this saved file for this conversation. The link may be old, the file may not be collected yet, or SMTO couldn't reach it right now.

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0017 — SMTO didn't recognize that file retention choice
documents.summary: SMTO only accepts its listed choices for how long to keep a conversation's saved files. The choice sent wasn't one of them, so your retention setting stayed the same.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0017 — SMTO didn't recognize that file retention choice

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0018 — Saving a file was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: SMTO was saving a file from this Task when the save was cancelled, usually because the Task or one of its steps was stopped. Some files may have been saved before that.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0018 — Saving a file was stopped before it finished
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0019 — A file can't be saved while it's still being written
documents.summary: SMTO saves a Task's files only after every command that might write them has finished. A command is still running, or the file has a temporary-looking name, so it wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0019 — A file can't be saved while it's still being written
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0020 — These files are still used by another conversation
documents.summary: SMTO didn't delete these Task files because another conversation still uses them, for example one started with Continue in new conversation. The files are still there.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0020 — These files are still used by another conversation

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0021 — Files can only be saved during a Task
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save or list files from a step that isn't connected to a Task, so there was nowhere to keep them. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0021 — Files can only be saved during a Task

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0022 — The Gateway can't give this Task its own temporary folder
documents.summary: On Linux, the Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) gives each Task a private /tmp folder. That computer can't set this up, so a file action using it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0022 — The Gateway can't give this Task its own temporary folder

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0023 — SMTO couldn't verify this Task's temporary folders
documents.summary: Before running a command, the Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) checks that the Task's private folders belong to this Task. That check failed, so the command didn't start.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0023 — SMTO couldn't verify this Task's temporary folders

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0024 — SMTO blocked a file request that came from another site
documents.summary: SMTO refused to open or change a Task's files because the request came from another website, app, or a different address for SMTO. No files were opened, changed, or deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0024 — SMTO blocked a file request that came from another site

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0025 — SMTO needs you to be signed in to open this file
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't confirm who was asking for this Task file, so it didn't open it. This usually happens after your sign-in expires or when a file link is opened in another browser. The file itself is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0025 — SMTO needs you to be signed in to open this file

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0026 — A Task result was too large for SMTO to save
documents.summary: One step in this Task produced a result larger than 16 MB, so SMTO couldn't save it with the conversation. Anything that step already did isn't undone; only its result couldn't be kept.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0026 — A Task result was too large for SMTO to save

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0027 — SMTO couldn't find that saved result in the chosen conversation
documents.summary: The saved result you tried to use either belongs to a different conversation than the one named, or it has since been deleted. SMTO couldn't use it, so nothing was attached.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0027 — SMTO couldn't find that saved result in the chosen conversation

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0028 — SMTO's scheduled cleanup of old Task files didn't finish
documents.summary: SMTO removes old Task files on a schedule, and its last cleanup didn't finish. Some expired files may still be using disk space. Files you're keeping aren't affected, and SMTO tries again in about an hour.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0028 — SMTO's scheduled cleanup of old Task files didn't finish

documents.title: SMTO-ART-0029 — SMTO couldn't match a background command's result to its Task
documents.summary: A command running in the background sent back a result SMTO couldn't match to the Task that started it, so SMTO didn't record it. The command may still have done its work, and related files are kept.

headings.title: SMTO-ART-0029 — SMTO couldn't match a background command's result to its Task

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0001 — SMTO needs a username or password to continue
documents.summary: The connection this Task is using is missing sign-in details, such as a username or password, so SMTO stopped before connecting. Nothing ran on that connection, and this doesn't mean a password you gave was wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0001 — SMTO needs a username or password to continue

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0002 — An older result says an admin password couldn't be sent safely
documents.summary: This comes from a result saved by an older version of SMTO. SMTO refused to send an administrator password over a Gateway connection it couldn't confirm was secure. It doesn't mean your password was wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0002 — An older result says an admin password couldn't be sent safely

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0003 — The admin password was for a different account than the Gateway's
documents.summary: SMTO was given an administrator username that doesn't match the account the Gateway uses on that computer, so it didn't send the password or run the command.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0003 — The admin password was for a different account than the Gateway's

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0004 — The computer didn't accept the administrator password
documents.summary: SMTO tried to run a command with administrator rights, but the password was refused, either by the computer or because it contained a line break. The command did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0004 — The computer didn't accept the administrator password

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0005 — SMTO didn't run an admin command that was set up to take input
documents.summary: This command needs administrator rights, but it was set up to also take typed input or run interactively. SMTO keeps your administrator password apart from what the command reads, so it stopped before running anything.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0005 — SMTO didn't run an admin command that was set up to take input

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0006 — This account isn't allowed to run that command as administrator
documents.summary: The computer's own rules don't let the account SMTO uses run this command with administrator rights, so the command did not run. Entering a different password won't change that.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0006 — This account isn't allowed to run that command as administrator

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0007 — This service sign-in isn't set up completely
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a complete, up-to-date setup for this service sign-in, such as the app ID, its secret, or the sign-in address. Signing in again won't help until that setup is fixed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0007 — This service sign-in isn't set up completely

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0008 — This connection doesn't allow the access SMTO needs
documents.summary: This action needs access that the saved connection isn't set up to allow, or that wasn't approved when you signed in. SMTO can't add that access on its own, so it stopped before using the connection.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0008 — This connection doesn't allow the access SMTO needs

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0009 — Sign in to the service so the Task can continue
documents.summary: This step uses a connected service that needs you to sign in and approve access first. Until you do, the step waits here and doesn't continue.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0009 — Sign in to the service so the Task can continue

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0010 — The service refused or withdrew SMTO's access
documents.summary: The connected service didn't give SMTO the access it asked for, or no longer accepts access it gave before. This happens when Deny is chosen on the sign-in page or SMTO's access is removed from the account.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0010 — The service refused or withdrew SMTO's access

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0011 — The sign-in link or code expired before it was used
documents.summary: The sign-in link, device code, or short-term access SMTO had for this step is no longer valid, usually because it took too long or the connection's settings changed. Old links can't be reused.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0011 — The sign-in link or code expired before it was used

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0012 — SMTO couldn't confirm the sign-in response was genuine
documents.summary: After you signed in, the reply from the service didn't match the sign-in SMTO started, so SMTO refused it to avoid connecting the wrong account. This often happens with reused or old sign-in pages.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0012 — SMTO couldn't confirm the sign-in response was genuine

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0013 — SMTO couldn't complete sign-in with the service
documents.summary: SMTO tried to reach the service's sign-in system but couldn't, or got back an answer it couldn't use or trust. The sign-in wasn't completed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0013 — SMTO couldn't complete sign-in with the service

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0014 — The sign-in service sent SMTO an answer it couldn't use
documents.summary: When SMTO asked the service for access, its reply was incomplete, unreadable, or said your sign-in is no longer active. SMTO didn't use that reply, and you may need to sign in to that service again.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0014 — The sign-in service sent SMTO an answer it couldn't use

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0015 — The sign-in service didn't accept SMTO's app details
documents.summary: The service SMTO signs in to rejected the app ID, secret, key or certificate saved for this connection. This is not about your own password, and SMTO got no access from this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0015 — The sign-in service didn't accept SMTO's app details

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0016 — SMTO couldn't reach the Gateway securely to use this sign-in
documents.summary: This task needs to pass your saved sign-in details to the Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to work on another computer) over a verified, encrypted link. SMTO couldn't confirm that link, so it kept them private and stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0016 — SMTO couldn't reach the Gateway securely to use this sign-in

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0017 — This sign-in uses an option SMTO doesn't support
documents.summary: The saved sign-in, or the way this task tries to use it, relies on an option SMTO doesn't allow, so SMTO stopped before getting access. It won't turn on an unsupported option just because the service offers it.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0017 — This sign-in uses an option SMTO doesn't support

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0018 — SMTO can't find the Google app setup it needs
documents.summary: To connect to Google, SMTO needs a saved Google app setup (a Google Workspace OAuth App entry in Parameter Store). It couldn't find the one this request named, so it didn't contact Google.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0018 — SMTO can't find the Google app setup it needs

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0019 — The saved Google app setup has a mistake
documents.summary: The Google app setup SMTO was told to use is either the wrong kind of entry or has settings SMTO can't accept. SMTO stopped before opening a Google sign-in, so nothing was connected or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0019 — The saved Google app setup has a mistake

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0020 — SMTO has no connected Google account that can do this
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a connected Google account with the access this request needs, or the account name it was given doesn't exist. This doesn't mean anything happened to your Google account itself.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0020 — SMTO has no connected Google account that can do this

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0021 — The saved Google account entry is damaged or the wrong kind
documents.summary: The entry SMTO was told to use isn't a valid connected Google account. It may be a different kind of entry, or its saved details were changed by hand or are incomplete. SMTO didn't use it.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0021 — The saved Google account entry is damaged or the wrong kind

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0022 — More than one Google account could do this
documents.summary: You have several connected Google accounts that could handle this request, and SMTO won't guess which one to act as. Nothing was done with any of them.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0022 — More than one Google account could do this

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0023 — SMTO needs to know which Google account to update
documents.summary: A Google account is already connected through this Google app, so SMTO needs to know whether you're updating it or adding a new one. It won't quietly create a second copy, and nothing was saved from this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0023 — SMTO needs to know which Google account to update

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0024 — That account name already belongs to a different Google connection
documents.summary: The name chosen for this Google connection is already used by a different Google account or a different Google app setup. SMTO left that saved account unchanged rather than replace it.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0024 — That account name already belongs to a different Google connection

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0025 — This Google sign-in link is no longer valid
documents.summary: Google sent you back to SMTO, but the reply didn't match a current sign-in request. The link may have been old or already used, SMTO may have restarted, or its Google app setup changed. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0025 — This Google sign-in link is no longer valid

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0026 — The Google sign-in ended without giving permission
documents.summary: Google came back without approving access, for example because Cancel was selected or Google refused the request. SMTO got no new access and saved nothing from this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0026 — The Google sign-in ended without giving permission

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0027 — The Google sign-in took too long
documents.summary: Each Google sign-in link from SMTO works for only 10 minutes, and this one ran past that before Google sent you back. SMTO saved nothing from it.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0027 — The Google sign-in took too long

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0028 — Google didn't give SMTO usable access
documents.summary: Google's reply didn't include access SMTO could accept, so your Google account wasn't connected or renewed this time. SMTO saved nothing from the reply, and the request that needed Google didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0028 — Google didn't give SMTO usable access

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0029 — Your Google account hasn't allowed SMTO to do this
documents.summary: The connected Google account doesn't give SMTO the access this request needs. This older message doesn't say exactly which access is missing.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0029 — Your Google account hasn't allowed SMTO to do this

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0030 — Your Google account needs extra permission for this
documents.summary: Your Google account is connected, but you haven't yet allowed SMTO to use it for this kind of work, such as sending email or changing calendar events. SMTO stopped before doing anything.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0030 — Your Google account needs extra permission for this

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0031 — SMTO couldn't renew its access to your Google account
documents.summary: SMTO needed to renew its saved access to your Google account and couldn't. This older message doesn't say why; it could be a network problem or a sign-in that needs renewing.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0031 — SMTO couldn't renew its access to your Google account

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0032 — Your Google account needs to be reconnected
documents.summary: SMTO's saved access to this Google account expired, was removed, or was disconnected, so SMTO can't renew it on its own. The request that needed Google didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0032 — Your Google account needs to be reconnected

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0033 — SMTO couldn't confirm which Google account signed in
documents.summary: After you signed in, SMTO couldn't verify Google's proof of which account it was, so it didn't save the connection. Your existing connections weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0033 — SMTO couldn't confirm which Google account signed in

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0034 — Your Google account changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: The saved Google account this action relies on was changed, removed or reconnected partway through. SMTO stopped instead of quietly switching accounts, and it didn't save a new sign-in or send this request using the changed account.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0034 — Your Google account changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0035 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from Google sign-in
documents.summary: SMTO contacted Google to finish or renew your Google sign-in, but the connection failed or Google's reply couldn't be used. Your saved Google connection wasn't changed, and the Google request you asked for wasn't made.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0035 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from Google sign-in

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0036 — Too many Google sign-ins are waiting to be finished
documents.summary: SMTO can keep up to 32 unfinished Google sign-in links at once, and that limit is reached, so no new link was made. Unfinished links expire after ten minutes. None of your Google accounts were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0036 — Too many Google sign-ins are waiting to be finished

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0037 — SMTO doesn't recognize the Google access that was requested
documents.summary: The request named a Google feature SMTO doesn't support, so SMTO didn't create a sign-in link or add any access. SMTO only grants Google access from its own fixed list of features.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0037 — SMTO doesn't recognize the Google access that was requested

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0038 — SMTO can't use that name to find a Google account
documents.summary: SMTO finds Google accounts and Google app settings only by their exact Parameter Store name, such as workspace. The name given was in a different form, like an email address, so nothing was looked up or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0038 — SMTO can't use that name to find a Google account

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0039 — SMTO hid a reply that contained your sign-in secret
documents.summary: The service answered this request, but its reply contained the secret sign-in details SMTO used, so SMTO blocked the reply instead of showing or saving it. If the request was meant to change something, it may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0039 — SMTO hid a reply that contained your sign-in secret

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0040 — This Microsoft sign-in doesn't match an open request
documents.summary: Microsoft sent you back to SMTO, but SMTO had no open sign-in waiting for that reply. The link may have been used already, replaced, or cleared when SMTO restarted. No Microsoft account was connected or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0040 — This Microsoft sign-in doesn't match an open request

documents.title: SMTO-AUT-0041 — This sign-in needs a saved connection with an https:// address
documents.summary: SMTO only sends this kind of sign-in through a connection saved in Parameter Store whose address starts with https://. This request used an unsaved connection or a plain http:// address, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-AUT-0041 — This sign-in needs a saved connection with an https:// address

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0001 — Compatible Python is required
documents.summary: This installer needs Python 3.11 or newer (64-bit) on this computer and couldn't find it, so it stopped. Earlier setup steps, such as installing system packages, may already have run.

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0002 — SMTO can't start with one of the options or settings given
documents.summary: A command was started with an option SMTO doesn't know, or with a value it can't accept, such as a data folder that doesn't exist. SMTO stopped at that point instead of guessing what you meant.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0002 — SMTO can't start with one of the options or settings given

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0003 — A startup option is missing its value
documents.summary: An option that needs a value, such as --port or --data-dir, was typed with nothing after it. SMTO stopped before starting.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0003 — A startup option is missing its value

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0004 — This part of SMTO isn't installed on this computer
documents.summary: The command looked for SMTO's installed program files (the .venv folder) next to it and didn't find them, so it stopped. Usually the installer hasn't been run here yet, or the folder was moved or deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0004 — This part of SMTO isn't installed on this computer

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0005 — SMTO needs OpenSSL to set up a secure (HTTPS) connection
documents.summary: SMTO was started with HTTPS turned on and needed to create a security certificate, but the OpenSSL tool it uses for that isn't installed. SMTO stopped instead of starting without HTTPS.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0005 — SMTO needs OpenSSL to set up a secure (HTTPS) connection

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0006 — Your account can't update the Gateway's installed files
documents.summary: The Gateway installer found the Gateway's existing program files, but your user account isn't allowed to change them, often because a different account or sudo installed them before. The Gateway's program files weren't updated.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0006 — Your account can't update the Gateway's installed files

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0007 — This installer doesn't support this computer's system
documents.summary: The installer you ran is made for a different operating system or processor type than this computer has, so it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0007 — This installer doesn't support this computer's system

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0008 — Part of SMTO's installation is incomplete
documents.summary: The Gateway or SMTO checked its installed parts and found something missing or out of date, or it was started in a way this kind of installation doesn't support. It stopped before starting.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0008 — Part of SMTO's installation is incomplete

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0009 — Python couldn't create the Windows Gateway's program folder
documents.summary: The Windows Gateway installer asked Python to create the Gateway's private program folder (.venv), and Python reported a failure. The Gateway wasn't installed or updated.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0009 — Python couldn't create the Windows Gateway's program folder

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0010 — The Gateway installer couldn't update Python's install tools
documents.summary: Before installing the Gateway's parts, the installer updates Python's own install tools (pip, setuptools and wheel). That update failed, so the installer stopped there.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0010 — The Gateway installer couldn't update Python's install tools

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0011 — The program that runs the AI model wasn't found
documents.summary: The model start script couldn't find the model engine program it launches (llama-server, Ollama or vLLM), or the curl tool it uses for checks. It stopped before starting the model, so nothing was loaded.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0011 — The program that runs the AI model wasn't found

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0012 — The AI model's files weren't found on this computer
documents.summary: The model start script couldn't find or read the model file it was set to load, or for vLLM the matching tokenizer files. It stopped before loading anything, and files already on disk weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0012 — The AI model's files weren't found on this computer

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0013 — Your model engine version lacks a feature this script needs
documents.summary: Before loading the model, the start script checked the engine program's list of options, and an option it needs (for example --spec-type) was missing. It stopped before loading the model.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0013 — Your model engine version lacks a feature this script needs

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0014 — The model launcher can't use the two graphics cards selected
documents.summary: This launcher splits the model across two different graphics cards (GPUs). The cards it was told to use aren't two different ones, or one isn't visible on this computer, so it stopped before loading the model.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0014 — The model launcher can't use the two graphics cards selected

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0015 — The model setup can't find a working NVIDIA graphics card
documents.summary: Before installing or starting a model, SMTO checks that it can use the computer's NVIDIA graphics card (GPU). That check failed, so it stopped before installing anything or loading a model.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0015 — The model setup can't find a working NVIDIA graphics card

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0016 — The model launcher doesn't recognize the engine you chose
documents.summary: This launcher can run the model with one of two engines (the program that runs the model): vLLM or llama.cpp. The ENGINE setting names something else, so it stopped without starting anything.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0016 — The model launcher doesn't recognize the engine you chose

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0017 — The environment name you gave the installer can't be used
documents.summary: The installer needs a simple name for the new Conda environment, the separate space where the model software goes. Your name uses characters it doesn't allow, or is reserved by Conda. Nothing was installed or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0017 — The environment name you gave the installer can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0018 — The installer can't use the folder chosen for Conda
documents.summary: The folder chosen for Conda, the tool that installs the model software, isn't a full path, or it already holds other files but no working Conda. Nothing was downloaded, and that folder wasn't touched.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0018 — The installer can't use the folder chosen for Conda

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0019 — The installer can't find Conda to check your setup
documents.summary: You asked the installer only to check an existing setup, but it couldn't find Conda, the tool that holds the model software. Check-only mode never installs anything, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0019 — The installer can't find Conda to check your setup

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0020 — The installer needs curl or wget to download Conda
documents.summary: No Conda was found, so the installer tried to download it. That needs a download program, curl or wget, and this computer has neither. Nothing was downloaded or installed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0020 — The installer needs curl or wget to download Conda

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0021 — No Conda environment with that name was found to check
documents.summary: You asked the installer to check an existing Conda environment, the space where the model software is installed, but Conda has none with that exact name. Check-only mode never creates one, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0021 — No Conda environment with that name was found to check

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0022 — A Conda environment with that name already exists
documents.summary: The installer only creates new Conda environments, and one with this name is already there. It stopped without touching the existing environment or anything installed in it.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0022 — A Conda environment with that name already exists

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0023 — The installer couldn't work out which vLLM version to install
documents.summary: The installer asks a helper file which vLLM version fits your computer, but the answer came back incomplete. It stopped before installing vLLM. The new Conda environment it had just created is still there, without vLLM.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0023 — The installer couldn't work out which vLLM version to install

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0024 — The installer couldn't load the NVIDIA graphics driver
documents.summary: To choose the right vLLM build, the installer talks directly to the NVIDIA driver, the software that runs your graphics card. It couldn't load the driver, so it stopped before installing vLLM.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0024 — The installer couldn't load the NVIDIA graphics driver

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0025 — The installer can't see any NVIDIA graphics cards
documents.summary: The installer found no NVIDIA graphics card it can use, so it stopped. If this happened during the final check, vLLM is already installed and only the card access needs fixing.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0025 — The installer can't see any NVIDIA graphics cards

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0026 — The NVIDIA driver returned an error during the installer's check
documents.summary: The installer asked the NVIDIA driver about your graphics cards, and the driver answered with an error. It stopped before installing vLLM, though earlier steps may already have set up Conda or the new environment.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0026 — The NVIDIA driver returned an error during the installer's check

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0027 — This computer's processor type isn't supported by the vLLM installer
documents.summary: The vLLM installer only works on Linux computers with x86_64 (common Intel and AMD) or aarch64 (64-bit ARM) processors. This computer reported a different type, so the installer stopped before installing vLLM.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0027 — This computer's processor type isn't supported by the vLLM installer

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0028 — One of your graphics cards is too old for this vLLM install
documents.summary: The latest vLLM needs NVIDIA graphics cards at least as new as the Turing family (such as the RTX 20 series). At least one card the installer can use is older, so it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0028 — One of your graphics cards is too old for this vLLM install

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0029 — The installer can't read the latest vLLM release's build details
documents.summary: The installer reads the newest vLLM release's details online to pick the build that fits your graphics card. That release no longer lists them the way the installer expects, so it stopped before installing vLLM.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0029 — The installer can't read the latest vLLM release's build details

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0030 — The installer found a vLLM download from an unexpected place
documents.summary: The installer only downloads vLLM from the official vLLM release page. The newest release pointed to a download somewhere else, so the installer refused it and stopped before installing vLLM.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0030 — The installer found a vLLM download from an unexpected place

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0031 — No vLLM build fits this computer's driver and system
documents.summary: The installer checked every ready-made package in the newest vLLM release, and none fits this computer. This happens when the NVIDIA driver is older than those packages need, or the system isn't one they were built for.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0031 — No vLLM build fits this computer's driver and system

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0032 — The vLLM installer's helper was started the wrong way
documents.summary: vllm_install_support.py is a helper the vLLM installer runs for you. It was started with something other than its two commands, probe or plan, so it did nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0032 — The vLLM installer's helper was started the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0033 — The model server didn't start answering in time
documents.summary: SMTO's model tool waited for the model server, the program that runs the AI model, but it didn't answer before the time limit, or it closed while starting. Nothing was sent to the model yet.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0033 — The model server didn't start answering in time

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0034 — Another model server is still using the benchmark's port
documents.summary: Before starting each model, the benchmark waits for its port to be free. Something kept answering there for two minutes, so this model wasn't started and gets no score in the report.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0034 — Another model server is still using the benchmark's port

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0035 — The model server didn't confirm the model the benchmark expected
documents.summary: The benchmark started a model server, but the server never confirmed it was serving the expected model. The benchmark stopped that server and skipped this model rather than test the wrong one.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0035 — The model server didn't confirm the model the benchmark expected

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0036 — The model server stopped while it was starting
documents.summary: The benchmark started a model server, but that server closed before it was ready. This model gets no score in the report, and the benchmark moves on to the next one.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0036 — The model server stopped while it was starting

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0037 — The model server took too long to start
documents.summary: The model server the benchmark started wasn't ready within the time allowed (15 minutes unless you changed it). The benchmark stopped it, skipped this model and moved on to the next one.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0037 — The model server took too long to start

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0038 — A model's answer had no structured data for the benchmark to check
documents.summary: One benchmark question asked the model to reply in a strict data format, but its answer contained none. That question is marked as failed; the rest of the benchmark carries on.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0038 — A model's answer had no structured data for the benchmark to check

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0039 — Your graphics card gave a wrong answer to a basic test
documents.summary: While checking the model environment, the installer asked each graphics card (GPU) to add 1 and 1 and got the wrong answer. Everything stays installed, but it isn't safe to run models with it yet.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0039 — Your graphics card gave a wrong answer to a basic test

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0040 — The model software isn't using your NVIDIA graphics card
documents.summary: Your graphics card passed its tests, but vLLM, the software that runs local models, didn't switch to its NVIDIA mode. The environment stays installed but isn't ready to run models.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0040 — The model software isn't using your NVIDIA graphics card

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0041 — SMTO couldn't connect to your model server while starting
documents.summary: While starting, SMTO tried to connect to the server that runs your AI Model and couldn't. SMTO keeps starting, but requests to the Model may fail until it can be reached.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0041 — SMTO couldn't connect to your model server while starting

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0042 — SMTO's optional Console couldn't start
documents.summary: SMTO tried to start its Console, a separate diagnostics page, and the computer wouldn't start it. Your conversations and Tasks don't depend on the Console.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0042 — SMTO's optional Console couldn't start

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0043 — The benchmark needs the address of your running model server
documents.summary: You told the benchmark not to start a model server itself, but didn't say which running server to test. It stopped before testing anything, and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0043 — The benchmark needs the address of your running model server

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0044 — The benchmark doesn't recognize a model name you listed
documents.summary: One or more names after --models aren't models this benchmark knows how to start. It stopped before starting or testing anything.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0044 — The benchmark doesn't recognize a model name you listed

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0045 — SMTO is missing a part it needs to start
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because part of the program, or a file it was told to use, couldn't be found.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0045 — SMTO is missing a part it needs to start

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0046 — SMTO isn't allowed to open a file it needs to start
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because your computer blocked it from reading or writing one of its files or folders.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0046 — SMTO isn't allowed to open a file it needs to start

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0047 — Your disk is full, so SMTO can't finish starting
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because the disk that holds its data is full, or you've used up your storage allowance on it.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0047 — Your disk is full, so SMTO can't finish starting

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0048 — SMTO can't save data because its disk is read-only
documents.summary: SMTO can see the disk where it keeps its data, but the disk is set so nothing can be written to it. SMTO needs to write there to start.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0048 — SMTO can't save data because its disk is read-only

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0049 — Another program is already using SMTO's network port
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't open the network address your browser uses to reach it because another program is already using it. That program may be a copy of SMTO that's already running.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0049 — Another program is already using SMTO's network port

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0050 — SMTO couldn't reopen your saved work
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while loading your saved conversations and Tasks because a step that reads them didn't finish safely. This alone doesn't mean your data is damaged.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0050 — SMTO couldn't reopen your saved work

documents.title: SMTO-BOOT-0051 — SMTO couldn't load its security certificate
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use the certificate that gives it a secure https:// address. When started normally, it may come back on a plain http:// address until this is fixed.

headings.title: SMTO-BOOT-0051 — SMTO couldn't load its security certificate

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0001 — This Task isn't allowed to use that tool or program
documents.summary: The Task tried to use a tool, Skill or program that your capability settings block, so SMTO stopped that step and didn't run it.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0001 — This Task isn't allowed to use that tool or program

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0002 — The tool this Task asked for isn't available
documents.summary: The Model working on your Task asked for a tool that this Task can't use right now. SMTO turned the request down, so nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0002 — The tool this Task asked for isn't available

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0003 — SMTO looked for a part of a Skill that doesn't exist
documents.summary: While working on your Task, SMTO's Agent asked for a section of a Skill that isn't in that Skill's list. Nothing was run, and the Agent usually picks a real section and carries on.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0003 — SMTO looked for a part of a Skill that doesn't exist

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0004 — SMTO couldn't set up its tools because two names clash
documents.summary: SMTO stopped preparing the tools for this Task because a Skill uses a name that another tool, or SMTO itself, already uses. No tool was run at that point.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0004 — SMTO couldn't set up its tools because two names clash

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0005 — SMTO couldn't confirm a safe way or place to do this step
documents.summary: SMTO stopped this step because it couldn't confirm the tool it needed, or the USB or external drive it should save to. Nothing was written or run by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0005 — SMTO couldn't confirm a safe way or place to do this step

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0006 — SMTO hit an internal step it doesn't recognize
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent tried an internal step that this version of SMTO doesn't know how to do, so the Task stopped there. That step didn't run, but earlier steps in the Task may have finished.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0006 — SMTO hit an internal step it doesn't recognize

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0007 — That program name can't be used in a Shell rule
documents.summary: A Shell executable rule must name just one program, like curl, or its exact path. This entry had spaces, options or symbols in it, so SMTO didn't save the rule.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0007 — That program name can't be used in a Shell rule

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0008 — A Skill or tool is set to both use and never use
documents.summary: Your capability choices both favor and block the same Skill or tool, or favor a tool whose whole Skill is blocked. SMTO can't follow both, so it didn't accept these choices.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0008 — A Skill or tool is set to both use and never use

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0009 — Your capability settings name a Skill or tool that isn't installed
documents.summary: Your saved capability choices mention a Skill or tool this SMTO doesn't have, often because it was removed or renamed. SMTO won't use a choice it can't match, so it didn't accept them.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0009 — Your capability settings name a Skill or tool that isn't installed

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0010 — SMTO tried to use a tool that isn't installed
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent asked for a tool by a name this SMTO doesn't have. Nothing was run, and SMTO won't swap in a similar-looking tool, because that could do something you didn't ask for.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0010 — SMTO tried to use a tool that isn't installed

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0011 — SMTO tried to use a tool before it was ready for this Task
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent tried to use a tool before loading its instructions for this Task, or the tool stopped being available. Nothing was run, and the Agent usually loads the tool and tries again.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0011 — SMTO tried to use a tool before it was ready for this Task

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0012 — SMTO asked for a part of a Skill that isn't listed
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent asked to see a section of a Skill's tools that this SMTO doesn't list, often a guessed or outdated name. Nothing was run, and the Agent can look up the real sections and continue.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0012 — SMTO asked for a part of a Skill that isn't listed

documents.title: SMTO-CAP-0013 — SMTO couldn't load the full set of tools it asked for
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent asked to load a group of tools, but at least one isn't available in this Task. SMTO rejected the whole request instead of quietly loading only part of it. Nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-CAP-0013 — SMTO couldn't load the full set of tools it asked for

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0001 — A safety setting has a value SMTO doesn't recognize
documents.summary: A safety setting, such as Unsafe actions or an Agent Check, was sent with a name or value SMTO doesn't recognize. SMTO rejected it, so nothing was changed or run.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0001 — A safety setting has a value SMTO doesn't recognize

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0002 — This SMTO version can't open your saved data
documents.summary: Your saved data was made by a newer SMTO, or by an old version this one no longer supports, so SMTO stopped while starting. Your data wasn't changed or deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0002 — This SMTO version can't open your saved data

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0003 — One of SMTO's prompts has a formatting problem
documents.summary: SMTO fills in blanks in its prompts (the instructions it sends to the model) before using them. One prompt is empty, has a stray dollar sign, or asks for a blank SMTO can't fill.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0003 — One of SMTO's prompts has a formatting problem

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0004 — The Gateway can't start because its port number is invalid
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) was given a network port number outside 1 to 65535, so it stopped before starting. Nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0004 — The Gateway can't start because its port number is invalid

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0005 — The Gateway's command time limit can't be negative
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) was given a negative time limit for commands, so it stopped before starting. Nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0005 — The Gateway's command time limit can't be negative

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0006 — The Gateway knows the SMTO address but not its port
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) was told which computer runs SMTO, but not which port to connect to. It stopped before starting, so it can't connect yet.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0006 — The Gateway knows the SMTO address but not its port

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0007 — The Gateway couldn't start: its SMTO server port is invalid
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. The port number it was given for reaching your SMTO server isn't a real port number. No settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0007 — The Gateway couldn't start: its SMTO server port is invalid

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0008 — The Gateway couldn't start: its connection type for SMTO is invalid
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. The connection type it was given for reaching SMTO, such as https, isn't one it understands. No settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0008 — The Gateway couldn't start: its connection type for SMTO is invalid

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0009 — The Gateway couldn't start: idle terminal time limit is too low
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. Its limit for how long an unused terminal may stay open is set to zero or less, which isn't allowed. No settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0009 — The Gateway couldn't start: idle terminal time limit is too low

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0010 — The Gateway couldn't start: input wait time can't be negative
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. Its wait time for spotting a command that needs typed input is below zero. No settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0010 — The Gateway couldn't start: input wait time can't be negative

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0011 — The Gateway couldn't start: its working folder doesn't exist
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. The folder it was told to run commands in can't be found on that computer. No files or settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0011 — The Gateway couldn't start: its working folder doesn't exist

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0012 — The Gateway couldn't start: its working folder path isn't a folder
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer, stopped right after starting. Its working folder setting points to a file or something else that isn't a folder. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0012 — The Gateway couldn't start: its working folder path isn't a folder

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0013 — SMTO can't save a name with hidden characters or a web address
documents.summary: The name includes something that isn't plain text, such as a tab, a line break or an invisible character copied from elsewhere, or it looks like a web address. SMTO didn't save it.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0013 — SMTO can't save a name with hidden characters or a web address

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0014 — SMTO couldn't tell which Gateway should be the main one
documents.summary: Your message's settings named two different Gateways (the computers SMTO runs commands on) as the main one. SMTO stopped before starting any work so nothing runs on the wrong computer.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0014 — SMTO couldn't tell which Gateway should be the main one

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0015 — SMTO can't read this conversation's saved settings format
documents.summary: The settings stored with this conversation, such as its mode and Gateway choices, use a format this copy of SMTO doesn't recognize. SMTO left them as they are and won't use them for new messages here.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0015 — SMTO can't read this conversation's saved settings format

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0016 — SMTO didn't recognize a setting your page tried to change
documents.summary: The page asked SMTO to change a message-box setting that this SMTO doesn't have. This usually means the page in your browser is from a different SMTO version than the server. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0016 — SMTO didn't recognize a setting your page tried to change

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0017 — The conversation link or reference isn't valid
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to load or change a conversation's settings, but the conversation reference has characters or a length SMTO never uses, for example from a link that was cut off or edited. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0017 — The conversation link or reference isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0018 — This conversation was deleted or can't be found
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find the conversation you're working in. It may have been deleted on another device or removed by automatic cleanup. Your last change or message wasn't saved to it.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0018 — This conversation was deleted or can't be found

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0019 — SMTO got new-chat settings for a conversation that already exists
documents.summary: Choices meant only for starting a brand-new conversation, such as Parallel execution or Background activities, were sent with a conversation that already exists. SMTO didn't start the task or change any settings.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0019 — SMTO got new-chat settings for a conversation that already exists

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0020 — SMTO got new-chat choices without the rest of the chat's settings
documents.summary: Starting a new conversation needs both its scheduling choices, like Parallel execution, and its message-box settings, like mode and Gateway. Only the first part arrived, so SMTO didn't start the conversation or the task.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0020 — SMTO got new-chat choices without the rest of the chat's settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0021 — SMTO got two different sets of choices for this message
documents.summary: Your message said one thing about how to run it, for example Plan or Agent mode, or which Gateway to use, while the message box settings said another. SMTO didn't start the task.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0021 — SMTO got two different sets of choices for this message

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0022 — SMTO couldn't use this conversation's saved settings
documents.summary: Either the settings stored with this conversation, like its mode, Gateway and output limit, can't be read, or its Output limit is lower than the minimum your model setup now requires. SMTO won't send messages here until that is fixed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0022 — SMTO couldn't use this conversation's saved settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0023 — SMTO couldn't save that change to the message box settings
documents.summary: The setting you just changed above the message box has a value SMTO can't accept, for example an Output limit below your model's minimum. SMTO didn't save the change.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0023 — SMTO couldn't save that change to the message box settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0024 — This conversation's settings changed in another window or device
documents.summary: While you were changing a setting above the message box, the same conversation's settings were changed in another window or on another device. SMTO didn't save your change so it wouldn't overwrite theirs.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0024 — This conversation's settings changed in another window or device

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0025 — Saved model is unavailable
documents.summary: This conversation was set to use a model that SMTO no longer offers, for example because it was removed or renamed in the model setup. New messages can't start until a working model is chosen. Tasks already started keep their model.

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0026 — A Gateway chosen for this message is missing or turned off
documents.summary: The message box is set to use a Gateway (a computer SMTO runs commands on) that has been removed or switched off. SMTO didn't start the task.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0026 — A Gateway chosen for this message is missing or turned off

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0027 — SMTO couldn't apply your permission choice here
documents.summary: The permissions you picked were meant for a new conversation, or a saved rule didn't match your approve or deny choice. Nothing was sent or decided.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0027 — SMTO couldn't apply your permission choice here

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0028 — This request used settings SMTO no longer accepts
documents.summary: The request tried to set SMTO's internal behavior rules directly, which SMTO no longer allows. It was refused, so nothing was started or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0028 — This request used settings SMTO no longer accepts

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0029 — SMTO couldn't load its list of slash commands
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because two of its slash commands (like /stop or /status) share a name, or one has a name it can't use. Your conversations aren't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0029 — SMTO couldn't load its list of slash commands

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0030 — This Skill doesn't offer that setting or connection test
documents.summary: You asked to change or test settings for a Skill (an add-on that gives SMTO extra abilities), but the installed version doesn't have them. Nothing was saved or tested.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0030 — This Skill doesn't offer that setting or connection test

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0031 — SMTO couldn't accept these Skill settings
documents.summary: The Skill settings you tried to save or test are too large (over 64 KB) or contain a value in the wrong form. Nothing was saved, and no connection test ran.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0031 — SMTO couldn't accept these Skill settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0032 — The model server address isn't a valid web address
documents.summary: The address SMTO uses to reach your AI model is incomplete or mistyped: it may be missing http://, the server name, or have a port number outside 1 to 65535.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0032 — The model server address isn't a valid web address

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0033 — SMTO's settings file is from a newer version of SMTO
documents.summary: The startup settings file (usually config.yaml) was written for a newer SMTO than the one installed, so SMTO stopped instead of guessing what it means. The file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0033 — SMTO's settings file is from a newer version of SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0034 — SMTO's settings file uses a format it no longer supports
documents.summary: The startup settings file (usually config.yaml) says it uses an older format than this SMTO accepts, so SMTO stopped before starting. The file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0034 — SMTO's settings file uses a format it no longer supports

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0035 — SMTO can't find the settings file it was told to use
documents.summary: SMTO was started with a specific settings file, but there is no file at that location, so it stopped. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0035 — SMTO can't find the settings file it was told to use

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0036 — SMTO wasn't told which settings file to use
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to start with a specific settings file, but no file location was given, so it stopped. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0036 — SMTO wasn't told which settings file to use

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0037 — SMTO's settings file has a formatting mistake
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't read its startup settings file (usually config.yaml) because the text isn't laid out the way it expects, so it stopped. The file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0037 — SMTO's settings file has a formatting mistake

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0038 — SMTO's settings file doesn't start with named settings
documents.summary: SMTO read its startup settings file (usually config.yaml), but instead of named sections such as llm: and runtime:, it found a list or a single value at the top, so it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0038 — SMTO's settings file doesn't start with named settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0039 — SMTO's settings file has an empty model API key
documents.summary: SMTO's startup settings file (usually config.yaml) has an api_key line for the AI model with nothing in it, so SMTO stopped. The key works like a password for connecting to the model service.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0039 — SMTO's settings file has an empty model API key

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0040 — SMTO's settings file has no model server address
documents.summary: SMTO's startup settings file (usually config.yaml) has a base_url line for the AI model with nothing in it, so SMTO doesn't know where your model is and stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0040 — SMTO's settings file has no model server address

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0041 — SMTO's model context size setting is zero or negative
documents.summary: A startup setting tells SMTO how much text the AI model can consider at once (its context size), but it is set to zero or a negative number, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0041 — SMTO's model context size setting is zero or negative

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0042 — SMTO's model answer length setting is negative
documents.summary: A startup setting limits how long the AI model's answers can be, but it is set to a negative number, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0042 — SMTO's model answer length setting is negative

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0043 — SMTO's model request time limit must be above zero
documents.summary: A startup setting gives the AI model a time limit for answering each request, but it is set to zero or less, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0043 — SMTO's model request time limit must be above zero

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0044 — SMTO's command output limit must be above zero
documents.summary: A startup setting limits how much of each command's output SMTO keeps for the agent to read, but it is set to zero or less, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0044 — SMTO's command output limit must be above zero

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0045 — SMTO's command access setting has an unknown value
documents.summary: A startup setting controls whether and how SMTO may run commands, but its value isn't one SMTO recognizes, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0045 — SMTO's command access setting has an unknown value

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0046 — SMTO's shutdown wait time must be above zero
documents.summary: A startup setting tells SMTO how long to wait for its background work to stop when it shuts down, but it is set to zero or less, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0046 — SMTO's shutdown wait time must be above zero

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0047 — SMTO can't start because its port number is out of range
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because its port — the number after the colon in SMTO's web address — is set outside 1 to 65535. Your conversations and settings were not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0047 — SMTO can't start because its port number is out of range

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0048 — SMTO can't start because a database row limit is below zero
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because a setting that limits how many database rows it returns is a negative number. Your conversations and settings were not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0048 — SMTO can't start because a database row limit is below zero

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0049 — SMTO can't start because its schedule history limit is too low

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0053 — SMTO's default Gateway name isn't in its list of Gateways

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0056 — A Gateway in SMTO's startup settings has no address

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0057 — Model temperature must be between 0 and 1

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0058 — SMTO doesn't know which Gateway to use by default

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0058 — SMTO doesn't know which Gateway to use by default

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0059 — SMTO doesn't recognize the Gateway name it was asked to use

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0059 — SMTO doesn't recognize the Gateway name it was asked to use

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0060 — SMTO can't start because its command output limit is too low

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0060 — SMTO can't start because its command output limit is too low

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0061 — SMTO doesn't recognize the shell access setting
documents.summary: The shell access setting — which controls whether SMTO may run commands on a computer — has a value SMTO doesn't recognize, so SMTO refused it rather than guess how much access to allow.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0061 — SMTO doesn't recognize the shell access setting

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0062 — SMTO can't start because its shutdown wait time is too low

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0062 — SMTO can't start because its shutdown wait time is too low

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0063 — A Model time limit is outside the allowed range

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0063 — A Model time limit is outside the allowed range

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0064 — An old summary option is no longer supported

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0064 — An old summary option is no longer supported

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0065 — The time limit given for this task isn't a usable number

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0065 — The time limit given for this task isn't a usable number

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0066 — This action no longer matches the task's saved settings

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0066 — This action no longer matches the task's saved settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0067 — Saved Agent settings are in a format this SMTO can't read

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0067 — Saved Agent settings are in a format this SMTO can't read

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0068 — SMTO's Fast Cache was set up with an unsupported size

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0068 — SMTO's Fast Cache was set up with an unsupported size

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0069 — The Gateway doesn't know your SMTO server's address

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0069 — The Gateway doesn't know your SMTO server's address

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0070 — A prompt or built-in instruction isn't in a form SMTO can use

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0070 — A prompt or built-in instruction isn't in a form SMTO can use

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0071 — SMTO couldn't find one of its built-in instructions
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a built-in instruction it gives the Agent behind the scenes and couldn't find it in its own files or saved copies, so the step that needed it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0071 — SMTO couldn't find one of its built-in instructions

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0072 — SMTO couldn't save a settings change
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save a settings change, such as a conversation's options, to a place it doesn't support, and stopped. Settings you saved earlier weren't deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0072 — SMTO couldn't save a settings change

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0073 — SMTO couldn't use your custom name and logo settings
documents.summary: SMTO's branding file, which sets the product name, tagline and logos, has a value SMTO can't safely show. SMTO kept using the previous or default name and logo instead.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0073 — SMTO couldn't use your custom name and logo settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0074 — The thinking target must be a whole number from 0 to 100

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0074 — The thinking target must be a whole number from 0 to 100

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0075 — A Redaction switch has a value that isn't simply on or off
documents.summary: Redaction hides passwords, tokens and similar secrets in logs, activity and other places SMTO shows them. One of its switches has a saved value that isn't plainly on or off, so SMTO stopped rather than guess.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0075 — A Redaction switch has a value that isn't simply on or off

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0076 — Task Contract size settings don't fit together
documents.summary: A Task Contract is the step-by-step brief SMTO writes from your request before the Agent starts. Its size, thinking and retry numbers don't fit within the allowed limits, so SMTO didn't accept them.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0076 — Task Contract size settings don't fit together

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0077 — SMTO can't use your automatic Skill selection settings

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0077 — SMTO can't use your automatic Skill selection settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0078 — A Skill set to Always isn't allowed for this request
documents.summary: A Skill or tool is set to Always, but this request's settings don't allow it, for example because it is set to Never somewhere else. SMTO stopped rather than quietly widening what the agent may use.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0078 — A Skill set to Always isn't allowed for this request

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0079 — SMTO's automatic Skill picker gave an unusable answer
documents.summary: The model that picks Skills for each request suggested one outside the allowed list. SMTO ignored it, and the request continues with only the Skills it was already allowed to use.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0079 — SMTO's automatic Skill picker gave an unusable answer

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0080 — SMTO can't resume this task's saved Skill settings

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0080 — SMTO can't resume this task's saved Skill settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0081 — SMTO couldn't pick Skills automatically for this request
