headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0081 — SMTO couldn't pick Skills automatically for this request

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0082 — SMTO couldn't find the Skill list saved for this Task
documents.summary: When a Task starts, SMTO saves a list of Skills it may add later. That list isn't available for this Task, so SMTO can't add more Skills to it. Nothing new was turned on.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0082 — SMTO couldn't find the Skill list saved for this Task

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0083 — SMTO's request to add Skills wasn't in a form it accepts
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent tried to add Skills to this Task in a way SMTO doesn't allow, such as asking for more than eight at once or mixing them with other lookups. Nothing was turned on or run.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0083 — SMTO's request to add Skills wasn't in a form it accepts

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0084 — SMTO asked to add a Skill that isn't installed
documents.summary: SMTO's Agent asked to turn on a Skill by a name this SMTO doesn't have. Nothing was turned on, and SMTO won't guess a similar Skill instead.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0084 — SMTO asked to add a Skill that isn't installed

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0085 — SMTO tried to add a built-in helper Skill on its own
documents.summary: Some Skills are built-in helpers that SMTO adds automatically with the Skills that need them. The Agent tried to turn one on by itself, which isn't allowed. Nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0085 — SMTO tried to add a built-in helper Skill on its own

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0086 — SMTO needs your OK before using this Skill
documents.summary: This Skill only turns on when you allow it. SMTO's Agent wants to use it, so SMTO is asking you first. Nothing has been done with the Skill yet.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0086 — SMTO needs your OK before using this Skill

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0087 — This Task isn't allowed to turn on that Skill
documents.summary: The Skill the Agent wanted is outside what this Task was allowed to use when it started. SMTO didn't turn it on, and the Task can only go on with the Skills it already has.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0087 — This Task isn't allowed to turn on that Skill

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0088 — SMTO can't turn on that Skill for this Task
documents.summary: The Agent wanted a Skill that can't be turned on in this Task, because of how the Task was started or because something the Skill needs isn't available. Nothing was turned on.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0088 — SMTO can't turn on that Skill for this Task

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0089 — SMTO couldn't save turning on a Skill, so it didn't use it
documents.summary: SMTO tried to turn on a Skill for this Task but couldn't confirm the change was saved. To stay safe, SMTO won't use a Skill until that change is saved.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0089 — SMTO couldn't save turning on a Skill, so it didn't use it

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0090 — SMTO needs your OK to turn on a Skill for this conversation

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0090 — SMTO needs your OK to turn on a Skill for this conversation

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0091 — This permission question is out of date

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0091 — This permission question is out of date

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0092 — SMTO couldn't tell whether you allowed the Skill

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0092 — SMTO couldn't tell whether you allowed the Skill

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0093 — Capability settings changed while permission was pending

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0093 — Capability settings changed while permission was pending

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0094 — SMTO couldn't save your Skill permission answer
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save your answer to a Skill permission question but couldn't confirm that it was saved. Until it is, the Skill settings you had before still apply.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0094 — SMTO couldn't save your Skill permission answer

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0095 — SMTO couldn't continue the task after your Skill answer
documents.summary: After you answered the Skill permission question, SMTO couldn't save the next step that carries the task on. The task may not have continued yet.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0095 — SMTO couldn't continue the task after your Skill answer

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0096 — A Skill is turned on but can't work yet
documents.summary: SMTO turned on a Skill for this task, but it still needs a sign-in, more setup, or a service or computer it depends on. Its tools can't be used until that is sorted out.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0096 — A Skill is turned on but can't work yet

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0097 — SMTO won't use this Skill for the current request
documents.summary: Earlier in this request, the Skill permission question was answered no, wasn't answered clearly, or clashed with changed settings. SMTO keeps that decision and carries on with the tools it is allowed to use.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0097 — SMTO won't use this Skill for the current request

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0098 — A question about this Skill is already waiting for you
documents.summary: SMTO already asked whether to allow this Skill for the current request. It won't ask a second time, and the task waits for your answer to the first question.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0098 — A question about this Skill is already waiting for you

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0099 — This request doesn't fit Plan mode
documents.summary: In Plan mode the Agent only looks around and asks questions, then writes one plan for you to approve. Something broke that rule, such as trying to make a change, so SMTO blocked it. Blocked changes didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0099 — This request doesn't fit Plan mode

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0100 — SMTO couldn't start work from this plan

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0100 — SMTO couldn't start work from this plan

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0101 — The Activity supervision timings don't fit together
documents.summary: SMTO checks on long-running work at set times. These timings are out of order, or a check interval is longer than the allowed maximum, so SMTO didn't accept them.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0101 — The Activity supervision timings don't fit together

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0102 — The Tool result preview sizes aren't valid
documents.summary: Tool result preview sets how many characters from the start and end of each tool's output the Agent sees. Both must be whole numbers, and at least one must be above zero.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0102 — The Tool result preview sizes aren't valid

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0103 — The SMTO website can't start with its current settings
documents.summary: The public SMTO website, which is separate from the SMTO app, has a setting it can't accept, such as an address that isn't a public https address. It didn't start, so visitors can't reach it yet.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0103 — The SMTO website can't start with its current settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0104 — Some SMTO website pages failed their publishing checks
documents.summary: A page, picture or link on the public SMTO website didn't pass the checks run before publishing, for example a broken link or a file that's missing or too large. The website can't start until it's fixed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0104 — Some SMTO website pages failed their publishing checks

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0105 — The website's download list has invalid version details
documents.summary: The list of SMTO versions offered for download has a mistake, such as a repeated version, a date without a time zone, or a test version marked as stable. The website shows downloads as unavailable until it's fixed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0105 — The website's download list has invalid version details

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0106 — An older SMTO rejected its memory limit settings
documents.summary: This message comes from an older SMTO version that had its own memory limit. Current SMTO has no such limit, so there is nothing to set. It doesn't tell you whether a later task worked.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0106 — An older SMTO rejected its memory limit settings

documents.title: SMTO-CFG-0107 — SMTO's settings file has a value it can't accept
documents.summary: SMTO read its startup settings, but one setting has the wrong kind of value or is out of range, such as text where a number belongs. SMTO stopped before opening your saved data, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CFG-0107 — SMTO's settings file has a value it can't accept

documents.title: SMTO-CMP-0001 — Answer preserved

headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0002 — Completion could not be verified

headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0010 — The AI's claimed result doesn't match what SMTO saw

headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0011 — This task has too many results for SMTO to check at once

headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0019 — The AI's "not finished" report included success details

documents.title: SMTO-CMP-0020 — SMTO couldn't confirm it saved what you asked it to remember

headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0020 — SMTO couldn't confirm it saved what you asked it to remember

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0026 — This part of an attached file is too large for the AI model
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0027 — An attached file is too large for the AI model to read in full
documents.summary: SMTO is set to give the AI model whole attached files at once. This file, plus everything the task already holds, is bigger than the model's space, so none of it was given to the model.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0027 — An attached file is too large for the AI model to read in full
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0028 — SMTO couldn't find an item in this Task's saved notes
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open a saved note, result or page from this Task, but it was not available. It may have changed, expired or been removed. This lookup changed nothing, and it doesn't mean earlier work failed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0028 — SMTO couldn't find an item in this Task's saved notes

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0029 — Your saved messages don't all fit in the model
documents.summary: You saved some messages to keep with this task. Together with the task's own instructions they're too long for the model, so SMTO stopped before sending anything. Your saved messages weren't cut or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0029 — Your saved messages don't all fit in the model
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0030 — A message you saved for this task is no longer available
documents.summary: One of the messages you saved to keep with this task can't be read anymore, for example because it was deleted. SMTO stopped before sending anything and did not bring back any deleted text.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0030 — A message you saved for this task is no longer available
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0031 — A saved result is too big to show the AI model in one piece
documents.summary: The task asked to look at part of a saved result, such as a command's output, but that part was too large for the AI model's remaining space. The saved result is still there, and nothing was run again.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0031 — A saved result is too big to show the AI model in one piece

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0032 — SMTO can't find a saved result for that reference
documents.summary: The task asked for a saved result using a name that doesn't match any result it is allowed to see. It may be from another task, already removed, or simply mistyped. Nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0032 — SMTO can't find a saved result for that reference

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0033 — That reference is a task note, not a saved result
documents.summary: The task tried to open one of its own notes as if it were the saved output of a command. SMTO pointed it to the right way to open notes. Nothing was run or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0033 — That reference is a task note, not a saved result

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0034 — This step has no saved result yet
documents.summary: The task asked for the result of one of its steps, but that step has no saved result yet. It may still be running, or it may have stopped without saving one. Nothing new was started.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0034 — This step has no saved result yet

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0035 — The task gave its notes tool a value it can't accept
documents.summary: While keeping its working notes, the task sent a value the notes tool doesn't accept, such as a name in the wrong form or text that is too long. The task is told which value to correct.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0035 — The task gave its notes tool a value it can't accept
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0036 — A task note changed before it could be updated
documents.summary: Something changed a task note or saved message after it was last read, so SMTO refused to save over it. This keeps the newer version from being lost. The change you or the task tried to make was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0036 — A task note changed before it could be updated
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0037 — The task lost its place while paging through notes or results
documents.summary: The task was reading a long list or document a page at a time, and the bookmark it used to find the next page no longer matches what is saved. Nothing was changed; the task needs to start that read again.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0037 — The task lost its place while paging through notes or results
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0038 — A task note or saved item is no longer available
documents.summary: The task, or a save you made, pointed to a note, message or source that is missing or can't be used here. It may have been removed or may belong to something else. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0038 — A task note or saved item is no longer available
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0039 — The task tried to use notes that belong to another task
documents.summary: Each task has its own working notes. This request either had no notes available to it or pointed at notes from a different task, so SMTO refused it. Nothing was read or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0039 — The task tried to use notes that belong to another task
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0040 — The task tried to update a summary of an earlier stage
documents.summary: Long tasks are split into stages, and each stage gets a short summary. The task tried to write a summary for a stage that has already closed, so SMTO refused. Earlier summaries stay as they were.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0040 — The task tried to update a summary of an earlier stage
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0041 — SMTO tried to read a group of notes or a non-text file as one page
documents.summary: While working on your Task, SMTO opened a group of saved notes, or a file that isn't plain text, as if it were one readable page. Nothing in your conversation was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0041 — SMTO tried to read a group of notes or a non-text file as one page
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0042 — SMTO asked for a part of a saved result that isn't there
documents.summary: SMTO looked inside a saved result from this Task for a specific piece, such as a command's output, and that piece doesn't exist in it. Nothing in your conversation was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0042 — SMTO asked for a part of a saved result that isn't there
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0043 — SMTO can't find that attached file in this task
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open a file it thought was attached, but that file isn't available to this task, for example it was removed or belongs to another conversation. This doesn't mean your upload is gone.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0043 — SMTO can't find that attached file in this task

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0044 — SMTO couldn't read its saved copy of your attached file
documents.summary: SMTO still has the record of your attached file, but it couldn't read the copy it saved when you uploaded it, for example because that stored copy was moved, deleted or can't be opened.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0044 — SMTO couldn't read its saved copy of your attached file

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0045 — SMTO's saved copy of an attached file or page image has changed
documents.summary: SMTO keeps a saved copy of each file you attach and each page image it makes. The copy it found no longer matches what it saved, so SMTO didn't use it.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0045 — SMTO's saved copy of an attached file or page image has changed

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0046 — SMTO couldn't read an attached file as text
documents.summary: SMTO tried to read an attached file as plain text, but the file isn't plain text in a format SMTO can read, for example it's a program or data file. SMTO didn't guess at its contents.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0046 — SMTO couldn't read an attached file as text

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0047 — This attached file needs its own reader, not plain text
documents.summary: SMTO tried to read a PDF, Office document, image or archive as plain text. Those files need a special reader, so SMTO stopped rather than read them wrongly.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0047 — This attached file needs its own reader, not plain text

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0048 — SMTO asked to open a file the wrong way
documents.summary: SMTO's assistant made a mistake in how it asked to open a file, for example pointing to the file in two ways at once. Nothing was opened or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0048 — SMTO asked to open a file the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0049 — SMTO couldn't copy your attached file to the Gateway
documents.summary: To work on your attached file, SMTO copies it to the Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run work on a computer). That copy failed. Your uploaded file is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0049 — SMTO couldn't copy your attached file to the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0050 — SMTO is missing the part it needs to read images
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't look at your image because a part it needs to open pictures isn't installed on the server. Your image is fine; the server's setup is incomplete.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0050 — SMTO is missing the part it needs to read images

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0051 — The image is too large for SMTO to look at in one go
documents.summary: SMTO can only look at about 4 MB of picture data at once. Your image, or the pages it tried to look at together, were bigger than that, so SMTO didn't look at them.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0051 — The image is too large for SMTO to look at in one go

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0052 — SMTO couldn't confirm where this image came from
documents.summary: SMTO only lets the model look at pictures it can trace back to a file you attached or a page or screen it captured itself. This picture had no such record, so the model has not looked at it.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0052 — SMTO couldn't confirm where this image came from

documents.title: SMTO-CTX-0053 — SMTO can't find that earlier request in this Code thread
documents.summary: The task tried to reopen an earlier message in this Code thread using a name that doesn't match any finished message it can see. Nothing was run or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-CTX-0053 — SMTO can't find that earlier request in this Code thread

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0001 — SMTO's database feature is missing a part it needs
documents.summary: SMTO can't work with databases right now because a piece of software it needs isn't installed correctly on the computer running SMTO. Nothing was sent to your database.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0001 — SMTO's database feature is missing a part it needs

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0002 — SMTO can't use the saved database connection it was given
documents.summary: SMTO was pointed at a saved entry that doesn't look like a complete database connection, or its saved link to that connection is out of date. No query was run.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0002 — SMTO can't use the saved database connection it was given

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0003 — SMTO's database tool only works with PostgreSQL databases
documents.summary: The database SMTO was asked to use looks like a kind other than PostgreSQL, and SMTO's built-in database tool can only talk to PostgreSQL. No query was run.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0003 — SMTO's database tool only works with PostgreSQL databases

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0004 — Database access is turned off in this SMTO
documents.summary: Whoever set up this SMTO has switched off its database feature, so SMTO won't connect to any database. Nothing was sent to your database.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0004 — Database access is turned off in this SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0005 — SMTO needs your approval before it changes your database
documents.summary: SMTO wanted to run a database command that changes data or isn't a plain read, and it didn't have your approval to do that. Nothing in your database was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0005 — SMTO needs your approval before it changes your database

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0006 — SMTO couldn't understand the database query
documents.summary: The database query was empty, had a mistake in how it was written, or contained more than one query at once. SMTO stopped before sending it, so nothing was run on your database.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0006 — SMTO couldn't understand the database query

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0007 — The database sign-in details weren't in a form SMTO accepts
documents.summary: SMTO was given database sign-in details that were incomplete or in the wrong form. It only accepts a user name and a password, written as plain text. Nothing was sent to your database.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0007 — The database sign-in details weren't in a form SMTO accepts

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0008 — The database query names a table or column SMTO can't find
documents.summary: The query asks for a table or column that isn't in SMTO's list of what this database contains. The name may be wrong, or the database may have changed since SMTO last looked. No query was run.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0008 — The database query names a table or column SMTO can't find

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0009 — The database query must say how many rows it may return
documents.summary: SMTO only runs database reads that set a maximum number of rows, up to a fixed limit for this SMTO. This query had no maximum, or asked for more rows than allowed. No query was run.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0009 — The database query must say how many rows it may return

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0010 — The database reported an error while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: The database program SMTO uses reported a problem, such as being unable to connect, wrong sign-in details, missing permission, or a mistake in the query. If SMTO was changing data, part of that change may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0010 — The database reported an error while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0011 — The saved database connection is missing its address
documents.summary: The saved database entry SMTO picked doesn't include the full address of the database: its host, port or database name is empty. Nothing was sent to your database.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0011 — The saved database connection is missing its address

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0012 — The database search didn't say what kind of database it is
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server, but the request didn't say what kind of database server it is. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0012 — The database search didn't say what kind of database it is

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0013 — SMTO can only search PostgreSQL servers for databases
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server of a type it can't search. This search only works with PostgreSQL servers. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0013 — SMTO can only search PostgreSQL servers for databases

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0014 — The database server address is missing or written wrongly
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server, but the server's address was empty or contained characters an address can't have. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0014 — The database server address is missing or written wrongly

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0015 — The database server's port number isn't valid
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server, but the port, the number that tells SMTO which door on the server to use, was missing or not a valid number. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0015 — The database server's port number isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0016 — The database search is missing a user name or password
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server, but it wasn't given both a user name and a password to sign in. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0016 — The database search is missing a user name or password

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0017 — The database connection's encryption setting isn't recognized
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to find the databases on a server, but the setting that controls how the connection is encrypted (sslmode) had a value SMTO doesn't recognize. SMTO didn't connect to anything.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0017 — The database connection's encryption setting isn't recognized

documents.title: SMTO-DB-0018 — SMTO couldn't finish finding your databases
documents.summary: SMTO tried to list the databases on your PostgreSQL database server but stopped without a usable list. Nothing was added to or changed in Parameter Store.

headings.title: SMTO-DB-0018 — SMTO couldn't finish finding your databases

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0001 — SMTO couldn't get your email ready to send
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while preparing your email because something in the message or its saved sender settings didn't pass its checks. This older message doesn't say which part, and it can't confirm whether anything was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0001 — SMTO couldn't get your email ready to send

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0002 — SMTO couldn't reach a Gateway that can send email
documents.summary: SMTO sends email through a Gateway, the helper program it uses to run work on a computer. The Gateway was unreachable or too old to handle email, so the email step stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0002 — SMTO couldn't reach a Gateway that can send email

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0003 — SMTO won't send your email sign-in over an unprotected link
documents.summary: Your email account's sign-in details may only travel over an encrypted, verified connection, and one of the connections SMTO would use isn't protected. SMTO stopped before sending your sign-in or any email.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0003 — SMTO won't send your email sign-in over an unprotected link

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0004 — SMTO couldn't open a secure connection to your mail server
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open an encrypted connection to your mail server, but the server didn't offer one or its security certificate couldn't be trusted. SMTO stopped before sending, so no email went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0004 — SMTO couldn't open a secure connection to your mail server

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0005 — Your mail server didn't accept SMTO's sign-in
documents.summary: SMTO reached your mail server, but the server refused the email account's sign-in, or SMTO had no sign-in details to offer. No email was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0005 — Your mail server didn't accept SMTO's sign-in

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0006 — SMTO couldn't connect to your mail server
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach your mail server, or the server hung up during the opening exchange. This happened before your message was handed over, so no email went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0006 — SMTO couldn't connect to your mail server

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0007 — Your email's recipients or sender address weren't accepted
documents.summary: Either the email had no recipients or too many, or the mail server refused the sender address or every recipient. The message was not sent to anyone.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0007 — Your email's recipients or sender address weren't accepted

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0008 — Your mail server refused to accept the message
documents.summary: The mail server accepted the recipients but then refused the message itself, for example because of its content, size or a sending limit. The server did not accept it for delivery.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0008 — Your mail server refused to accept the message

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0009 — SMTO couldn't use a file you asked it to attach
documents.summary: One of the attachments isn't a file SMTO may use in this conversation, no longer exists, or has a name or file type SMTO can't use. The email wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0009 — SMTO couldn't use a file you asked it to attach

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0010 — SMTO couldn't hand your email over to the Gateway
documents.summary: Before sending, SMTO copies the finished email to the Gateway in pieces. That copy didn't arrive complete or in time, so the Gateway refused it before contacting the mail server. No email went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0010 — SMTO couldn't hand your email over to the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0011 — Your email is too large to send
documents.summary: The email, including its attachments, is bigger than SMTO or your mail server allows. SMTO stopped before sending it, so nothing went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0011 — Your email is too large to send

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0012 — Your mail server can't handle an address with special letters
documents.summary: An email address in this message uses accented or non-English letters before the @ sign, and your mail server doesn't support those. SMTO stopped before sending, so nothing went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0012 — Your mail server can't handle an address with special letters

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0013 — SMTO needs your approval before sending this email
documents.summary: SMTO only sends an email after someone approves that exact message, and this send arrived without an approval. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0013 — SMTO needs your approval before sending this email

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0014 — Your email was stopped before it was sent
documents.summary: The email step was cancelled, for example because the task was stopped, before SMTO handed the message content to the mail server. The email was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0014 — Your email was stopped before it was sent

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0015 — SMTO can't tell whether your email was sent
documents.summary: Your message was handed to the mail server, but SMTO never got a clear answer back. The email may already have been delivered, so SMTO won't send it again on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0015 — SMTO can't tell whether your email was sent

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0016 — Your email has no message text
documents.summary: The email didn't include any message text, only blanks or nothing at all, so SMTO stopped before preparing it. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0016 — Your email has no message text
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0017 — Your email's message text is too long or not plain text
documents.summary: The message text is longer than SMTO allows (about one million characters) or wasn't given as ordinary text. SMTO stopped before sending, so nothing went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0017 — Your email's message text is too long or not plain text
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0018 — One of the email addresses isn't valid
documents.summary: An address in the To, Cc or Bcc list isn't written as a complete email address, so SMTO stopped before sending. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0018 — One of the email addresses isn't valid
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0019 — Your email's subject or file name can't be used
documents.summary: The subject line or an attachment's file name has a hidden character, such as a line break, or is too long. SMTO stopped before sending, so nothing went out.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0019 — Your email's subject or file name can't be used
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0020 — SMTO can't find the email sender you picked
documents.summary: SMTO looked for the saved email sender (the account it sends mail from), but nothing is saved under that name. No email was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0020 — SMTO can't find the email sender you picked
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0021 — Your saved email sender has a setting SMTO can't use
documents.summary: One detail saved for this email sender, such as the server name, port or From address, isn't in a form SMTO accepts. Nothing was sent, and your password was never tried.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0021 — Your saved email sender has a setting SMTO can't use
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0022 — The email sender changed while this email was being prepared
documents.summary: The saved sender for this email was edited or deleted after SMTO prepared the message, so SMTO stopped rather than send with different settings. This email was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0022 — The email sender changed while this email was being prepared
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0023 — Your email sender's security certificate can't be loaded
documents.summary: This sender is set to check the mail server with a certificate you supplied, but that certificate is missing or damaged. SMTO stopped before connecting, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0023 — Your email sender's security certificate can't be loaded
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0024 — SMTO couldn't get ready to send this email
documents.summary: Something SMTO needs before sending email wasn't available, such as its store of saved settings or a Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to work on a computer). Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0024 — SMTO couldn't get ready to send this email
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0025 — SMTO can't find the sign-in setup for this email sender
documents.summary: This sender signs in through your email provider's approval screen (OAuth), but a saved sign-in entry it relies on is missing. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0025 — SMTO can't find the sign-in setup for this email sender
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0026 — This email sender's sign-in setup has the wrong kind of entry
documents.summary: The saved sign-in entries this sender points to exist, but one is the wrong kind of entry or has settings SMTO can't accept. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0026 — This email sender's sign-in setup has the wrong kind of entry
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0027 — SMTO stopped an email that didn't match its approved details
documents.summary: Just before sending, SMTO found that the prepared email's sender or header lines didn't match what was checked. It stopped before contacting the mail server, so this email was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0027 — SMTO stopped an email that didn't match its approved details
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0028 — Your email provider rejected the sign-in for this sender
documents.summary: The mail server said the username and password, or sign-in approval, saved for this sender isn't accepted. No email was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0028 — Your email provider rejected the sign-in for this sender
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0029 — Your email provider's sign-in service is temporarily down
documents.summary: The mail server said it couldn't check the sign-in right now because of a temporary problem on its side. Your password wasn't rejected, and no email was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0029 — Your email provider's sign-in service is temporarily down
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0030 — The mail server doesn't allow this sender's sign-in method
documents.summary: The mail server doesn't offer, or doesn't permit, the sign-in method this sender uses. No email was sent, and this doesn't mean your password is wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0030 — The mail server doesn't allow this sender's sign-in method
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EML-0031 — The mail server refused the sign-in without saying why
documents.summary: The mail server stopped the sign-in, but its reply doesn't say your password is wrong or explain the reason. SMTO stopped before sending this email.

headings.title: SMTO-EML-0031 — The mail server refused the sign-in without saying why
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0001 — This schedule is already running
documents.summary: You asked a schedule to run now, but its previous run hasn't finished, so SMTO didn't start a second one. The run already in progress was not stopped or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EVT-0001 — This schedule is already running

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0002 — Agent events are disabled
documents.summary: Schedules and reminders are switched off on this SMTO, so it can't create, change or run them, or show their past runs. Turning this off doesn't delete schedules you already saved.

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0003 — SMTO can't find that schedule or run
documents.summary: The schedule or run you chose no longer exists here. It may have been deleted, or the page was showing an out-of-date list. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EVT-0003 — SMTO can't find that schedule or run

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0004 — SMTO didn't recognize that notification status
documents.summary: A request asked to show or change notifications using a status SMTO doesn't support. Nothing was changed. This usually comes from an outdated page or a script, not from something you typed.

headings.title: SMTO-EVT-0004 — SMTO didn't recognize that notification status

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0005 — That notification is no longer available
documents.summary: The notification you tried to mark or dismiss isn't saved anymore, so SMTO couldn't change it. The task or schedule it was about is not affected.

headings.title: SMTO-EVT-0005 — That notification is no longer available

documents.title: SMTO-EVT-0006 — SMTO couldn't set up this monitor
documents.summary: A monitor (a repeated check SMTO runs on a Gateway) needs a command to run, or a description clear enough to turn into one. This request had neither, or asked for an unknown monitor status. Nothing was created. This usually comes from a script or another tool.

headings.title: SMTO-EVT-0006 — SMTO couldn't set up this monitor

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0001 — An earlier job is still holding what this step needs
documents.summary: SMTO didn't run this step because an earlier job is still using the same thing, or stopped without SMTO knowing what it finished. Your new step hasn't started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0001 — An earlier job is still holding what this step needs
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0002 — Privileged environment unsupported
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to run a command with administrator rights along with extra custom settings, and it only allows its own built-in settings for such commands. The command did not run.

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0003 — SMTO needs to check an earlier step before going further
documents.summary: An earlier step in this task was interrupted while it was changing something, so SMTO doesn't know if it finished. SMTO won't make more changes, or say the task is done, until that's checked.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0003 — SMTO needs to check an earlier step before going further
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
documents.summary: SMTO started an action but lost contact before it heard back, so it can't tell whether the action happened. The screen shows an error, but the change may still have been made.

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0005 — A command ran too long and SMTO stopped it
documents.summary: A command in your task hit the time limit for commands that run while you wait, so SMTO stopped it. Anything it changed before it was stopped may still be in place.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0005 — A command ran too long and SMTO stopped it
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0006 — Invalid working directory
documents.summary: SMTO tried to run a command inside a folder that doesn't exist, or isn't a folder, on the chosen computer. The command never started, so nothing was changed.

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0007 — SMTO couldn't start the command
documents.summary: The command never began running, so it made no changes. Usually the computer that runs commands isn't connected or set up, or that computer refused to start the program.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0007 — SMTO couldn't start the command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0008 — You stopped this task
documents.summary: SMTO stopped the task because Stop was selected. Steps that finished before that stay done; stopping doesn't undo them.

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0009 — SMTO can't run this command with administrator rights here
documents.summary: The command needed administrator (sudo) rights, but the chosen computer, or the way the command was set to run, doesn't allow that. The command didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0009 — SMTO can't run this command with administrator rights here

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0010 — SMTO couldn't safely run this administrator command
documents.summary: The command asked for administrator (sudo) rights in a form SMTO can't check safely, such as sudo tucked inside a longer command. It was refused before running, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0010 — SMTO couldn't safely run this administrator command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0011 — SMTO lost track of an earlier result this step needed
documents.summary: This step was set to reuse a result from an earlier step in the task, but SMTO couldn't find that saved result to check it. The step didn't run, so it changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0011 — SMTO lost track of an earlier result this step needed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0012 — The Python code for this step wasn't in the required form
documents.summary: SMTO wrote a small Python program for this step, but it wasn't laid out the way SMTO requires, so it was refused. No Python ran and nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0012 — The Python code for this step wasn't in the required form

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0013 — SMTO didn't repeat commands that already ran
documents.summary: Some commands in a series already ran earlier in this task. SMTO refused to run the whole series again from the start so those finished commands aren't done twice.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0013 — SMTO didn't repeat commands that already ran
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0014 — The blocking job changed before your choice was saved
documents.summary: While you were deciding what to do about a job that was blocking your task, that job's situation changed. SMTO didn't apply your choice, and your blocked command still hasn't started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0014 — The blocking job changed before your choice was saved

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0015 — SMTO couldn't bring back the step that was blocked
documents.summary: Your task was waiting for another job to let go of something it needed. SMTO couldn't restore the waiting step to run it, and it has not rerun anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0015 — SMTO couldn't bring back the step that was blocked

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0016 — SMTO didn't recognize that recovery choice
documents.summary: The choice sent to deal with a blocking job isn't one the Gateway accepts, so nothing was done. Your blocked command still hasn't started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0016 — SMTO didn't recognize that recovery choice

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0017 — Your recovery choice no longer matches the blocked step
documents.summary: Your choice was meant for a blocked command that SMTO can no longer match up. That command may already have been cancelled or started, or the blocking job is gone. Your choice wasn't applied.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0017 — Your recovery choice no longer matches the blocked step

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0018 — That recovery choice isn't available right now
documents.summary: The choice you made for the blocking job isn't allowed in its current state, for example because it can't safely be ended yet. Nothing was done, and your blocked command still hasn't started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0018 — That recovery choice isn't available right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0019 — SMTO blocked a step that clashed with an earlier one
documents.summary: SMTO's model sent a new step labeled the same as an earlier step but with different details. SMTO refused the new step, and the earlier step and its result are kept as they were.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0019 — SMTO blocked a step that clashed with an earlier one
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0020 — SMTO is trying a saved, proven way to do this first
documents.summary: SMTO has a saved procedure that already worked for this kind of request, so it held back a web search to try that first. This is only a notice; it doesn't mean the work already ran.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0020 — SMTO is trying a saved, proven way to do this first

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0021 — SMTO saved your choice to continue from how things are now
documents.summary: You chose to accept things as they are now after an earlier job blocked your task. SMTO recorded that choice so the task can go on. The earlier job's history is kept unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0021 — SMTO saved your choice to continue from how things are now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0022 — The Python code for this step has a mistake
documents.summary: The Python code for this step couldn't be read because of a writing mistake, such as a missing bracket. It was refused before running, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0022 — The Python code for this step has a mistake

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0023 — SMTO couldn't show or update Fast Cache
documents.summary: Something went wrong inside SMTO while it was showing or changing your saved Fast Cache procedures, so your change may not have gone through. Normal tasks still run as usual.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0023 — SMTO couldn't show or update Fast Cache

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0024 — This prompt can't be saved to Fast Cache
documents.summary: SMTO checked this task and found it isn't safe to save for reuse, for example because it changed things, a step failed, or it relied on web results. Nothing was saved, and the original task is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0024 — This prompt can't be saved to Fast Cache

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0025 — A command failed without saying why
documents.summary: A step in your task reported that it failed, but it gave no clear reason. It may have done part of its work before it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0025 — A command failed without saying why

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0026 — SMTO needs your choice before it can continue this task
documents.summary: An earlier job that was using the same files or resources has ended, but SMTO can't tell what it finished. Your next command has not started yet.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0026 — SMTO needs your choice before it can continue this task

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0027 — Another job is still using what this task needs
documents.summary: Your task is waiting because another job is still running, or may still be running, on the same files or resources. Your next command has not started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0027 — Another job is still using what this task needs

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0028 — SMTO couldn't find a value where it was told to look
documents.summary: SMTO tried to pick out one value from a saved result or a sign-in reply, but the location it was given doesn't exist there. The step that needed that value didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0028 — SMTO couldn't find a value where it was told to look

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0029 — SMTO couldn't open the folder for this command
documents.summary: SMTO tried to run a command inside a folder, but couldn't open that folder on the computer. The command did not run, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0029 — SMTO couldn't open the folder for this command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0030 — There was no command to run
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to run a command, but the command text was empty. Nothing was run and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0030 — There was no command to run

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0031 — SMTO gave one input two different values
documents.summary: SMTO planned a step that fills the same input from two different earlier results, so it couldn't tell which one to use. The step did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0031 — SMTO gave one input two different values

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0032 — A step needs a result that isn't ready yet
documents.summary: SMTO tried to use the answer from an earlier step before that step had finished, or tried to chain results inside one combined command. The waiting step did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0032 — A step needs a result that isn't ready yet

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0033 — SMTO couldn't finish working through your data
documents.summary: SMTO tried to sort, count or reshape some data, but that calculation crashed or ran out of time or memory. Earlier results are still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0033 — SMTO couldn't finish working through your data

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0034 — SMTO's data step tried to use a tool it isn't allowed
documents.summary: SMTO's quick data calculation tried to use something beyond simple data handling, such as files or the internet. For safety, that kind of step can only work with data. Nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0034 — SMTO's data step tried to use a tool it isn't allowed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0035 — SMTO passed information to a command the wrong way
documents.summary: SMTO tried to hand some information to a command, but it labeled or attached that information in a way commands can't accept. The command did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0035 — SMTO passed information to a command the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0036 — Too much text was sent into one command
documents.summary: SMTO tried to feed more than about 1 MB of text straight into a command, which is over its limit. The command did not run and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0036 — Too much text was sent into one command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0037 — SMTO couldn't understand an option in this command
documents.summary: The command used an unusual setting before its main action, so SMTO couldn't work out what the command would change. SMTO treats it as unknown and may refuse it or ask you first.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0037 — SMTO couldn't understand an option in this command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0038 — The terminal is already busy with another command
documents.summary: SMTO wanted to start a new command in a terminal that is still running an earlier command it is watching. The new command was not started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0038 — The terminal is already busy with another command

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0039 — SMTO couldn't tell how a command ended
documents.summary: The computer that ran a command sent back a report about it that didn't make sense. SMTO can't tell whether the command ran or what it changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0039 — SMTO couldn't tell how a command ended

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0040 — A command is waiting for someone to type an answer
documents.summary: A command stopped to ask a question, such as a password or a yes/no prompt, and nobody could answer it there. The command may have started before it asked.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0040 — A command is waiting for someone to type an answer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0041 — The result of a data step was too large to return
documents.summary: SMTO's data calculation finished, but its answer was bigger than about 1 MB, so SMTO couldn't take it back. Nothing was cut off or changed, and earlier results are still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0041 — The result of a data step was too large to return

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0042 — SMTO won't repeat a step that already failed twice
documents.summary: The same action has already failed twice, and nothing has changed since. SMTO didn't try it a third time, so nothing new was run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0042 — SMTO won't repeat a step that already failed twice

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0043 — SMTO didn't get any result back from an action
documents.summary: SMTO started an action but got nothing back, not even an error. It can't tell whether the action happened or what it changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0043 — SMTO didn't get any result back from an action

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0044 — The forced reset wasn't confirmed, so nothing was done
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to end a blocking job by force, but the request didn't include your confirmation. The job was not ended and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0044 — The forced reset wasn't confirmed, so nothing was done

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0045 — An earlier job may still be using what this task needs
documents.summary: SMTO paused this task because an earlier job may still be working on the same thing, and SMTO can't tell whether it has stopped. Your new command did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0045 — An earlier job may still be using what this task needs

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0046 — SMTO doesn't know what an earlier job changed
documents.summary: An earlier job that worked on the same thing has finished, but SMTO can't tell everything it changed. To be safe, your new command was held back and did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0046 — SMTO doesn't know what an earlier job changed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0047 — SMTO can't safely release the earlier job right now
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to forcefully release an earlier job, but that job is in a state where releasing it isn't safe. SMTO kept the earlier job's hold in place, so the waiting command hasn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0047 — SMTO can't safely release the earlier job right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0048 — SMTO couldn't confirm the earlier job has stopped
documents.summary: SMTO tried to stop an earlier job that was in the way, but it couldn't confirm the job really ended. SMTO keeps treating it as possibly running, and your command still hasn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0048 — SMTO couldn't confirm the earlier job has stopped

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0049 — SMTO can't find a USB or external drive to save to
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to save to a USB or external drive, but it couldn't find one that is plugged in and ready on the computer doing the work. Nothing was written.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0049 — SMTO can't find a USB or external drive to save to

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0050 — SMTO couldn't start this group of commands
documents.summary: SMTO planned to run several commands in a row, but one of them didn't pass its checks, so none of them were started. Nothing on the computer was changed by this group.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0050 — SMTO couldn't start this group of commands

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0051 — No one is signed in at the computer's screen for SMTO to use
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a signed-in desktop on the Gateway computer, so it can't see or work with the windows and apps there. Nothing on that computer was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0051 — No one is signed in at the computer's screen for SMTO to use

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0052 — SMTO can't do that desktop action on this computer right now
documents.summary: The Gateway computer either doesn't support this kind of window or app action, or is already busy with as many desktop actions as it allows. This doesn't always mean something is missing.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0052 — SMTO can't do that desktop action on this computer right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0053 — The computer didn't let SMTO control that app or window
documents.summary: The operating system on the Gateway computer refused SMTO's request to see or control an app or window. On a Mac this usually means the Gateway lacks Accessibility permission. Part of the action may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0053 — The computer didn't let SMTO control that app or window

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0054 — SMTO couldn't find that app on the computer
documents.summary: SMTO looked for the app you asked it to open on the Gateway computer but couldn't find it there, so nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0054 — SMTO couldn't find that app on the computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0055 — The computer refused to start that app
documents.summary: SMTO found the app on the Gateway computer, but the computer wouldn't start it. The file may not be a program that can run, or the system blocked it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0055 — The computer refused to start that app

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0056 — The window SMTO was about to use has changed or closed
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to act on a window it had seen earlier, but that window has closed, changed, or was seen before the Gateway restarted. SMTO stopped instead of guessing which window you meant.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0056 — The window SMTO was about to use has changed or closed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0057 — The program SMTO was about to use has closed or restarted
documents.summary: The program SMTO was asked to work with has closed or restarted since SMTO last looked, so SMTO stopped rather than risk acting on the wrong program.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0057 — The program SMTO was about to use has closed or restarted

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0058 — SMTO won't close that program because it's protected
documents.summary: The program you asked SMTO to close or stop belongs to the system, to SMTO or its Gateway, or to another user, so SMTO refused. Nothing was closed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0058 — SMTO won't close that program because it's protected

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0059 — The computer didn't let SMTO see or stop that program
documents.summary: The operating system on the Gateway computer refused SMTO access to that program, usually because it belongs to another user or runs with administrator rights. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0059 — The computer didn't let SMTO see or stop that program

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0060 — The computer didn't bring that window to the front
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway computer to switch to a window, but the computer refused or the window didn't end up in front. The window may still have changed partly, for example by being restored.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0060 — The computer didn't bring that window to the front

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0061 — SMTO can't move or resize the window to that spot
documents.summary: The position or size asked for would put the window off every screen, or the window is in full-screen mode, which can't be moved or resized. The window was left as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0061 — SMTO can't move or resize the window to that spot

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0062 — The window SMTO was waiting for didn't appear in time
documents.summary: SMTO waited for a window to show up on the Gateway computer, but none matching what it was looking for appeared before time ran out. The app may still be opening.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0062 — The window SMTO was waiting for didn't appear in time

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0063 — SMTO's request on the Gateway computer's desktop was stopped
documents.summary: A request to work with apps or windows on the Gateway computer was stopped, either because the task was cancelled or because the same request had already been sent. An earlier copy of it may already have done the work.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0063 — SMTO's request on the Gateway computer's desktop was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0064 — SMTO lost contact with the Gateway computer during a desktop task
documents.summary: SMTO asked another computer to work with its apps or windows, but got no usable answer from the Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses on that computer. SMTO uses this message when it was only looking or hadn't started a change.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0064 — SMTO lost contact with the Gateway computer during a desktop task

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0065 — SMTO can't tell if its change on the Gateway computer happened
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open, close, quit or move something on the Gateway computer, but lost the answer before it could confirm the result. The change may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0065 — SMTO can't tell if its change on the Gateway computer happened

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0066 — SMTO couldn't carry out that desktop request as asked
documents.summary: SMTO tried to work with apps or windows on the Gateway computer, but the request had missing or wrong details, or asked for something the Desktop skill doesn't allow. Nothing was done.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0066 — SMTO couldn't carry out that desktop request as asked

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0067 — SMTO can't reach the clipboard on the Gateway computer
documents.summary: Copy and paste belong to a signed-in desktop. The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses on that computer, isn't running inside a signed-in desktop, so SMTO can't use its clipboard. The clipboard wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0067 — SMTO can't reach the clipboard on the Gateway computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0068 — The clipboard tools on the Gateway computer aren't working
documents.summary: SMTO reached the Gateway computer, but the program it uses there to copy and paste is missing or stopped working. The copy or paste didn't finish.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0068 — The clipboard tools on the Gateway computer aren't working

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0069 — The clipboard on the Gateway computer is busy
documents.summary: Another program on the Gateway computer was holding the clipboard, or SMTO already had many clipboard steps running, so this copy or paste didn't happen.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0069 — The clipboard on the Gateway computer is busy

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0070 — The Gateway can't handle that kind of clipboard content
documents.summary: SMTO asked to copy or paste a kind of content, text, files or an image, that the Gateway computer's clipboard can't handle right now, or the copied text couldn't be read. The clipboard wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0070 — The Gateway can't handle that kind of clipboard content

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0071 — The clipboard doesn't contain what SMTO asked for
documents.summary: SMTO looked for text, files or an image on the Gateway computer's clipboard, but that kind of content wasn't there. The clipboard may be empty or hold something else.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0071 — The clipboard doesn't contain what SMTO asked for

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0072 — The clipboard changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: Something new was copied on the Gateway computer between SMTO checking the clipboard and using it, so SMTO stopped rather than use or replace the wrong content. SMTO didn't change the clipboard.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0072 — The clipboard changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0073 — The clipboard content is too large for SMTO
documents.summary: The text, list of files or image was bigger than SMTO can copy or paste through the Gateway computer's clipboard, so SMTO stopped that step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0073 — The clipboard content is too large for SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0074 — SMTO couldn't use that file location for the clipboard
documents.summary: To copy files to the Gateway computer's clipboard, SMTO needs the full location of files that already exist on that computer. The location was incomplete, on a network drive, a web link, or the file wasn't there.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0074 — SMTO couldn't use that file location for the clipboard

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0075 — SMTO couldn't process the clipboard image
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't read or prepare the image for the Gateway computer's clipboard. Either image support isn't installed there, or the image isn't a normal PNG, JPEG, BMP or TIFF picture. The clipboard wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0075 — SMTO couldn't process the clipboard image

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0076 — SMTO couldn't save the clipboard picture as a file
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save the picture on the clipboard as an image file for this Task, but couldn't store it. Your clipboard wasn't changed and no partial image file was kept.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0076 — SMTO couldn't save the clipboard picture as a file

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0077 — The computer blocked SMTO from using its clipboard
documents.summary: The operating system on the Gateway computer refused SMTO access to the clipboard, or to a file it was asked to copy. The clipboard was left as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0077 — The computer blocked SMTO from using its clipboard

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0078 — SMTO lost contact with the computer whose clipboard it was using
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't get a usable answer from the Gateway, the helper program on that computer, while working with its clipboard or while cancelling that work.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0078 — SMTO lost contact with the computer whose clipboard it was using

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0079 — SMTO can't tell whether your clipboard was changed
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway computer to copy something to its clipboard, or to clear it, but lost the answer partway through. The clipboard may or may not have changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0079 — SMTO can't tell whether your clipboard was changed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0080 — SMTO sent a clipboard request the computer couldn't accept
documents.summary: The clipboard request was rejected before the clipboard was touched, because something in it wasn't in a form the Gateway accepts, such as hidden control characters in the text.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0080 — SMTO sent a clipboard request the computer couldn't accept

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0081 — The computer sent back a clipboard answer SMTO couldn't trust
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway to read its clipboard, but the answer that came back was damaged, too large or incomplete, so SMTO ignored it. Reading never changes the clipboard.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0081 — The computer sent back a clipboard answer SMTO couldn't trust

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0082 — The clipboard action was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The clipboard action was cancelled, for example because the Task was stopped. SMTO halted before changing the clipboard.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0082 — The clipboard action was stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0083 — This clipboard action was already sent or cancelled
documents.summary: The Gateway had already received this exact clipboard request, or cancelled it, within the last few minutes, so it refused to run it a second time.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0083 — This clipboard action was already sent or cancelled

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0084 — The clipboard action took too long and was stopped
documents.summary: The Gateway computer didn't finish the clipboard step within its 5-second limit, so SMTO gave up before changing the clipboard.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0084 — The clipboard action took too long and was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0085 — SMTO can't see a desktop on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO tried to look at the screen of the computer it works on, but the Gateway there isn't running inside a signed-in desktop. Nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0085 — SMTO can't see a desktop on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0086 — The computer didn't let SMTO take a screenshot
documents.summary: SMTO asked the computer for a picture of its screen, but the system refused or sent back nothing. No screenshot was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0086 — The computer didn't let SMTO take a screenshot

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0087 — The screen SMTO wanted to capture is no longer connected
documents.summary: SMTO tried to capture a specific screen, but that screen is no longer connected or has changed since SMTO last looked. Nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0087 — The screen SMTO wanted to capture is no longer connected

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0088 — The window SMTO wanted to capture is closed or hidden
documents.summary: SMTO tried to capture a window that is closed, minimized or hidden, or there was no window in front to look at. Nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0088 — The window SMTO wanted to capture is closed or hidden

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0089 — The area SMTO tried to capture doesn't fit on one screen
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to capture an area that goes past the edge of a screen, or a window that stretches across two monitors. SMTO only captures areas that sit fully on one screen, so nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0089 — The area SMTO tried to capture doesn't fit on one screen

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0090 — SMTO's screen tools aren't working on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use its screen tools on the computer the Gateway runs on. That computer may be missing a part SMTO needs, or use a system SMTO doesn't support for screenshots. Nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0090 — SMTO's screen tools aren't working on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0091 — SMTO can't capture the screen in this Linux desktop mode
documents.summary: The Linux computer running the Gateway uses Wayland, a desktop mode that SMTO's screenshots don't support yet. SMTO doesn't try to get around Wayland's screen protection, so nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0091 — SMTO can't capture the screen in this Linux desktop mode

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0092 — The screenshot or image is too big for SMTO
documents.summary: The screen area or image SMTO was asked to use is larger than SMTO allows, and SMTO never shrinks pictures on its own. It stopped, so nothing was captured or read.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0092 — The screenshot or image is too big for SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0093 — SMTO can only save screenshots as PNG or JPEG
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to save a screenshot as a file type it doesn't make. It only makes PNG or JPEG pictures, so nothing was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0093 — SMTO can only save screenshots as PNG or JPEG

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0094 — SMTO can't read text on that computer
documents.summary: Reading text from a screenshot or image needs a text-reading program called Tesseract on the Gateway's computer. It's missing there, or it doesn't have the language you asked for. Taking screenshots still works.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0094 — SMTO can't read text on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0095 — SMTO couldn't read text from this image
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use the image or settings it was given for reading text, or the text-reading program sent back results that didn't make sense. No text was returned.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0095 — SMTO couldn't read text from this image

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0096 — Reading the text took too long or produced too much
documents.summary: SMTO gives text reading a short time limit (about ten seconds for screen text) and a size limit. This screen or image had too much to read, so SMTO stopped. No text was returned.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0096 — Reading the text took too long or produced too much

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0097 — SMTO couldn't save the screenshot
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't store the screenshot with the task's files on the Gateway's computer, so it threw the picture away. This usually means the disk there is full or can't be written to.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0097 — SMTO couldn't save the screenshot

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0098 — SMTO lost contact with the computer it was looking at
documents.summary: SMTO sent a screen request to the Gateway but didn't get a usable answer back. No screenshot was confirmed, and SMTO won't repeat the request on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0098 — SMTO lost contact with the computer it was looking at

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0099 — SMTO's screen request had a setting that isn't allowed
documents.summary: SMTO's request to the screen tool included something that isn't allowed, such as an unknown action or an invalid position or size. It was refused before anything was captured.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0099 — SMTO's screen request had a setting that isn't allowed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0100 — The computer sent back a screen result SMTO couldn't trust
documents.summary: The Gateway answered SMTO's screen request, but the answer was incomplete or didn't match what was asked, for example the picture was the wrong size. SMTO threw the answer away.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0100 — The computer sent back a screen result SMTO couldn't trust

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0101 — The screen capture was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: SMTO stopped looking at the computer's screen before it finished, usually because the task was stopped. No screenshot or screen text from this attempt was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0101 — The screen capture was stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0102 — SMTO didn't repeat a screen request it already handled
documents.summary: The Gateway received a screen request it had already handled or cancelled, so it refused to do the same request twice. No new screenshot was taken.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0102 — SMTO didn't repeat a screen request it already handled

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0103 — The Gateway is already busy with other screen requests
documents.summary: The computer SMTO was asked to look at was already handling four screen requests, so it turned this one away. Nothing was captured for it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0103 — The Gateway is already busy with other screen requests

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0104 — Looking at the screen took too long
documents.summary: SMTO gave up after 15 seconds because the computer didn't finish capturing its screen in time. No screenshot or screen text from this attempt was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0104 — Looking at the screen took too long

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0105 — SMTO can't show the mouse pointer in screenshots
documents.summary: The request asked for a screenshot that shows the mouse pointer, and this version of SMTO can't do that. No screenshot was taken.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0105 — SMTO can't show the mouse pointer in screenshots

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0106 — The Gateway's web browser tools aren't installed correctly
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to work on a computer) couldn't load the software it needs to open a web browser, so this browsing step couldn't open a browser.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0106 — The Gateway's web browser tools aren't installed correctly

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0107 — The Gateway's built-in web browser is missing
documents.summary: The Gateway has its browser tools, but the Chromium browser program they open isn't installed where they look for it, so SMTO couldn't start a browser for this step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0107 — The Gateway's built-in web browser is missing

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0108 — SMTO can't find the browser window it was using
documents.summary: SMTO tried to keep working in a browser it opened earlier, but that browser is no longer running on the Gateway. Nothing was done in a browser by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0108 — SMTO can't find the browser window it was using

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0109 — This browser belongs to another conversation
documents.summary: SMTO asked to use or close a browser that this conversation is not allowed to control in that way. Nothing in that browser was changed by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0109 — This browser belongs to another conversation

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0110 — SMTO isn't set up to connect to your existing browser
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to connect to a browser that is already open on the computer, but that computer's Gateway has not been set up to allow it. SMTO did not connect to or change any browser.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0110 — SMTO isn't set up to connect to your existing browser

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0111 — SMTO can't find that browser tab
documents.summary: SMTO tried to work in a browser tab it no longer recognizes, for example one that was closed or belongs to another browser window. Nothing was done in the page by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0111 — SMTO can't find that browser tab

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0112 — The browser tab SMTO was using has closed
documents.summary: The tab SMTO wanted to use was closed, by a person, by the website itself, or by an earlier step. SMTO did not do anything in it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0112 — The browser tab SMTO was using has closed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0113 — The browser couldn't open that web page
documents.summary: SMTO asked the browser to go to a page, but the page didn't load. The website might still have received the request, so the browser may be on a different page than expected.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0113 — The browser couldn't open that web page

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0114 — The web page took too long to load
documents.summary: SMTO stopped waiting for a page to finish loading. The website may still have received the request and changed something, so the browser could be on a new page.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0114 — The web page took too long to load

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0115 — SMTO can't find that item on the page or in downloads
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a button, field, link or downloaded file, but nothing matching was there. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0115 — SMTO can't find that item on the page or in downloads

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0116 — More than one item on the page matches what SMTO was asked to use
documents.summary: SMTO found several buttons, fields or downloads that fit the description, so it stopped instead of guessing. Nothing was clicked, typed or saved.
