headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0116 — More than one item on the page matches what SMTO was asked to use

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0117 — The web page changed before SMTO could act
documents.summary: The page changed after SMTO looked at it, for example it reloaded or updated itself. To avoid clicking the wrong thing, SMTO did not click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0117 — The web page changed before SMTO could act

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0118 — SMTO can't use that part of the page right now
documents.summary: SMTO found the item but couldn't use it the way it was asked, for example the button is greyed out, hidden, or isn't a box you can type in. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0118 — SMTO can't use that part of the page right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0119 — SMTO can't find the file to upload on the Gateway computer
documents.summary: To upload a file, the file must be on the computer where SMTO's browser runs, and SMTO couldn't find or read it there. Nothing was uploaded.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0119 — SMTO can't find the file to upload on the Gateway computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0120 — The file upload didn't finish
documents.summary: SMTO tried to add a file to a web page, but something went wrong. The page may already have received the file, so it might be attached already.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0120 — The file upload didn't finish

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0121 — SMTO stopped waiting before the download finished
documents.summary: SMTO waited for a file to download, but the wait ended before it saw the download finish. The file may still be downloading or may already be done.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0121 — SMTO stopped waiting before the download finished

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0122 — SMTO isn't allowed to use that browser profile or folder
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open a browser with saved settings, but the folder it would use either belongs to something else or can't be accessed. SMTO didn't change that folder.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0122 — SMTO isn't allowed to use that browser profile or folder

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0123 — SMTO's browser can't do that on this page
documents.summary: SMTO's browser couldn't carry out this step, often because the tab shows something other than a normal web page. SMTO hadn't started the action, so the page wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0123 — SMTO's browser can't do that on this page

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0124 — The chosen computer can't run SMTO's browser this way
documents.summary: The computer SMTO is using for this conversation either doesn't have the browser set up, or can't show a visible browser window. Nothing was opened or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0124 — The chosen computer can't run SMTO's browser this way

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0125 — The browser step was stopped
documents.summary: The browser step was stopped, usually because the task was stopped or the Gateway was shutting down. If the step had already started, it may have changed the page or website.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0125 — The browser step was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0126 — SMTO can't tell whether the browser step happened
documents.summary: SMTO sent a browser action, such as a click or form entry, but never got a clear answer back. The action may or may not have happened, so SMTO won't repeat it on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0126 — SMTO can't tell whether the browser step happened

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0127 — SMTO can't type passwords for you
documents.summary: SMTO reached a password box on a website. To keep your password private, SMTO never types passwords, so you need to sign in yourself. Nothing was typed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0127 — SMTO can't type passwords for you

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0128 — SMTO couldn't do that web browser step as asked
documents.summary: SMTO tried a web browser step in a form it isn't allowed to use, such as opening an address that doesn't start with http:// or https://. The step was refused before anything happened on the website.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0128 — SMTO couldn't do that web browser step as asked

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0129 — SMTO got a reply from the web browser it couldn't trust
documents.summary: SMTO asked the web browser on your Gateway to do something, but the reply came back in a form SMTO couldn't check. If the step was a click, typing or a form submission, it may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0129 — SMTO got a reply from the web browser it couldn't trust

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0130 — SMTO lost contact with the web browser on your Gateway
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach the Gateway, the helper program that runs the web browser for SMTO, or that Gateway was shutting down. The browser step got no answer.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0130 — SMTO lost contact with the web browser on your Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0131 — The web browser on your Gateway is too busy right now
documents.summary: The Gateway already has as many browser windows or browser steps going as it allows, so SMTO didn't run this step. Nothing was done on the website.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0131 — The web browser on your Gateway is too busy right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0132 — SMTO stopped a web browser step from running twice
documents.summary: SMTO tried to send a browser step the Gateway had already received, so the Gateway refused to run it again. The first attempt may already have clicked, typed or submitted something.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0132 — SMTO stopped a web browser step from running twice

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0133 — A web browser step took too long
documents.summary: SMTO waited for a step on the web page, such as a click or typing, but it didn't finish in time. Part of it may still have happened on the page.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0133 — A web browser step took too long

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0134 — A web browser step was too big for SMTO to handle
documents.summary: The browser step went over one of SMTO's limits, such as a file larger than 16 MB, a description that matched too many things on the page, or too many open tabs. SMTO stopped that step.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0134 — A web browser step was too big for SMTO to handle

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0135 — SMTO downloaded a file but couldn't save it
documents.summary: The web browser finished downloading the file, but SMTO couldn't save it into this task's files on the Gateway computer. The browser still has the finished download.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0135 — SMTO downloaded a file but couldn't save it

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0136 — A file download in the web browser failed
documents.summary: The website started a download, but the web browser reported that it failed before the file was complete. No file was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0136 — A file download in the web browser failed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0137 — That saved browser profile is already open
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open a web browser with a saved profile, which keeps your website sign-ins between uses, but a browser using that profile is already open. Only one can use it at a time, so no new browser was opened.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0137 — That saved browser profile is already open

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0138 — SMTO can't read the buttons and fields of apps on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't read the buttons and text fields of apps on the Gateway's computer, because that computer's accessibility features aren't working for it right now. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0138 — SMTO can't read the buttons and fields of apps on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0139 — The Mac hasn't given SMTO permission to control apps
documents.summary: The Mac running the Gateway hasn't allowed it to use Accessibility, which SMTO needs to read and press buttons in other apps. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0139 — The Mac hasn't given SMTO permission to control apps

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0140 — That computer has no signed-in desktop for SMTO to use
documents.summary: SMTO can only work with apps on a desktop that a person is signed in to, and the Gateway on that computer isn't running inside one. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0140 — That computer has no signed-in desktop for SMTO to use

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0141 — App control isn't installed or supported on that computer
documents.summary: The Gateway on that computer doesn't have working app-control parts, either because they weren't installed correctly or its operating system isn't supported. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0141 — App control isn't installed or supported on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0142 — SMTO couldn't find the app window it needed
documents.summary: SMTO looked for the app window it was asked to work in, but found no matching window, or more than one, on that computer. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0142 — SMTO couldn't find the app window it needed

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0143 — SMTO couldn't find that button or field in the app
documents.summary: SMTO searched the whole app window for the button or field it wanted and didn't find it. It may not be on screen yet or may have a different name. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0143 — SMTO couldn't find that button or field in the app

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0144 — SMTO found more than one matching button or field
documents.summary: The description of the button or field SMTO was given matches more than one thing in the app, or the window was too big to check completely. SMTO didn't click or type anything rather than risk picking the wrong one.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0144 — SMTO found more than one matching button or field

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0145 — The app changed before SMTO could use that button or field
documents.summary: SMTO had found the button or field, but by the time it acted, the app had changed, the window had moved on or more than a minute had passed. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0145 — The app changed before SMTO could use that button or field

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0146 — The button or field SMTO needs isn't visible on screen
documents.summary: SMTO found the button or field, but it's hidden, scrolled out of view or off the edge of the screen, so SMTO couldn't safely use it. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0146 — The button or field SMTO needs isn't visible on screen

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0147 — The button or field SMTO needs is greyed out
documents.summary: SMTO found the button or field, but the app has it switched off (greyed out) right now, so it can't be used yet. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0147 — The button or field SMTO needs is greyed out

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0148 — That app control doesn't support what SMTO tried to do
documents.summary: SMTO tried an action the button or field doesn't offer, like typing into something that isn't selected or clicking something that can't be pressed. SMTO didn't click or type anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0148 — That app control doesn't support what SMTO tried to do

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0149 — SMTO blocked a password field's contents from being read
documents.summary: The Gateway tried to send back what's inside a password or other protected field, and SMTO refused it to keep that secret private. The secret wasn't shown or saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0149 — SMTO blocked a password field's contents from being read

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0150 — SMTO can't type into password fields for you
documents.summary: SMTO was about to type into a password field, and it never does that, to keep your secrets out of its records. Nothing was typed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0150 — SMTO can't type into password fields for you

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0151 — SMTO can't use the keyboard on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO wanted to press keys in an app, but keyboard control isn't available on that computer, for example because its Linux desktop uses Wayland. SMTO didn't press anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0151 — SMTO can't use the keyboard on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0152 — SMTO can't move the mouse on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO tried to click, drag or move the mouse in an app on the Gateway's computer, but that computer doesn't let SMTO control the mouse right now. Nothing was clicked.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0152 — SMTO can't move the mouse on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0153 — SMTO couldn't find that spot on the screen
documents.summary: SMTO tried to point at a screen position that isn't inside any current screen or inside the chosen window, so it didn't click or move anything.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0153 — SMTO couldn't find that spot on the screen

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0154 — A desktop step took too long and was stopped
documents.summary: SMTO was waiting to work in an app on the Gateway's computer, but the step ran out of time before any click or typing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0154 — A desktop step took too long and was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0155 — The desktop step was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The desktop step was cancelled, usually because the task was stopped or the Gateway was shutting down. No click or typing from this step was sent to the app.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0155 — The desktop step was stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0156 — That computer can't do this desktop action right now
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway's computer to work with an app on its screen, but that computer reported it can't see or control apps right now. Nothing was clicked or typed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0156 — That computer can't do this desktop action right now

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0157 — SMTO isn't sure whether the desktop action happened
documents.summary: SMTO started a click, typing or other change in an app on the Gateway's computer, but lost track before it could confirm the result. The change may have happened, partly happened, or may still be in progress.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0157 — SMTO isn't sure whether the desktop action happened

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0158 — The computer's security settings blocked this desktop action
documents.summary: The operating system on the Gateway's computer refused SMTO's click, key press or change in the app. SMTO can't be sure whether part of the action went through before it was refused.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0158 — The computer's security settings blocked this desktop action

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0159 — SMTO built a desktop instruction it couldn't use
documents.summary: SMTO's instruction for working in an app on the Gateway's computer was incomplete or in a form the Gateway doesn't accept, so nothing was clicked or typed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0159 — SMTO built a desktop instruction it couldn't use

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0160 — SMTO got a reply from the Gateway it couldn't understand
documents.summary: The Gateway's computer answered SMTO's desktop step, but the answer was incomplete or not what SMTO expected. If the step was a click or typing, it may have happened anyway.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0160 — SMTO got a reply from the Gateway it couldn't understand

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0161 — SMTO lost contact with the computer it was controlling
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't get a reliable answer from the Gateway while working in an app on that computer. If you had asked SMTO to stop, the action may still be running there.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0161 — SMTO lost contact with the computer it was controlling

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0162 — That computer is still finishing an earlier desktop step
documents.summary: SMTO can do only one desktop step at a time on that computer, and an earlier one hasn't finished yet. This step was not started.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0162 — That computer is still finishing an earlier desktop step

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0163 — SMTO blocked a repeat of a desktop step
documents.summary: SMTO tried to send a desktop step that the Gateway had already received or cancelled. To avoid doing the same thing twice, the Gateway refused it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0163 — SMTO blocked a repeat of a desktop step

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0164 — SMTO had no place to save this document
documents.summary: SMTO normally saves edited documents as a new file inside the conversation, but this request didn't come with a conversation it could save into. The original document wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0164 — SMTO had no place to save this document

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0165 — The Gateway is missing the software to work with this document
documents.summary: The computer SMTO is working on doesn't have working software for this kind of file (Word, Excel or PowerPoint). Nothing was read or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0165 — The Gateway is missing the software to work with this document

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0248 — SMTO can't use the saved Docker login or secret you named

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0249 — This Docker option isn't supported by SMTO

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0249 — This Docker option isn't supported by SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0250 — This Docker request was already sent once

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0250 — This Docker request was already sent once

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0251 — Only finished tasks can be saved as a workflow
documents.summary: SMTO can only turn a task into a reusable workflow after it has finished successfully. This task hasn't finished, or it didn't succeed, so nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0251 — Only finished tasks can be saved as a workflow

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0252 — SMTO couldn't find steps in this task that it can reuse
documents.summary: SMTO tried to turn this finished task into a step-by-step workflow, but couldn't confirm which steps could be safely repeated. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0252 — SMTO couldn't find steps in this task that it can reuse

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0253 — Part of this task may not have finished, so it can't be saved yet
documents.summary: While this task ran, at least one action ended without SMTO knowing whether it worked, or a question was left open. SMTO won't save a workflow from it until that's settled, so nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0253 — Part of this task may not have finished, so it can't be saved yet

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0254 — Your workflow contains a password or other private value
documents.summary: SMTO found something that looks like a password, key or other private value in what you're saving. To keep it safe, SMTO didn't save the workflow.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0254 — Your workflow contains a password or other private value

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0255 — SMTO can't record your own clicks and typing as a workflow
documents.summary: SMTO can't watch what you do on your computer and turn it into a workflow; this isn't available on Linux, Windows or macOS. Nothing was recorded.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0255 — SMTO can't record your own clicks and typing as a workflow

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0256 — This workflow's steps or changes aren't valid
documents.summary: SMTO found something in this workflow it can't accept, such as a removed required step, steps in the wrong order, or a step running in a way the workflow doesn't allow. The change wasn't saved, or the step didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0256 — This workflow's steps or changes aren't valid

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0257 — A tool this workflow uses is no longer available
documents.summary: This workflow needs a tool that SMTO can't find anymore. It may have been removed, renamed or turned off, for example by an update. SMTO stopped before using it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0257 — A tool this workflow uses is no longer available

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0258 — A tool in this workflow changed since the workflow was saved
documents.summary: A tool this workflow relies on now works differently than when the workflow was saved, usually after an SMTO update. SMTO stopped instead of guessing how to use it.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0258 — A tool in this workflow changed since the workflow was saved

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0259 — This workflow needs a value that wasn't provided
documents.summary: This workflow has a required input, such as a file name or address, that has no value for this run. SMTO stopped before running any of the workflow's steps.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0259 — This workflow needs a value that wasn't provided

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0261 — A saved account or private value this workflow needs is missing
documents.summary: This workflow refers to an entry in the Parameter Store, where SMTO keeps passwords and other private values, but that entry can't be found or its name is written wrong. SMTO stopped before running the workflow's steps.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0261 — A saved account or private value this workflow needs is missing

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0262 — SMTO found more than one possible target and won't guess
documents.summary: A workflow step needed one specific item, such as a file or record, but found several that match. SMTO stopped rather than risk picking the wrong one.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0262 — SMTO found more than one possible target and won't guess

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0263 — This workflow can't run because something it needs is turned off
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't start this workflow. Workflows may be turned off, the workflow may no longer exist, or a tool it needs isn't allowed or ready right now.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0263 — This workflow can't run because something it needs is turned off

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0264 — This workflow must run on a specific computer that isn't selected
documents.summary: This workflow was saved to always run through one particular Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer. This run used a different Gateway or none, so SMTO stopped before any steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0264 — This workflow must run on a specific computer that isn't selected

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0265 — This workflow was changed since you opened it
documents.summary: A newer version of this workflow was saved, for example from another window, or the version this run expected is gone. SMTO stopped so it doesn't overwrite the newer version or run an outdated one.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0265 — This workflow was changed since you opened it

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0266 — A workflow step couldn't run because what it depends on isn't ready
documents.summary: A workflow step needed a result from an earlier step, or had to match exactly what was set up, and didn't. An earlier step may have failed. SMTO blocked the change and kept the steps that already finished.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0266 — A workflow step couldn't run because what it depends on isn't ready

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0267 — A workflow step finished without the result it was supposed to produce
documents.summary: SMTO tried to finish this workflow, but a required step hadn't completed, or a step succeeded without returning the result later steps need. SMTO didn't mark the workflow as done.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0267 — A workflow step finished without the result it was supposed to produce

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0268 — A workflow step may already have made its change
documents.summary: SMTO lost track of whether a workflow step finished, or an earlier run of this workflow is still open. The change may already have happened, so SMTO is blocking further changes until that's checked.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0268 — A workflow step may already have made its change

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0269 — This workflow is waiting for you to answer a question
documents.summary: One step in this workflow needs a person to confirm or answer something. The workflow is paused at that step and won't go on until you answer. SMTO never answers it for you.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0269 — This workflow is waiting for you to answer a question

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0270 — This workflow can't run on a schedule because it needs a person
documents.summary: This workflow has at least one step where a person must answer or confirm something. A schedule runs with nobody watching, so SMTO won't run this workflow that way. None of its steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0270 — This workflow can't run on a schedule because it needs a person

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0271 — This workflow run stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The workflow stopped partway through. Steps that already finished were not undone, and a step that was running when it stopped may or may not have taken effect.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0271 — This workflow run stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0272 — SMTO couldn't accept this workflow because part of it is wrong
documents.summary: SMTO checks every workflow before saving or running it, and this one didn't pass. Nothing in the workflow was run.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0272 — SMTO couldn't accept this workflow because part of it is wrong

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0273 — Web browsing is turned off on this Gateway
documents.summary: The person who set up this Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run things on a computer, turned off its web browser. SMTO can't open websites there, and allowing it in this conversation doesn't change that.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0273 — Web browsing is turned off on this Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0274 — The computer running the Gateway can't make this kind of chart
documents.summary: SMTO's chart tools on the selected computer are missing some of the software they need, so the chart format you asked for can't be made there right now. Other chart types may still work.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0274 — The computer running the Gateway can't make this kind of chart

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0275 — The screen changed before SMTO could click
documents.summary: SMTO was about to click or type at a spot it found in a screenshot, but that part of the screen moved or changed, or the screenshot got too old. SMTO didn't send the click or typing.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0275 — The screen changed before SMTO could click

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0276 — Another window took over before SMTO could type
documents.summary: SMTO was about to type or press keys in an app, but a different window came to the front, or a key such as Shift was held down. SMTO stopped so its typing wouldn't land in the wrong place.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0276 — Another window took over before SMTO could type

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0277 — SMTO can't type some of these characters on that computer
documents.summary: The keyboard layout on the Gateway's Linux computer has no key for some characters SMTO needed to type, such as accented letters, symbols or emoji. SMTO didn't type any of the text.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0277 — SMTO can't type some of these characters on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-EXE-0278 — A command in this task's terminal needs your attention first
documents.summary: SMTO didn't start a new step because a command already running in this task's terminal is still using something that step needs, and it has gone quiet. That command is still running and wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-EXE-0278 — A command in this task's terminal needs your attention first

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0001 — Permission error while handling the request
documents.summary: The computer refused to let SMTO open or change a file or folder it needed. The account SMTO runs as isn't allowed to use that item.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0001 — Permission error while handling the request

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0002 — Required file or resource was not found
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a file, folder or other item it needed, but it isn't where SMTO was told to look. It may have been renamed, moved, deleted, or be on another computer.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0002 — Required file or resource was not found

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0003 — A file or folder with that name already exists
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to create something new, but a file or folder with that name is already in that place. SMTO left the existing one as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0003 — A file or folder with that name already exists

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0004 — SMTO tried to read a non-text file as text
documents.summary: The file looks like a picture, archive, program or other non-text file, so SMTO couldn't open it as text. The file was not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0004 — SMTO tried to read a non-text file as text

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0005 — The file operation was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The copy, save or transfer stopped because its Task or Activity was stopped. Some files may already have been copied or changed before it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0005 — The file operation was stopped before it finished
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0006 — This computer can't list connected drives for SMTO
documents.summary: SMTO can only find USB and external drives by itself on Linux computers. The Gateway you're using runs a different system, so SMTO couldn't list its drives.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0006 — This computer can't list connected drives for SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0007 — SMTO couldn't read this file's text format
documents.summary: The file's text is stored in a format (its encoding) that SMTO couldn't read, or that doesn't match the one it was told to use, so SMTO stopped instead of garbling it.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0007 — SMTO couldn't read this file's text format

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0008 — SMTO couldn't use the file name pattern it was given
documents.summary: SMTO tried to pick out files with a name pattern (like *.csv) that it couldn't read, so the search or listing didn't run. No files were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0008 — SMTO couldn't use the file name pattern it was given

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0009 — Invalid regular expression
documents.summary: SMTO tried to search inside files using a text pattern it couldn't run, so the search didn't happen. No files were changed.

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0010 — SMTO's file request had missing or conflicting details
documents.summary: SMTO asked to work with a file but left out a required detail or mixed options that can't be used together. The request was refused before it ran, so no files were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0010 — SMTO's file request had missing or conflicting details

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0011 — SMTO couldn't use that file or folder location
documents.summary: The location SMTO used is blank, too long, contains characters the computer doesn't allow, or would copy or move a folder into itself. SMTO stopped at that step.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0011 — SMTO couldn't use that file or folder location

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0012 — SMTO couldn't open the folder it works from on that computer
documents.summary: SMTO starts each file action from a working folder on the Gateway's computer (the Gateway is the helper program SMTO uses there). That folder is missing or couldn't be opened, so nothing was run or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0012 — SMTO couldn't open the folder it works from on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0013 — SMTO couldn't finish reading or writing a file
documents.summary: The computer reported a problem while SMTO was working with a file but didn't say exactly what. If SMTO was adding to or changing files, part of the change may already be saved.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0013 — SMTO couldn't finish reading or writing a file

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0014 — SMTO couldn't find the text it meant to change
documents.summary: SMTO tried to edit a file, but the exact text it wanted to replace isn't in the file as it is now. The file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0014 — SMTO couldn't find the text it meant to change

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0015 — SMTO wasn't sure which part of the file to change
documents.summary: The text SMTO wanted to replace appears a different number of times than it planned, usually more than once, so it couldn't tell which place to change. The file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0015 — SMTO wasn't sure which part of the file to change

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0016 — SMTO expected a folder but found a file
documents.summary: SMTO tried to use a location as a folder, for example to list it or create something inside it, but that location, or part of it, is a file.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0016 — SMTO expected a folder but found a file

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0017 — SMTO expected a file but found a folder
documents.summary: SMTO tried to treat a folder as a single file, for example to read it, save over it, or copy it without saying to include its contents. It stopped at that step.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0017 — SMTO expected a file but found a folder

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0018 — SMTO couldn't find that file or folder
documents.summary: A file, folder, drive or network location SMTO needed isn't there on the selected computer. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted, or SMTO is looking on the wrong computer.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0018 — SMTO couldn't find that file or folder

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0019 — SMTO can't do that file action in this way
documents.summary: SMTO asked for a file action it can't carry out safely, such as copying a folder over an existing folder, replacing a folder during a move, or renaming a file inside a set of edits. This step changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0019 — SMTO can't do that file action in this way

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0020 — SMTO's file changes didn't match the files as they are now
documents.summary: SMTO prepared changes to one or more files, but they were badly formed or no longer line up with what the files contain now. None of these changes were applied.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0020 — SMTO's file changes didn't match the files as they are now

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0021 — That location is outside the folders SMTO may use
documents.summary: SMTO may only work with files inside certain folders on the Gateway's computer. This location is outside them, or the request would delete or move a whole drive or SMTO's main work folder. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0021 — That location is outside the folders SMTO may use

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0022 — The computer didn't let SMTO use this file
documents.summary: The account the Gateway runs as on that computer isn't allowed to open or change this file, or the file is read-only. SMTO's own permission settings can't override the computer's file permissions.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0022 — The computer didn't let SMTO use this file
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0023 — The file is too large to copy, or the storage allowance is full
documents.summary: Either the file is bigger than SMTO's copy size limit (64 MB unless your administrator changed it), or your storage allowance on that computer is used up. The copy or save didn't complete.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0023 — The file is too large to copy, or the storage allowance is full

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0024 — This file task is too big for SMTO to do in one step
documents.summary: The files or changes involved are larger than SMTO handles in one step, such as editing a file over 8 MB, comparing very long files, or changing more than 64 files at once. This step was stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0024 — This file task is too big for SMTO to do in one step

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0025 — A file changed while SMTO was working with it
documents.summary: The file or folder was changed, replaced or moved by someone or something else after SMTO last looked at it, or while it was working. SMTO stopped instead of overwriting those changes.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0025 — A file changed while SMTO was working with it
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0026 — SMTO can only work with ordinary files here
documents.summary: The location points to a special system item, not an ordinary file. Examples are a device, a pipe, a shortcut-style link or a special Windows link. SMTO's file actions can't read, copy or send it.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0026 — SMTO can only work with ordinary files here

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0027 — SMTO lost its place while reading a file in parts
documents.summary: SMTO was reading a long file or folder list in parts, but its bookmark for the next part expired, the Gateway restarted, or the file changed. Nothing was changed; the read just needs to start over.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0027 — SMTO lost its place while reading a file in parts
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0028 — A folder link loops back on itself
documents.summary: SMTO stopped following a path because a link (a shortcut to another folder) leads back into a folder it had already gone through. If you asked for a list or search, files inside that loop are left out.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0028 — A folder link loops back on itself

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0029 — A file action on the Gateway took too long
documents.summary: SMTO gave up on a file action on the Gateway computer because it didn't finish in time. It may have been waiting for another change to the same files, or there was too much to go through.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0029 — A file action on the Gateway took too long

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0030 — A folder in the copy's path is a link, not a real folder
documents.summary: SMTO stopped the copy because a folder on the way to the file is a link or junction pointing elsewhere on the Windows computer. SMTO only copies through ordinary folders, so files can't land somewhere unexpected.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0030 — A folder in the copy's path is a link, not a real folder

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0031 — This Windows file name or path isn't supported
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use this path because part of it means something special to Windows, such as a reserved name like CON or NUL, a name ending in a dot or space, or an extra colon. SMTO didn't open or change it.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0031 — This Windows file name or path isn't supported

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0032 — SMTO can't confirm whether the copied file was saved
documents.summary: A copy between Gateways reached its last step, but the receiving computer's reply didn't match what SMTO expected. The file may or may not have been saved at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0032 — SMTO can't confirm whether the copied file was saved
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0033 — The receiving Gateway didn't confirm the copied data correctly
documents.summary: While copying a file between Gateways, the receiving computer reported a different amount of data than SMTO had just sent. SMTO stopped the copy before putting the file in place at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0033 — The receiving Gateway didn't confirm the copied data correctly
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0034 — SMTO couldn't read the original file's details for the copy
documents.summary: When SMTO opened the original file to copy it to another Gateway, that Gateway didn't report a usable size or identity for it. SMTO stopped before sending anything to the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0034 — SMTO couldn't read the original file's details for the copy
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0035 — A copy step reached the wrong side of the copy
documents.summary: During a copy between Gateways, a step meant for the sending computer reached the receiving one, or the other way round. The Gateway refused it and the copy stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0035 — A copy step reached the wrong side of the copy
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0036 — Part of the file arrived in an unexpected form during the copy
documents.summary: While copying a file between Gateways, one piece of the file didn't have the expected size or position, or didn't match the original file. SMTO stopped the copy before putting the file in place at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0036 — Part of the file arrived in an unexpected form during the copy
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0037 — The Gateway is handling too many file copies right now
documents.summary: The Gateway computer is already tracking as many file copies as it can, including unfinished ones it still has to clean up. SMTO stopped this copy before sending any of the file.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0037 — The Gateway is handling too many file copies right now
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0038 — The copied file didn't match the original, so it wasn't saved
documents.summary: At the end of a copy between Gateways, SMTO compared the received file with the original and found they were different. SMTO did not put the mismatched file in place at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0038 — The copied file didn't match the original, so it wasn't saved
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0039 — This copy looks like a repeat of one already started
documents.summary: The Gateway already has a record of a copy with the same internal number, so it refused to start it again. Starting it twice could copy the file twice or mix up the two copies.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0039 — This copy looks like a repeat of one already started
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0040 — A piece of the copied file arrived out of order
documents.summary: During a copy between Gateways, the next piece of the file didn't start where the last one ended. SMTO stopped the copy before putting the file in place at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0040 — A piece of the copied file arrived out of order
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0041 — SMTO left an unfinished copy file alone because it couldn't confirm it
documents.summary: SMTO tried to remove a leftover, partly copied file from a copy between Gateways, but the file or its folder had changed since SMTO made it. To avoid deleting something that isn't its own, SMTO left it in place.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0041 — SMTO left an unfinished copy file alone because it couldn't confirm it
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0042 — The Gateway lost track of this file copy
documents.summary: Partway through a copy between Gateways, the Gateway no longer had the copy open, for example because it restarted or the copy sat idle too long. SMTO can't tell from this alone whether the file was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0042 — The Gateway lost track of this file copy
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0043 — A file copy couldn't start and may have left a partial file
documents.summary: SMTO hit a problem while getting a file copy ready on a Gateway, and it couldn't confirm that it cleaned up afterwards. A hidden, unfinished copy file may still be in the destination folder.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0043 — A file copy couldn't start and may have left a partial file
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0044 — The copy tried to finish before the whole file arrived
documents.summary: At the end of a copy between Gateways, the receiving computer had less data than the file's full size. SMTO did not put the incomplete file in place at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0044 — The copy tried to finish before the whole file arrived
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0045 — SMTO couldn't set up this copy between Gateways
documents.summary: Before copying anything, SMTO checks both Gateways and the request. One of those checks failed, so the copy didn't start and no files were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0045 — SMTO couldn't set up this copy between Gateways

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0046 — SMTO can't open that file link
documents.summary: The file link you selected points to a file that no longer exists, to a folder, or to a place outside the folder SMTO is allowed to open. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0046 — SMTO can't open that file link

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0047 — SMTO stopped a save to a different place than the drive you chose
documents.summary: SMTO was about to save files somewhere other than the drive or folder you picked, so it stopped before writing anything. Nothing was copied or changed by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0047 — SMTO stopped a save to a different place than the drive you chose

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0048 — A skip list in this folder is too large for SMTO to read
documents.summary: While looking through the folder, SMTO found a list of files to skip (such as a .gitignore file) that is bigger than 64 KB. It couldn't use that list, so the results are marked incomplete.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0048 — A skip list in this folder is too large for SMTO to read

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0049 — SMTO couldn't check everything in the folder before changing it
documents.summary: Before copying, moving or deleting a whole folder, SMTO looks at everything inside it. It couldn't finish looking, so it didn't start the change.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0049 — SMTO couldn't check everything in the folder before changing it

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0050 — SMTO couldn't keep a file's hidden details, so it didn't save it
documents.summary: When SMTO copies or replaces a file, it keeps the file's hidden details, such as tags or security labels. That failed, so this file was not saved. Files finished earlier in the same request may already be in place.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0050 — SMTO couldn't keep a file's hidden details, so it didn't save it

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0051 — An edit to several files failed partway and needs checking
documents.summary: SMTO was changing several files together when something went wrong. It tried to put back the files it had already changed, but some may still hold the new text.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0051 — An edit to several files failed partway and needs checking

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0052 — The drive you chose is no longer available
documents.summary: SMTO can't find the USB or external drive you picked earlier, or it was unplugged and plugged back in. SMTO didn't write anything in this step.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0052 — The drive you chose is no longer available

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0053 — SMTO couldn't check which drives are connected
documents.summary: Before saving to a USB or external drive, SMTO asks the Gateway which drives are plugged in. That check failed, or the folder path given wasn't usable, so nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0053 — SMTO couldn't check which drives are connected

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0054 — The drive SMTO was saving to is full
documents.summary: The computer reported no free space left where SMTO was saving. Some files from this request may have been saved before the space ran out.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0054 — The drive SMTO was saving to is full

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0055 — SMTO can't save there because the drive is read-only
documents.summary: The computer doesn't allow any changes on that drive or folder because it is set to read-only, so SMTO couldn't save there.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0055 — SMTO can't save there because the drive is read-only
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0056 — Another program is using the file SMTO needs
documents.summary: Windows says another program has this file open or locked, so SMTO couldn't use it right now.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0056 — Another program is using the file SMTO needs

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0057 — SMTO can't move these files directly to another drive
documents.summary: Files can't be moved between two different drives in one step, and SMTO couldn't switch to its safe copy-then-delete method for this request, so it stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0057 — SMTO can't move these files directly to another drive

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0058 — SMTO can't remove a folder that still has files in it
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to remove a folder, but the folder still holds files or subfolders, or new ones appeared while SMTO was deleting. The folder itself was not removed.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0058 — SMTO can't remove a folder that still has files in it

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0059 — SMTO's file search tool stopped with an error
documents.summary: SMTO uses a search tool on the Gateway computer to find files by name. That tool failed or gave results SMTO couldn't trust, so no results were shown. Searching doesn't change any files.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0059 — SMTO's file search tool stopped with an error

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0060 — SMTO couldn't open this compressed file
documents.summary: The attached file isn't a ZIP, TAR or .gz file that SMTO can read, or it's damaged. SMTO didn't read anything from inside it.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0060 — SMTO couldn't open this compressed file

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0061 — This compressed file is too big for SMTO to open
documents.summary: Unpacked, this file would hold too many files or too much data for SMTO to check safely, so SMTO stopped. Nothing was unpacked.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0061 — This compressed file is too big for SMTO to open

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0062 — SMTO lost track of a file inside the compressed file
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open a file inside the compressed file using a reference from an earlier look or from a different compressed file, so it didn't match. Nothing was read.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0062 — SMTO lost track of a file inside the compressed file

documents.title: SMTO-FIL-0063 — SMTO can't safely open that file inside the compressed file
documents.summary: The item SMTO chose is a folder, doesn't exist, or is blocked for safety, for example because it's password-protected, a shortcut (link), or has a path pointing outside the compressed file. SMTO didn't unpack it.

headings.title: SMTO-FIL-0063 — SMTO can't safely open that file inside the compressed file

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0001 — SMTO couldn't find a Git project in that folder
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a Git project (a folder whose history is tracked with Git) in the folder it was using, and didn't find one. Nothing in that folder was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0001 — SMTO couldn't find a Git project in that folder

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0002 — Your Git project changed while SMTO was reading it
documents.summary: SMTO was reading your Git project's settings, such as where it sends and gets changes, and they changed while it was reading. SMTO set that reading aside instead of using details that might be wrong. Your project wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0002 — Your Git project changed while SMTO was reading it

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0003 — SMTO couldn't read this Git project's setup
documents.summary: After a Git command, SMTO tried to note which project folder was used, but that folder's hidden Git information is incomplete or damaged. Your command's result wasn't changed; SMTO just won't remember this project.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0003 — SMTO couldn't read this Git project's setup

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0004 — SMTO couldn't find the Git project for this folder
documents.summary: The folder used for a Git command is nested very deep, and SMTO stopped searching upward before it found the project. The command's own result wasn't changed; SMTO just won't remember this project.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0004 — SMTO couldn't find the Git project for this folder

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0005 — A Git settings file has a missing closing quote
documents.summary: A Git settings file on the computer running the Gateway has a value with an opening quote mark but no closing one. SMTO couldn't read it, so it won't remember this project. Your Git command's result wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0005 — A Git settings file has a missing closing quote

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0006 — This Git setup uses features SMTO can't check
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't safely record which Git project was used, because the Git setup on that computer uses something its quick check doesn't support. This doesn't change your Git command's result; SMTO just won't remember the project for later steps.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0006 — This Git setup uses features SMTO can't check

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0007 — SMTO ignored its saved notes about a Git project
documents.summary: SMTO keeps short notes about the Git projects used in a conversation. One of those notes was damaged or didn't make sense, so SMTO ignored it. Your project files and Git history weren't touched.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0007 — SMTO ignored its saved notes about a Git project

documents.title: SMTO-GIT-0008 — The Git project address has a sign-in name or isn't valid
documents.summary: The address saved for a Git project contains a user name or password, or isn't a valid address. SMTO keeps sign-in details only in their own private fields, so it didn't accept this address.

headings.title: SMTO-GIT-0008 — The Git project address has a sign-in name or isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0001 — SMTO needs to know which Gmail account to use
documents.summary: You have more than one Gmail account saved in SMTO, and this request didn't say which one to use. SMTO won't guess, so it didn't use any of them.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0001 — SMTO needs to know which Gmail account to use

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0002 — Your Gmail account changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: The saved Gmail account was edited, reconnected, renamed or removed after this request started using it. SMTO stopped so it wouldn't keep working with outdated account details.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0002 — Your Gmail account changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0003 — That Gmail account name is already used by another entry
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save your Gmail sign-in under a name that already belongs to a different saved entry, such as another email address or another kind of account. SMTO stopped so it wouldn't overwrite it.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0003 — That Gmail account name is already used by another entry

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0004 — SMTO can't find a Gmail account to use
documents.summary: This request needs a Gmail account, but none is saved in SMTO, or the one mentioned doesn't exist or isn't allowed to do this kind of action.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0004 — SMTO can't find a Gmail account to use

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0005 — SMTO couldn't find the email attachment
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a file it needed for this email, either a file to attach or an attachment on a message in your mailbox. No email was sent or drafted because of this step.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0005 — SMTO couldn't find the email attachment

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0006 — SMTO couldn't read your attached file correctly
documents.summary: SMTO started reading a file you attached to the conversation, but it couldn't read all of it, or what it read didn't match the file you uploaded. SMTO didn't send the email so a broken file wouldn't go out.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0006 — SMTO couldn't read your attached file correctly

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0007 — The email's attachments are too big to send
documents.summary: All the files together are bigger than the 25 MB that one email can carry. SMTO stopped before sending or saving the email, so nothing went out.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0007 — The email's attachments are too big to send

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0008 — SMTO must show you which emails it will change first
documents.summary: SMTO tried to change a group of emails picked by a search without first showing you exactly which emails those are. It stopped, and no emails were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0008 — SMTO must show you which emails it will change first

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0009 — The list of emails to change has expired
documents.summary: SMTO had prepared a list of emails to change, but that list is no longer valid. It lasts 10 minutes, works only once, and is cleared when SMTO restarts. Nothing was changed by this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0009 — The list of emails to change has expired
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0010 — SMTO couldn't tell which emails you wanted to change
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to change a group of emails, but the request named specific emails and also a search at the same time. SMTO stopped before changing anything in your mailbox.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0010 — SMTO couldn't tell which emails you wanted to change

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0011 — Your email change no longer matches the preview you approved
documents.summary: SMTO prepared a preview of emails to change, but the change it was about to make didn't match that preview exactly, so it stopped. No emails were changed by this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0011 — Your email change no longer matches the preview you approved

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0012 — Too many Gmail changes are waiting at once
documents.summary: SMTO keeps a short list of email previews that are waiting for approval, and that list is full, or one change tried to touch too many emails at once. Nothing was changed by this request.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0012 — Too many Gmail changes are waiting at once

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0013 — This Gmail change needs your approval first
documents.summary: SMTO was about to change your mailbox, but it didn't have your approval for this change, so it stopped. Nothing in your mailbox was changed by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0013 — This Gmail change needs your approval first

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0014 — This email is too long to forward with its text included
documents.summary: The email you wanted to forward is too long for SMTO to copy into a new message without cutting part of it off. SMTO stopped instead of sending an incomplete copy. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0014 — This email is too long to forward with its text included

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0015 — SMTO couldn't find that Gmail label
documents.summary: SMTO tried to add or remove a Gmail label, but no label with that exact name exists in the Gmail account it is using. No emails were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0015 — SMTO couldn't find that Gmail label

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0016 — The email has no message text
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to write or send an email, but the email had no text in it. SMTO stopped before creating a draft or sending anything.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0016 — The email has no message text

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0017 — SMTO couldn't find that email in Gmail
documents.summary: SMTO needed a specific email to reply, forward or change, but couldn't find it. It may have been deleted, or it belongs to a different conversation or account. Nothing was sent or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0017 — SMTO couldn't find that email in Gmail

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0018 — SMTO doesn't support that kind of Gmail change
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to make a bulk change to emails that it doesn't know how to do. It stopped before changing anything.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0018 — SMTO doesn't support that kind of Gmail change

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0019 — SMTO couldn't connect your Gmail account
documents.summary: SMTO tried to connect to your Gmail account, but the Google sign-in was cancelled or didn't finish properly, so SMTO has no permission to use the account. Nothing was saved and no emails were touched.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0019 — SMTO couldn't connect your Gmail account

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0020 — Gmail OAuth state is invalid
documents.summary: The Google sign-in link or reply SMTO received doesn't belong to a sign-in that is still in progress. It may have expired, been used already, or come from an older attempt. Your Gmail account was not connected by this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0020 — Gmail OAuth state is invalid

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0021 — Too many Gmail sign-ins are waiting to be finished
documents.summary: Many Gmail sign-ins were started but not finished, and SMTO only allows a limited number at once. SMTO didn't start a new one. Nothing about your connected accounts changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0021 — Too many Gmail sign-ins are waiting to be finished

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0022 — SMTO lost its place in a Gmail list
documents.summary: SMTO was showing a long Gmail list in pages, such as your labels, filters or emails, and the marker for the next page was no longer valid. Nothing in your mailbox was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0022 — SMTO lost its place in a Gmail list

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0023 — SMTO doesn't recognize that Gmail account name
documents.summary: SMTO was told which Gmail account to use, but the account name it was given isn't written in a form SMTO accepts, for example it contains spaces or an email address. Nothing was done in your mailbox.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0023 — SMTO doesn't recognize that Gmail account name

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0024 — Gmail is unavailable because saved account storage is off
documents.summary: SMTO keeps your connected Gmail accounts in its Parameter Store, and that storage is switched off on this installation, so Gmail can't be used. Your saved accounts aren't deleted; they just can't be reached right now.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0024 — Gmail is unavailable because saved account storage is off

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0025 — Gmail kept sending the same page of search results
documents.summary: SMTO was going through your Gmail search results page by page, but Gmail kept sending a page it had already sent. SMTO stopped to avoid going in circles. No emails were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0025 — Gmail kept sending the same page of search results

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0026 — Gmail authorization expired
documents.summary: SMTO can no longer use the permission Google gave it for this Gmail account. This message alone does not establish why: it may have expired, been removed, or been refused by Google.

headings.title: Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0027 — Google didn't allow SMTO to do this in your Gmail
documents.summary: SMTO tried to do something in your Gmail that Google hasn't allowed for this connection. You may not have granted that permission when you signed in, or your Google account's rules block it. The step didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0027 — Google didn't allow SMTO to do this in your Gmail

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0028 — SMTO can't handle Gmail attachments outside a conversation
documents.summary: SMTO tried to save an email attachment or attach a file to an email, but this request isn't connected to a conversation where SMTO can keep or find files. Nothing was saved or sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0028 — SMTO can't handle Gmail attachments outside a conversation

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0029 — SMTO couldn't tell which email conversation to reply in
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to write a reply, but it wasn't told which email or conversation to reply to. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0029 — SMTO couldn't tell which email conversation to reply in

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0030 — Gmail mutation outcome is unknown
documents.summary: SMTO lost track of a Gmail change partway through. The email may already have been sent, or the draft, label change or deletion may already be done in Gmail.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0030 — Gmail mutation outcome is unknown
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0031 — Google is limiting how fast SMTO can use Gmail
documents.summary: Google temporarily refused this Gmail request because too many requests were made in a short time. That request was turned down, but earlier steps in the same Task may already be done.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0031 — Google is limiting how fast SMTO can use Gmail

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0032 — SMTO couldn't complete a request to Gmail
documents.summary: SMTO asked Google to do something in Gmail, and Google, or the connection to Google, returned an error that SMTO couldn't narrow down further.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0032 — SMTO couldn't complete a request to Gmail

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0033 — This old Gmail setup page is no longer used
documents.summary: Something tried to open an old Gmail setup or mailbox-copy address that SMTO no longer has. Nothing was set up or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0033 — This old Gmail setup page is no longer used

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0034 — Gmail isn't available on this SMTO server
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use Gmail because the Gmail feature isn't switched on for this server. Your request never reached Gmail, so nothing in your mailbox changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0034 — Gmail isn't available on this SMTO server

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0035 — This sign-in link has expired or was already used
documents.summary: Your browser came back to SMTO from a sign-in page that is too old, was already finished once, or doesn't belong to the current request. SMTO ignored it, so nothing was connected by it.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0035 — This sign-in link has expired or was already used

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0036 — Google refused SMTO access to this Gmail request
documents.summary: Google said no to this Gmail request. The account may not have given SMTO this permission, or a Google or workplace rule may block it. Your password is probably not the problem.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0036 — Google refused SMTO access to this Gmail request
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0037 — Google couldn't find that Gmail item
documents.summary: The email, draft, label or attachment SMTO asked for isn't in this Gmail account anymore, or it belongs to a different account. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0037 — Google couldn't find that Gmail item

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0038 — Gmail had a problem on Google's side
documents.summary: Google's Gmail service had an internal problem while handling the request. If the Task was sending or changing email, that change may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0038 — Gmail had a problem on Google's side

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0039 — Gmail took too long to respond
documents.summary: SMTO waited for Google, but Gmail didn't answer in time, so the request stopped. If it was a send or a change, it may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0039 — Gmail took too long to respond

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0040 — SMTO lost its connection to Gmail
documents.summary: The connection between SMTO and Google broke before Gmail answered. A lost connection doesn't prove the request failed; a send or change may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0040 — SMTO lost its connection to Gmail

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0041 — Gmail sent back a reply SMTO couldn't read
documents.summary: SMTO got an answer that didn't look like it came from Gmail, for example a web page from a network filter or a Wi-Fi sign-in page, and couldn't use it.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0041 — Gmail sent back a reply SMTO couldn't read

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0042 — That email conversation has no messages to reply to
documents.summary: SMTO tried to reply in a Gmail conversation, but that conversation had no emails in it, for example because they were deleted. No reply was created or sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0042 — That email conversation has no messages to reply to

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0043 — SMTO doesn't know who to send this email to
documents.summary: The email has nobody in its To line, so SMTO stopped before creating the draft or sending it. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0043 — SMTO doesn't know who to send this email to

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0044 — The Gmail account you chose isn't set up correctly
documents.summary: The saved entry SMTO used as your Gmail account is either not a Gmail account or is missing required details. SMTO stopped before contacting Gmail, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0044 — The Gmail account you chose isn't set up correctly

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0045 — SMTO can't find the Gmail sign-in app you named
documents.summary: To connect Gmail, SMTO needs a saved Gmail OAuth App entry (your Google sign-in app details). The name you used, or the one your saved Gmail account points to, doesn't exist. Nothing in Gmail was touched.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0045 — SMTO can't find the Gmail sign-in app you named

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0046 — The Gmail sign-in app you named isn't set up correctly
documents.summary: The saved entry you named is either not a Gmail OAuth App or is missing details SMTO needs to start Google sign-in. SMTO stopped before contacting Google, so nothing in Gmail changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0046 — The Gmail sign-in app you named isn't set up correctly

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0047 — Gmail couldn't find the item SMTO asked for
documents.summary: SMTO asked Gmail for something, such as an email or a setting, that Gmail says doesn't exist in this account. It may have been deleted, moved or belong to a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0047 — Gmail couldn't find the item SMTO asked for

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0048 — Gmail asked SMTO to slow down
documents.summary: Gmail limits how many requests an account can make in a short time. SMTO hit that limit, so Gmail turned down this request. Earlier parts of the same Task may already be done.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0048 — Gmail asked SMTO to slow down

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0049 — The separate Gmail setup helper is no longer used
documents.summary: The command you ran used to start a separate helper for connecting Gmail. SMTO now connects Gmail itself, so the command only shows this notice and does nothing else.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0049 — The separate Gmail setup helper is no longer used

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0050 — Your saved Gmail account details are incomplete or invalid
documents.summary: SMTO checked the Gmail account saved in Parameter Store and found a problem, such as a missing app password, an unusable email address, or mail set to come from a different address. This step stopped before sending anything.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0050 — Your saved Gmail account details are incomplete or invalid

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0051 — Gmail refused to sign in with your saved Gmail account
documents.summary: Gmail refused to sign in to the Gmail account saved for this task, so SMTO couldn't open your mailbox. Most often the app password no longer works, but Gmail didn't say exactly why.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0051 — Gmail refused to sign in with your saved Gmail account

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0052 — The selected Gateway can't handle Gmail for this account
documents.summary: Gmail accounts saved with an app password are reached through a Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to run work on a computer. The Gateway for this task is missing, offline, or too old to do this.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0052 — The selected Gateway can't handle Gmail for this account

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0053 — Gmail isn't showing a folder or feature SMTO needs
documents.summary: To do this safely, SMTO needs Gmail to show certain folders, such as All Mail, Drafts and Trash, and some mailbox features to email apps. One of them isn't available, so SMTO stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0053 — Gmail isn't showing a folder or feature SMTO needs

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0054 — This Gmail action needs an account that signs in through Google
documents.summary: Your Gmail account is connected with an app password. That lets SMTO read, send and organize mail, but not manage filters, label colors or visibility, or Gmail's built-in folders as labels. SMTO didn't make this change.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0054 — This Gmail action needs an account that signs in through Google

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0055 — The email or draft changed since SMTO selected it
documents.summary: SMTO went back to the email or draft it had picked, but it had been edited, sent, deleted, or could no longer be told apart from another item. SMTO stopped so it wouldn't act on the wrong mail.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0055 — The email or draft changed since SMTO selected it

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0056 — The connection to Gmail was lost before the action finished
documents.summary: SMTO's connection to Gmail broke, took too long, or was stopped while it was working. If the request was sending or changing mail, it may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0056 — The connection to Gmail was lost before the action finished

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0057 — SMTO couldn't confirm that a Gmail change was completed
documents.summary: Gmail rejected or didn't confirm part of this request, such as saving a draft, applying a change, or removing an old draft. Some parts may already be done even though the whole request didn't finish.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0057 — SMTO couldn't confirm that a Gmail change was completed

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0058 — This Gmail request was too large to handle at once
documents.summary: The search results, email thread, attachment, or data passed between SMTO and the Gateway was bigger than SMTO allows, or didn't arrive complete. SMTO stopped rather than use partial mail.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0058 — This Gmail request was too large to handle at once

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0059 — That Gmail label can't be created, renamed or deleted
documents.summary: SMTO can only create, rename or delete your own Gmail labels. The label you asked about is one of Gmail's built-in folders, such as Inbox or Sent, or the new name isn't allowed. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0059 — That Gmail label can't be created, renamed or deleted

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0060 — Too many emails match this request
documents.summary: More emails matched than one request can handle (at most 50,000, or a lower limit if one was set). SMTO stopped before changing any email for this request.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0060 — Too many emails match this request

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0061 — Some chosen emails aren't in the folder you named
documents.summary: SMTO was given specific emails to change, but at least one isn't in the folder the request was limited to, for example it's in Spam or Trash. SMTO stopped before changing any of them.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0061 — Some chosen emails aren't in the folder you named

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0062 — SMTO needs a valid label or category for these emails
documents.summary: The request to label, move or recategorize emails didn't name a usable destination: no label was given, more than one label was given for a move, or the category isn't one of Gmail's tabs. No email was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0062 — SMTO needs a valid label or category for these emails

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0063 — The Gateway for this Gmail account needs an update
documents.summary: This Gmail account signs in with an app password, so SMTO reaches it through a Gateway (the helper program that runs work on a computer). That Gateway is too old for this email action, so SMTO stopped before changing any email.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0063 — The Gateway for this Gmail account needs an update

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0064 — This filter can't be applied to emails you already have
documents.summary: SMTO can apply a filter to emails you already have only if it matches simple things like sender or subject and only changes labels. This filter forwards mail, uses an unsupported condition, or has conflicting label changes. Nothing was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0064 — This filter can't be applied to emails you already have

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0065 — SMTO can't change this Gmail setting
documents.summary: SMTO can change only a few Gmail settings: the vacation auto-reply, display language, IMAP and POP access, and your main address's name, reply-to address and signature. The setting or value you asked for isn't one of these, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0065 — SMTO can't change this Gmail setting

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0066 — SMTO needs an .eml email file to import
documents.summary: Importing into Gmail works only with a saved email file whose name ends in .eml and that contains a real email. The file given was empty, a different type, or didn't look like an email, so nothing was imported.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0066 — SMTO needs an .eml email file to import

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0067 — Too many emails to export as separate files
documents.summary: Exporting as separate .eml files allows at most 100 emails, and more were selected. SMTO stopped before creating any export files.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0067 — Too many emails to export as separate files

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0068 — Some emails didn't end up the way SMTO expected
documents.summary: SMTO changed your emails, but when it checked afterward, some weren't in the expected state, for example another app or a Gmail filter moved them again. Changes Gmail confirmed are kept; nothing is repeated automatically.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0068 — Some emails didn't end up the way SMTO expected

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0069 — SMTO changed only some of the emails you selected
documents.summary: Gmail accepted the change for some of the selected emails but not all of them, so SMTO stopped partway. Emails Gmail confirmed stay changed; for a few, SMTO may not know whether the change happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0069 — SMTO changed only some of the emails you selected

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0070 — SMTO can't do that Gmail action
documents.summary: SMTO's Gmail connection has no way to do what was asked. Some Gmail features, such as snooze, scheduled send, mute, block sender, unsubscribe and confidential mode, aren't available to SMTO. No email was changed by this request.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0070 — SMTO can't do that Gmail action

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0071 — SMTO can't send from that email address
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to send from a different address than the account's main one, but Gmail hasn't confirmed this account is allowed to use that address. Nothing was drafted or sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0071 — SMTO can't send from that email address

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0072 — SMTO stopped to avoid doing the same email action twice
documents.summary: Earlier in this Task, SMTO already started this same reply, email import or filter. Doing it again could send a second reply, import a duplicate email or make a second filter, so SMTO stopped. The earlier attempt may have worked.
