headings.title: SMTO-GML-0072 — SMTO stopped to avoid doing the same email action twice

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0073 — SMTO couldn't find that email conversation
documents.summary: SMTO searched the folders it can see in this Gmail account, including Spam and Trash, and found no emails in that conversation. It may have been deleted, or it belongs to a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0073 — SMTO couldn't find that email conversation

documents.title: SMTO-GML-0074 — Gmail turned the connection away before sign-in finished
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open your Gmail mailbox, but Gmail refused the connection before sign-in completed. This doesn't prove your app password is wrong, and no mail was touched in this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-GML-0074 — Gmail turned the connection away before sign-in finished

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0001 — Agent unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach the computer you picked to do this work, so your new request didn't start. Work sent to that computer in earlier tasks may still have run.

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0002 — Gateway unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach the computer chosen for this task, so it stopped before sending the next step there. Steps sent before this check may already have run.

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0003 — Gateway node does not match
documents.summary: SMTO reached a computer at the saved address, but that computer says it's a different machine from the one picked for this job. It turned the request down without doing anything.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0003 — Gateway node does not match

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0004 — SMTO couldn't tell what system the Gateway computer runs
documents.summary: The computer's Gateway didn't tell SMTO which operating system it runs, so SMTO couldn't use it for this work. The saved message doesn't say exactly why.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0004 — SMTO couldn't tell what system the Gateway computer runs

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0005 — Gateway unauthorized
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't prove it is allowed to do this, so the step was blocked. When a Gateway was the one that refused, it did not carry out the request.

headings.title: Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0006 — SMTO got a message from the Gateway it couldn't trust
documents.summary: A message between SMTO and the computer came back garbled, too large, or in an unexpected form. If a task was running, SMTO can't tell whether its last step happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0006 — SMTO got a message from the Gateway it couldn't trust
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0007 — SMTO couldn't confirm the computer got your stop or input request
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to stop work, or to type into a terminal on that computer, but no clear answer came back. The original work may still be running.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0007 — SMTO couldn't confirm the computer got your stop or input request
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0008 — SMTO couldn't load the saved identity it uses with Gateways
documents.summary: Your Gateways recognize SMTO by a security key saved on this computer. SMTO couldn't read that key, so it didn't send this request and can't use your Gateways until the key is back.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0008 — SMTO couldn't load the saved identity it uses with Gateways

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0009 — This Gateway is already linked to an SMTO
documents.summary: Each Gateway trusts only one SMTO. This one already trusts an SMTO with a different identity (another SMTO, or this one before a reinstall), so it refused this link and changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0009 — This Gateway is already linked to an SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0010 — SMTO couldn't set up a secure link to the Gateway
documents.summary: Before sending work, SMTO needs a secure, verified link to the computer. Those checks didn't finish, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0010 — SMTO couldn't set up a secure link to the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0011 — The Gateway refused a request that changed on the way
documents.summary: The Gateway checks that every request arrives exactly as SMTO sent it. This one didn't match, so the Gateway refused it and did nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0011 — The Gateway refused a request that changed on the way

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0012 — The Gateway trusts a different SMTO than this one
documents.summary: This Gateway remembers a different SMTO from the one now connecting, so it refused the request. Nothing was run on that computer.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0012 — The Gateway trusts a different SMTO than this one

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0013 — Gateway identity changed
documents.summary: The computer at this Gateway's address now shows a different security identity from the one SMTO saved. SMTO stopped so it doesn't send work to a computer it can't vouch for.

headings.title: Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0014 — The Gateway is handling too many requests right now
documents.summary: For safety, the Gateway keeps a short list of every request from the last couple of minutes. That list is full, so it refused this request without running it.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0014 — The Gateway is handling too many requests right now

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0015 — Too many attempts to link with this Gateway
documents.summary: The Gateway allows only 30 attempts per minute to link a new SMTO. That limit was reached, so it ignored this attempt and changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0015 — Too many attempts to link with this Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0016 — The Gateway couldn't read or save its security records
documents.summary: The Gateway keeps files that remember which SMTO it trusts and which requests it has already seen. It couldn't read or save one of them, so it refused the request and ran nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0016 — The Gateway couldn't read or save its security records

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0017 — SMTO couldn't prepare a request for the Gateway
documents.summary: SMTO built a request in a form it couldn't securely sign, so it stopped before sending anything to the computer. This is a problem inside SMTO, not something you did.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0017 — SMTO couldn't prepare a request for the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0018 — The Gateway refused a request it had already received
documents.summary: The Gateway received the exact same request a second time and refused the copy. The first copy may already have done its work.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0018 — The Gateway refused a request it had already received

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0019 — The request to the Gateway was too large
documents.summary: SMTO tried to send more data to the computer in one request than the Gateway accepts, so the Gateway refused it before doing anything.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0019 — The request to the Gateway was too large

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0020 — The Gateway isn't linked to SMTO yet
documents.summary: The Gateway doesn't trust any SMTO right now, often because its link was reset on that computer. It refused this request, so nothing ran there.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0020 — The Gateway isn't linked to SMTO yet

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0021 — The Gateway refused a request because the clocks don't match
documents.summary: Every request SMTO sends to the Gateway is stamped with the time. The Gateway's clock and the SMTO server's clock disagree by more than a minute, so the request was refused and nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0021 — The Gateway refused a request because the clocks don't match

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0022 — SMTO couldn't confirm a secure connection to the Gateway
documents.summary: SMTO checks the Gateway's security certificate before sending it any work. That check failed, so SMTO stopped before sending anything and no command ran.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0022 — SMTO couldn't confirm a secure connection to the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0023 — The Gateway computer changed before SMTO's next step
documents.summary: While SMTO was deciding what to do next, the setup on the Gateway computer changed, for example after an update or restart. SMTO didn't run that step and needs to choose it again.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0023 — The Gateway computer changed before SMTO's next step

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0024 — The chosen Gateway can't be found or isn't set up correctly
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't match this request to a Gateway it can use. The Gateway may have been deleted, turned off or renamed, or a saved item still points to an old one.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0024 — The chosen Gateway can't be found or isn't set up correctly

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0025 — The Gateway turned down this request
documents.summary: The Gateway received SMTO's request but answered with an error instead of doing it. Often nothing ran, but for some settings changes SMTO can't be sure.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0025 — The Gateway turned down this request

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0026 — Gateway job control unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach a background job it started on the Gateway to check on it or control it. The job may still be running, or may have finished, even though this check failed.

headings.title: Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0027 — SMTO doesn't know whether the Gateway finished this action
documents.summary: SMTO sent the action to the Gateway but never got a clear answer back. The action may already have run and changed something, so SMTO did not try it again.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0027 — SMTO doesn't know whether the Gateway finished this action
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0028 — SMTO doesn't know how to reach this computer yet
documents.summary: The computer you chose is listed in SMTO, but SMTO has not yet learned its network name, so it can't send work there. Your request was not sent to it.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0028 — SMTO doesn't know how to reach this computer yet

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0029 — Gateway is disabled
documents.summary: The computer chosen for this work is switched off as a target in SMTO's Gateway list, so SMTO won't send work to it. Your request was not sent.

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0030 — A computer couldn't accept a file copy instruction
documents.summary: While copying a file between two computers, SMTO sent a copy instruction that the receiving Gateway could not accept, so that step was not carried out. Earlier steps of the same copy may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0030 — A computer couldn't accept a file copy instruction

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0031 — SMTO lost track of whether a file copy step finished
documents.summary: SMTO lost contact with a computer in the middle of copying a file, so it can't tell whether that step happened. The destination file may already be partly or fully changed. SMTO did not try again on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0031 — SMTO lost track of whether a file copy step finished
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0032 — A computer refused one step of a file copy
documents.summary: While SMTO was copying a file between two computers, the Gateway on one of them refused a step, so SMTO stopped the copy. Earlier steps may already have written part of the file at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0032 — A computer refused one step of a file copy

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0033 — The list of computers for this request isn't valid
documents.summary: SMTO checks which computers a request should run on before starting. The list it received didn't add up, for example no computer, more than 16, one listed twice, or a main computer that isn't in the list. Nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0033 — The list of computers for this request isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0034 — Your message names a different computer than the one selected
documents.summary: Your message mentions a computer by name that isn't the one chosen for the request, or mentions several computers when SMTO needed exactly one. SMTO won't guess which you meant, so nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0034 — Your message names a different computer than the one selected

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0035 — SMTO has no working way to reach the chosen computer
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a working connection to the computer this work should run on. It may not be set up, may be switched off in SMTO, or, for a computer that connects to SMTO itself, may not be connected right now.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0035 — SMTO has no working way to reach the chosen computer

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0036 — That computer name can't be used
documents.summary: Each computer in SMTO needs its own short, readable name. The name given was empty, looked like a web or network address, or is already used by another computer, so it wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0036 — That computer name can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0037 — This computer's connection is managed from that computer
documents.summary: This computer connects to SMTO on its own (an Outbound Gateway). Its connection settings and security identity are controlled on that computer, so SMTO refused to change them from here. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0037 — This computer's connection is managed from that computer

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0038 — SMTO can't safely send sign-in details through this computer yet
documents.summary: Before SMTO hands a computer any sign-in details for a website or service, it checks that the connection to that computer is trusted and ready. That check failed, so SMTO stopped before asking for or sending those details.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0038 — SMTO can't safely send sign-in details through this computer yet

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0039 — This computer can't do that kind of work as asked
documents.summary: The Gateway on the chosen computer couldn't handle this request, for example running something with administrator rights, opening a live terminal, or a particular file action. Usually its Gateway is out of date or doesn't offer that feature.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0039 — This computer can't do that kind of work as asked

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0040 — The terminal this step needs isn't open
documents.summary: This step needed a specific terminal window (a command line on the computer), but that terminal was closed or had stopped. The step may have been partly sent before the terminal went away.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0040 — The terminal this step needs isn't open

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0041 — This computer isn't set up to run local AI models
documents.summary: SMTO asked this computer to start or manage a local AI model, but its Gateway has that feature switched off. It is off by default on Windows and Mac computers. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0041 — This computer isn't set up to run local AI models

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0042 — Part of this computer's Gateway installation is missing or broken
documents.summary: When the Gateway on this computer was installed or checked, one of its required parts failed its test. Features that need that part, such as the web browser, documents or charts, may not work there until it is repaired.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0042 — Part of this computer's Gateway installation is missing or broken

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0043 — The model wasn't started because the Gateway is restarting
documents.summary: SMTO asked this computer to start an AI model while the Gateway there (the helper program SMTO uses on that computer) was in the middle of restarting. This request did not start the model.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0043 — The model wasn't started because the Gateway is restarting

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0044 — A running AI model is stopping this Gateway from restarting
documents.summary: SMTO tried to restart the Gateway on this computer, but an AI model the Gateway manages is still running there. To avoid cutting that model off, the Gateway did not restart.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0044 — A running AI model is stopping this Gateway from restarting

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0045 — A model start request didn't say how to start the model
documents.summary: Something asked this computer's Gateway to start an AI model with its older built-in starter but didn't include the command that starts the model. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0045 — A model start request didn't say how to start the model

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0046 — SMTO couldn't record the progress of a file copy
documents.summary: While copying a file between computers, SMTO couldn't save how far the copy had got, so it stopped. Depending on when it stopped, part or all of the file may already be at the destination.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0046 — SMTO couldn't record the progress of a file copy

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0047 — A file copy stopped because its conversation or Task was deleted
documents.summary: SMTO was copying a file between two computers, but the conversation or Task that started the copy was deleted, so SMTO stopped the copy. The file may or may not have reached its destination.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0047 — A file copy stopped because its conversation or Task was deleted

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0048 — SMTO couldn't confirm that a Gateway restarted
documents.summary: SMTO asked a Gateway (the helper program that runs work on another computer) to restart, but its reply was missing or unreadable. It may be restarting now, or it may never have received the request.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0048 — SMTO couldn't confirm that a Gateway restarted

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0049 — SMTO couldn't keep up with a command's output
documents.summary: A command running on a Gateway computer sent output faster than SMTO could read it, or sent one very large piece, so SMTO stopped reading. The command itself may still have run, or may still be running.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0049 — SMTO couldn't keep up with a command's output

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0050 — This Gateway is added by SMTO's startup settings and can't be deleted
documents.summary: This Gateway comes from the settings SMTO reads when it starts, so deleting it here wouldn't last; it would be added back the next time SMTO starts. Nothing was deleted or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0050 — This Gateway is added by SMTO's startup settings and can't be deleted

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0051 — SMTO couldn't find the Gateway computer by its name
documents.summary: SMTO looked up the Gateway computer's name on the network and got no address back, so it couldn't connect. This request was not sent to the Gateway.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0051 — SMTO couldn't find the Gateway computer by its name

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0052 — The Gateway computer refused SMTO's connection
documents.summary: SMTO reached the Gateway's computer, but nothing there accepted the connection. Usually the Gateway program isn't running or the port number is wrong. This request was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0052 — The Gateway computer refused SMTO's connection

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0053 — SMTO has no network path to the Gateway computer
documents.summary: The computer running SMTO can't reach the Gateway computer's network at all right now, so no connection was made and this request was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0053 — SMTO has no network path to the Gateway computer

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0054 — The Gateway computer didn't answer in time
documents.summary: SMTO tried to connect to the Gateway but heard nothing back before it gave up. The computer may be off or asleep, or a firewall may be silently blocking it. This request was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0054 — The Gateway computer didn't answer in time

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0055 — SMTO couldn't connect to the Gateway
documents.summary: Connecting to the Gateway failed for a network reason SMTO couldn't pin down. This request was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0055 — SMTO couldn't connect to the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0056 — File transfer did not complete
documents.summary: SMTO was copying a file from one Gateway computer to another, and the copy stopped before it finished. The file at the destination was not replaced.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0056 — File transfer did not complete

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0057 — An interrupted file copy was cancelled, so nothing was copied
documents.summary: A file copy between two computers was interrupted. When SMTO picked the work back up, it safely cancelled the unfinished copy. The destination file was not created or replaced.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0057 — An interrupted file copy was cancelled, so nothing was copied

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0058 — The Gateway couldn't run the NVIDIA GPU tool
documents.summary: SMTO uses NVIDIA's own tool (nvidia-smi) to read and change GPU settings on the Gateway computer. The Gateway couldn't find or start that tool, so the GPU action didn't complete.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0058 — The Gateway couldn't run the NVIDIA GPU tool

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0059 — The NVIDIA GPU driver reported a problem
documents.summary: The NVIDIA tool on the Gateway computer stopped with a driver error. If you asked for a GPU setting change, that error doesn't always prove whether the change took effect.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0059 — The NVIDIA GPU driver reported a problem

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0060 — SMTO can't find that GPU on the Gateway
documents.summary: The GPU you asked about isn't in the list of GPUs the Gateway computer can see right now. It may have been removed, renumbered or be on another Gateway. SMTO didn't change any GPU settings.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0060 — SMTO can't find that GPU on the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0061 — SMTO couldn't confirm it was still the same GPU
documents.summary: SMTO stopped because it couldn't be sure the GPU it was working on stayed the same throughout, for example because GPU numbers changed. For a settings change, SMTO stopped before making it.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0061 — SMTO couldn't confirm it was still the same GPU

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0062 — Your graphics card doesn't support this action
documents.summary: The graphics card (GPU) or its driver on that computer doesn't offer this feature, so SMTO didn't do it. No GPU settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0062 — Your graphics card doesn't support this action

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0063 — SMTO isn't allowed to change this GPU's settings
documents.summary: The computer account that SMTO's Gateway runs under doesn't have permission to change graphics card settings, so the card refused the change. No GPU settings were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0063 — SMTO isn't allowed to change this GPU's settings

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0064 — SMTO can't change this GPU's power limit
documents.summary: This graphics card didn't report its full allowed power range (lowest, highest and default), so SMTO won't change its power setting. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0064 — SMTO can't change this GPU's power limit

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0065 — That power limit is outside what this GPU allows
documents.summary: You asked for a power level lower or higher than this graphics card accepts right now. SMTO doesn't round it to the nearest allowed value, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0065 — That power limit is outside what this GPU allows

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0066 — This GPU's speed settings can't be changed through SMTO
documents.summary: Locking or resetting this graphics card's clock speed (how fast its processor or memory runs) isn't supported on this card, driver or computer. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0066 — This GPU's speed settings can't be changed through SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0067 — That clock speed isn't one this GPU supports
documents.summary: The lowest or highest speed you asked for isn't on this graphics card's list of supported speeds, or the lowest was set above the highest. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0067 — That clock speed isn't one this GPU supports

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0068 — SMTO can't change this GPU's compute mode
documents.summary: The compute mode controls whether several programs can share the graphics card. This card or its driver doesn't let SMTO change it, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0068 — SMTO can't change this GPU's compute mode

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0069 — Programs are still using this GPU, so it wasn't reset
documents.summary: SMTO found programs still running on this graphics card. Resetting it now would cut off their work, so SMTO stopped first. The GPU was not reset.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0069 — Programs are still using this GPU, so it wasn't reset

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0070 — SMTO can't safely reset this GPU
documents.summary: SMTO only resets a graphics card when it can confirm the reset is supported and safe on that computer. It couldn't confirm that here, so the GPU was not reset.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0070 — SMTO can't safely reset this GPU

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0071 — A GPU reset may not have finished cleanly
documents.summary: SMTO recorded that this graphics card didn't come back as expected after a reset. That doesn't prove the card is broken, but its current state hasn't been checked yet.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0071 — A GPU reset may not have finished cleanly

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0072 — SMTO can't split this GPU into MIG instances
documents.summary: MIG lets some NVIDIA cards be divided into several smaller GPUs. SMTO's GPU skill can show whether MIG is on, but it can't change MIG settings. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0072 — SMTO can't split this GPU into MIG instances

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0073 — The GPU is busy with other work right now
documents.summary: SMTO didn't make this GPU change because something else is using the card: a Local AI model is starting or running, another GPU change is in progress, or too many GPU requests are active. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0073 — The GPU is busy with other work right now

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0074 — This GPU readings request asks for too much at once
documents.summary: SMTO takes repeated GPU readings for at most 5 minutes and 120 readings at a time, spaced 0.5 to 60 seconds apart. This request went past those limits, so no readings were taken.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0074 — This GPU readings request asks for too much at once

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0075 — The GPU action was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: A stop request reached this GPU action before it was done. If it was a settings change, the change may or may not have taken effect.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0075 — The GPU action was stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0076 — The GPU action took too long to finish
documents.summary: SMTO stopped waiting because this GPU action ran out of time. If it was a settings change, it may or may not have happened, and NVIDIA's tool might still be running.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0076 — The GPU action took too long to finish

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0077 — SMTO can't tell whether the GPU change happened
documents.summary: SMTO sent the change to the graphics card but couldn't confirm the result. It may have happened fully, partly or not at all, and SMTO may keep this GPU marked as busy until it is checked.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0077 — SMTO can't tell whether the GPU change happened

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0078 — SMTO couldn't understand this GPU request
documents.summary: SMTO's GPU skill only accepts a fixed set of actions, each with specific details. This request didn't fit one of them, or went to a different computer than intended, so nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0078 — SMTO couldn't understand this GPU request

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0079 — SMTO got an unreadable answer from the GPU
documents.summary: The answer from NVIDIA's tool or the Gateway was too large or not in the expected form, so SMTO couldn't trust it. If you asked for a change, it may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0079 — SMTO got an unreadable answer from the GPU

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0080 — SMTO lost contact with the Gateway during a GPU action
documents.summary: SMTO didn't get a usable answer from the computer with the GPU. The request may have been refused, or it may already have run there; a stop request may also not have arrived.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0080 — SMTO lost contact with the Gateway during a GPU action

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0081 — This GPU request was already sent once
documents.summary: SMTO received a GPU request it had already seen, or one it couldn't record as new. The first copy may have run, so SMTO didn't run it again.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0081 — This GPU request was already sent once

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0082 — Confirmation Required
documents.summary: SMTO stopped a request to reset a graphics card (GPU) because you had not approved that exact reset. The GPU was not reset.

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0083 — The Gateway stopped a job because its access changed
documents.summary: Between accepting the job and starting it, the Gateway's permission for SMTO changed or the job was stopped. The Gateway did not start it.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0083 — The Gateway stopped a job because its access changed

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0084 — The Gateway couldn't trust a message from one of its jobs
documents.summary: On the Gateway computer, the main Gateway program and a helper running your job sent each other a message that didn't check out. The Gateway ignored it, so it can't fully trust what it knows about that job.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0084 — The Gateway couldn't trust a message from one of its jobs

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0085 — A job on the Gateway lost contact with the Gateway
documents.summary: Each job on the Gateway computer reports back to the main Gateway program. This job couldn't reach it. The job itself may still be running.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0085 — A job on the Gateway lost contact with the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0086 — The Gateway's saved job records failed a safety check
documents.summary: The Gateway keeps records of the jobs it has run. While loading, backing up or restoring those records, one didn't pass a safety check, so the Gateway won't use them. A destination problem doesn't mean the records are damaged.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0086 — The Gateway's saved job records failed a safety check

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0087 — The Gateway's private files aren't protected the way they must be
documents.summary: The Gateway keeps private files, such as its job records and security keys, that only its own user account may touch. Some of them have the wrong owner or permissions, so the Gateway won't use them.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0087 — The Gateway's private files aren't protected the way they must be

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0088 — The Gateway is at its limit for jobs or saved data
documents.summary: The Gateway limits how many jobs it runs at once, how much job history it keeps, and how big one request can be. This request would go over a limit, so the Gateway turned it down.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0088 — The Gateway is at its limit for jobs or saved data

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0089 — The Gateway's data is in use or the Gateway is shutting down
documents.summary: Only one copy of the Gateway may use its data folder at a time. Another copy is using it, or the Gateway is still shutting down, so this one can't take new work or start.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0089 — The Gateway's data is in use or the Gateway is shutting down

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0090 — The Gateway is waiting for a data cleanup to finish
documents.summary: Someone started deleting old runtime data on the server and its Gateways. Until that cleanup finishes on this Gateway, it refuses new work. This request was not run.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0090 — The Gateway is waiting for a data cleanup to finish

documents.title: SMTO-GWT-0091 — This work started before the Gateway's data was cleared
documents.summary: This work was started before runtime data was cleared on this Gateway, so the Gateway won't accept its requests anymore. This request was refused before it ran; earlier steps of the same work may already have run.

headings.title: SMTO-GWT-0091 — This work started before the Gateway's data was cleared

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0001 — This sign-in method isn't available on the Gateway
documents.summary: This HTTP Connection uses a sign-in method, such as NTLM or Negotiate (Kerberos), that the Gateway computer can't load. SMTO stopped before sending your request.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0001 — This sign-in method isn't available on the Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0002 — The sign-in reply didn't include what SMTO needed
documents.summary: SMTO signed in to the service, but the reply was missing a value this connection expects, such as a session cookie or token, or wasn't in a usable form. Your main request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0002 — The sign-in reply didn't include what SMTO needed

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0003 — Signing in to the service took too long
documents.summary: Before sending your request, SMTO tried to sign in to the service, but the sign-in didn't finish in time. Your main request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0003 — Signing in to the service took too long

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0004 — SMTO couldn't reach the service's sign-in address
documents.summary: While signing in to the service before your request, the network connection to its sign-in address failed. Your main request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0004 — SMTO couldn't reach the service's sign-in address

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0005 — Some sign-in details aren't in a form SMTO can use
documents.summary: A sign-in detail for this HTTP Connection was rejected before anything was sent, for example a username containing a colon (:), or a sign-in field the connection doesn't have.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0005 — Some sign-in details aren't in a form SMTO can use

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0006 — The service requires a client certificate
documents.summary: This service only accepts connections that present their own security certificate, and this HTTP Connection doesn't have a working one set up. Your request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0006 — The service requires a client certificate

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0007 — SMTO tried to use an HTTP connection the wrong way
documents.summary: SMTO's assistant asked to contact a service without setting up the connection the right way first, for example by mixing connection settings into a request. SMTO stopped it before anything was sent and normally corrects it on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0007 — SMTO tried to use an HTTP connection the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0008 — This HTTP Connection's settings changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: Someone edited this saved HTTP Connection, or the Task moved to a different Gateway, after SMTO had connected with it, so SMTO stopped using the old settings. The request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0008 — This HTTP Connection's settings changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0009 — This run's HTTP connections have already been closed
documents.summary: SMTO tried to set up a connection to a service for a run that had already ended, been stopped or been cleaned up, so it refused. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0009 — This run's HTTP connections have already been closed

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0010 — This task has connected to too many web services
documents.summary: One task can keep up to 32 different web service connections, and this task has used them all. The new connection wasn't made; work already done in this task is unaffected.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0010 — This task has connected to too many web services

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0011 — SMTO couldn't find the web service connection it tried to use
documents.summary: SMTO tried to use a web service connection that isn't open in this task, so this request wasn't sent. This happens when the connection never finished setting up or was made in an earlier task.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0011 — SMTO couldn't find the web service connection it tried to use

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0012 — The request went to a different website than its connection
documents.summary: Each web service connection only works with the one website address it was set up for. SMTO tried to use it for a different address, so the request was blocked and not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0012 — The request went to a different website than its connection

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0013 — This connection belongs to a different task or Gateway
documents.summary: SMTO tried to use a web service connection made for another task, or on a different Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to reach other computers and services). The request was blocked and not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0013 — This connection belongs to a different task or Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0014 — SMTO couldn't find the file to send to the web service
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to send a file to a web service, but that file isn't available in this conversation. Nothing was uploaded.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0014 — SMTO couldn't find the file to send to the web service

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0015 — The Gateway refused to send a web request
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to reach other computers and services) turned down SMTO's web request before contacting the service. The service wasn't reached, so nothing changed there.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0015 — The Gateway refused to send a web request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0016 — Access to the web service was not granted
documents.summary: When SMTO asked permission to use your account on the web service, the request was declined, so SMTO couldn't connect. SMTO did not use the service with your account.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0016 — Access to the web service was not granted

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0017 — The sign-in for the web service expired
documents.summary: SMTO asked you to sign in to a web service, but the sign-in wasn't finished before its time ran out. SMTO didn't connect and didn't use the service with your account.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0017 — The sign-in for the web service expired

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0018 — SMTO couldn't match this sign-in to its request
documents.summary: The web service sent back a sign-in that doesn't match the one SMTO is waiting for, for example from an older or already-used sign-in link. SMTO ignored it for your safety and didn't connect.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0018 — SMTO couldn't match this sign-in to its request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0019 — A saved web service connection has settings SMTO can't use
documents.summary: SMTO checked the settings of a saved web service connection and found one that is missing, conflicts with another, or isn't supported, so it didn't use the connection.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0019 — A saved web service connection has settings SMTO can't use

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0020 — SMTO used another name instead of the connection's exact name
documents.summary: SMTO looked up a saved web service connection by a nickname or a slightly different spelling. For safety, SMTO only uses a saved connection when asked for it by its exact name, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0020 — SMTO used another name instead of the connection's exact name

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0021 — SMTO couldn't find the saved web service connection
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a saved web service connection with the name it was given, but no saved connection has that name. Nothing was sent to the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0021 — SMTO couldn't find the saved web service connection

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0022 — The request points to a website outside the saved connection
documents.summary: A saved connection only allows its own website address and any extra addresses approved in its settings. SMTO tried to send a request or sign in somewhere else, so it was blocked and nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0022 — The request points to a website outside the saved connection

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0023 — SMTO can't reach your saved web service connections
documents.summary: This task needs a saved web service connection, but Parameter Store, where SMTO keeps those connections, is turned off or not available right now. Nothing was sent to the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0023 — SMTO can't reach your saved web service connections

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0024 — Signed in, but SMTO couldn't find the session it needs
documents.summary: The web service accepted the login, but its reply didn't include the session cookie or value the saved connection tells SMTO to look for. Your password was not rejected; the connection's login settings need adjusting.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0024 — Signed in, but SMTO couldn't find the session it needs

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0025 — The selected Gateway can't make web requests
documents.summary: SMTO sends web service requests through a Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to reach other computers and services). No connected Gateway that supports this is selected, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0025 — The selected Gateway can't make web requests

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0026 — The file couldn't be prepared for upload
documents.summary: SMTO tried to upload a file to a web service, but the Gateway (the helper program that sends SMTO's web requests) got file data it couldn't use, or files too large together. Nothing was uploaded.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0026 — The file couldn't be prepared for upload

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0027 — The files are too large to upload in one request
documents.summary: SMTO can upload only about 8 MB in one web request, counting the files and any form details sent with them. This upload was larger than that, so nothing was uploaded.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0027 — The files are too large to upload in one request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0028 — SMTO formatted the data for a web request the wrong way
documents.summary: SMTO packed the data for a web request as a single block of text instead of separate fields, so the service would have misread it. The request was stopped before sending, so nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0028 — SMTO formatted the data for a web request the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0029 — The web service took too long to respond
documents.summary: The web service didn't answer before SMTO's time limit. If the request was meant to change something, it may or may not have gone through.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0029 — The web service took too long to respond

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0030 — SMTO couldn't find the web address it tried to reach
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run work on a computer) couldn't look up the name of the website or service, so the request never reached it.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0030 — SMTO couldn't find the web address it tried to reach

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0031 — The service SMTO tried to reach turned the connection away
documents.summary: SMTO's Gateway reached the computer at that address, but nothing there was accepting connections. The request was not delivered.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0031 — The service SMTO tried to reach turned the connection away

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0032 — SMTO's web request didn't get a usable answer
documents.summary: The connection broke or the answer couldn't be read, and SMTO couldn't tell exactly why. The request may already have reached the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0032 — SMTO's web request didn't get a usable answer

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0033 — SMTO couldn't unpack the service's reply
documents.summary: The service answered, but it compressed its reply in a way SMTO can't open, so SMTO didn't use it. If the request was meant to change something, the service may have done it.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0033 — SMTO couldn't unpack the service's reply

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0034 — SMTO only got part of the service's reply
documents.summary: The service's answer stopped partway through or took too long to finish, so SMTO can't trust what arrived. The service may still have carried out the request.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0034 — SMTO only got part of the service's reply
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0035 — The service's reply was too large for SMTO to accept
documents.summary: The service sent more data than this request is allowed to receive, so SMTO stopped reading partway through and didn't use the reply as the answer.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0035 — The service's reply was too large for SMTO to accept

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0036 — This connection needs sign-in details before SMTO can use it
documents.summary: The saved connection is missing a password, key or other sign-in value, or the service asked for sign-in and none was given. SMTO can't use the service until those details are added.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0036 — This connection needs sign-in details before SMTO can use it

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0037 — The service didn't accept SMTO's sign-in
documents.summary: The service turned down the sign-in or its access check. That can mean wrong details, missing permission, or a reply SMTO couldn't understand; the reply doesn't say which.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0037 — The service didn't accept SMTO's sign-in
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0038 — SMTO couldn't find the service's sign-in address
documents.summary: The address SMTO uses to sign in doesn't exist on the service. This usually means the sign-in address is wrong, not that your password is.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0038 — SMTO couldn't find the service's sign-in address
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0039 — The service's sign-in address won't accept SMTO's request
documents.summary: SMTO reached the sign-in address, but the service said it doesn't accept that type of request there. This points to a wrong sign-in address or setup, not a wrong password.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0039 — The service's sign-in address won't accept SMTO's request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0040 — The service rejected SMTO's sign-in request
documents.summary: The service refused the sign-in because something in the request was wrong or missing, or because there were too many attempts. Its reply doesn't say exactly which.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0040 — The service rejected SMTO's sign-in request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0041 — The service's sign-in system is having a problem
documents.summary: SMTO reached the service's sign-in address, but the service reported a fault on its own side. Changing your sign-in details won't fix this.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0041 — The service's sign-in system is having a problem

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0042 — The service's sign-in reply wasn't one SMTO expected
documents.summary: The sign-in answered with a result this connection isn't set up to count as success, such as sending SMTO on to another page. Your details aren't necessarily wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0042 — The service's sign-in reply wasn't one SMTO expected

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0043 — SMTO couldn't sign in to the service
documents.summary: Signing in to the service failed, but this message comes from an older, general label that doesn't say which part of the sign-in went wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0043 — SMTO couldn't sign in to the service

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0044 — SMTO couldn't confirm the service's security certificate
documents.summary: The service couldn't prove its identity with a certificate SMTO trusts, so SMTO stopped before signing in or sending your request.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0044 — SMTO couldn't confirm the service's security certificate
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0045 — SMTO couldn't set up a secure connection to the service
documents.summary: SMTO and the service couldn't agree on how to secure the connection, so nothing was sent. The exact reason isn't known, and it doesn't mean your sign-in details are wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0045 — SMTO couldn't set up a secure connection to the service

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0046 — The service uses a sign-in type SMTO doesn't support
documents.summary: The service's sign-in gave SMTO a special kind of access pass that it can't use. SMTO only supports the common Bearer type.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0046 — The service uses a sign-in type SMTO doesn't support

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0047 — SMTO's web request was set up incorrectly
documents.summary: The request the task tried to send had a missing or badly formed part, such as the address or a header. SMTO stopped before sending it.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0047 — SMTO's web request was set up incorrectly

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0048 — SMTO couldn't reach the Gateway to make web requests
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run work on a computer) didn't answer when SMTO checked it was ready for web requests. No sign-in details were sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0048 — SMTO couldn't reach the Gateway to make web requests

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0049 — SMTO's web request was stopped
documents.summary: The request was stopped, either because someone selected Stop or because the same request was already running or had just been stopped. It may already have reached the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0049 — SMTO's web request was stopped
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0050 — SMTO can't tell if your change reached the other service
documents.summary: SMTO sent a request that changes something on another website or service, but the reply was lost or unreadable. The change may or may not have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0050 — SMTO can't tell if your change reached the other service
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0051 — The Gateway couldn't handle this web request
documents.summary: The Gateway, the helper program SMTO uses to reach other services from a computer, rejected or failed this web request, so SMTO didn't get a usable answer back.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0051 — The Gateway couldn't handle this web request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0052 — The Gateway's web request feature isn't working
documents.summary: The Gateway on the selected computer hit an internal problem while preparing or handling a web request, so SMTO didn't get a result.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0052 — The Gateway's web request feature isn't working

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0053 — The Gateway is missing software it needs for web requests
documents.summary: Part of the Gateway's installation is missing, so it can't make web requests until it is repaired. Nothing was sent to the other service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0053 — The Gateway is missing software it needs for web requests

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0054 — The Gateway sent back a reply SMTO couldn't read
documents.summary: The Gateway answered the web request, but its reply was incomplete or in a form SMTO doesn't accept, so SMTO couldn't use the result. This usually means SMTO and the Gateway are on different versions.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0054 — The Gateway sent back a reply SMTO couldn't read

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0055 — This way of changing a saved sign-in is no longer available
documents.summary: Something tried to update a connection's password or key using an older method that SMTO has removed. Nothing was changed; your saved connection is the same as before.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0055 — This way of changing a saved sign-in is no longer available

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0056 — SMTO won't send sign-in details over this Gateway connection
documents.summary: The link between SMTO and the Gateway isn't protected well enough to carry your passwords or keys, so SMTO stopped before sending the web request. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0056 — SMTO won't send sign-in details over this Gateway connection

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0057 — SMTO couldn't accept these connection settings
documents.summary: The web connection you were saving or opening has settings that are missing, unrecognized or in the wrong form, so it wasn't saved or couldn't be opened.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0057 — SMTO couldn't accept these connection settings

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0058 — These connection settings are too large to save
documents.summary: The connection settings you tried to save are larger than SMTO's 1 MB limit, so nothing was saved. This usually means a lot of text, such as a whole web response, was pasted into a field.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0058 — These connection settings are too large to save

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0059 — The Agent didn't use the connection it already set up
documents.summary: SMTO had already set up a working connection to this service and expected the Agent's next step to use it. The Agent asked for something else, so SMTO stopped that step. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0059 — The Agent didn't use the connection it already set up

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0060 — The Agent used a connection that isn't open in this Run
documents.summary: The Agent pointed its web request at a connection this Run doesn't have open; it may be from an earlier Run or simply wrong. SMTO stopped the request, so nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0060 — The Agent used a connection that isn't open in this Run

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0061 — The Agent didn't use the saved connection for this address
documents.summary: SMTO found one saved connection that fits this web address, but the Agent's request didn't choose it. SMTO stopped the request so it isn't sent without the right sign-in. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0061 — The Agent didn't use the saved connection for this address

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0062 — SMTO couldn't reuse a remembered connection setup
documents.summary: SMTO remembers how it connected to a service so later steps can reuse it. That remembered setup didn't check out, so SMTO set it aside and needs to connect again. Your saved connection in Parameter Store wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0062 — SMTO couldn't reuse a remembered connection setup

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0063 — This web request uses an action type SMTO doesn't allow
documents.summary: Every web request has an action type, such as GET to read or POST to send. This one was misspelled, too long, or one SMTO blocks (CONNECT or TRACE), so SMTO didn't send it.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0063 — This web request uses an action type SMTO doesn't allow

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0064 — The web request's content was set up the wrong way
documents.summary: The request tried to send content in more than one form at once, sent content with a read-only request, or had content SMTO couldn't package. SMTO didn't send it.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0064 — The web request's content was set up the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0065 — The web address in this request isn't valid
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use the web address for this request. It may be missing https://, contain spaces or odd characters, or be far too long. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0065 — The web address in this request isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0066 — One of the request's headers isn't allowed
documents.summary: Web requests carry extra labeled details called headers. One of them has an invalid name or value, appears twice, or is one SMTO fills in itself, so the request wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0066 — One of the request's headers isn't allowed

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0067 — This request has too many headers
documents.summary: Web requests can carry at most 64 extra labeled details, called headers, adding up to about 32 KB, including the sign-in details SMTO adds. This request went over that limit, or its headers weren't a simple list, so it wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0067 — This request has too many headers

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0068 — The request's search or form values aren't in a usable form
documents.summary: Search values in a web address and form values must be simple names with plain values, like text, numbers or true/false. This request had values nested inside other values, or invalid ones, so it wasn't sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0068 — The request's search or form values aren't in a usable form

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0069 — The request's data is nested too deeply
documents.summary: The data in this request has more than 64 layers of groups inside groups, which is more than SMTO will send. Nothing was sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0069 — The request's data is nested too deeply

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0070 — SMTO was given two different ways to sign in to a service
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to reach a web service using a saved connection and separate sign-in details at the same time, so it stopped. Nothing was sent to the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0070 — SMTO was given two different ways to sign in to a service

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0071 — The request said one kind of content but carried another
documents.summary: SMTO was about to send data to a web service, but the label describing that data didn't match what was inside. It stopped before sending anything.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0071 — The request said one kind of content but carried another

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0072 — The data SMTO tried to send is too large
documents.summary: SMTO tried to send more than about 1 MB of data in a single request to a web service. It stopped before sending anything and did not cut the data short.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0072 — The data SMTO tried to send is too large

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0073 — A request setting has a value SMTO can't use
documents.summary: One of the settings for a web request, such as how long to wait or how large a reply to accept, was outside what SMTO allows. Nothing was sent to the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0073 — A request setting has a value SMTO can't use

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0074 — A saved sign-in can't add its details to this request
documents.summary: This saved connection signs in and then adds a sign-in value to each request's data. This request's data had no place to put it, so the request was not sent.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0074 — A saved sign-in can't add its details to this request

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0075 — SMTO reached the service, but the connection test didn't pass
documents.summary: SMTO's test request got an answer from the service, but that answer didn't confirm the connection works. The test only reads information, so nothing on the service was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0075 — SMTO reached the service, but the connection test didn't pass

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0076 — The connection's security certificate settings are incomplete
documents.summary: The security certificate settings for this connection are missing a piece or mix two different sources, so SMTO can't use them. Nothing was sent to the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0076 — The connection's security certificate settings are incomplete

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0077 — Sign in to the service so SMTO can continue
documents.summary: This service wants you to approve SMTO's access on its own sign-in page. The task is paused at this step until you finish.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0077 — Sign in to the service so SMTO can continue

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0078 — HTTP request failed
documents.summary: SMTO's request to a web service didn't finish with a usable answer, and SMTO didn't try again on its own. If the request was meant to change something, that change may or may not have happened.

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0079 — The service tried to send SMTO to a different site
documents.summary: The service answered by pointing SMTO to another address. SMTO didn't follow it, so your sign-in details weren't passed to a site this connection doesn't trust.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0079 — The service tried to send SMTO to a different site

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0080 — The service kept redirecting SMTO, so it stopped
documents.summary: The service sent SMTO from one address to another more than five times. SMTO stopped following them so it wouldn't go around in circles.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0080 — The service kept redirecting SMTO, so it stopped

documents.title: SMTO-HTTP-0081 — The service refused access for this account
documents.summary: The service's sign-in check refused access for this account. That doesn't mean the password is wrong; the account may not be allowed to use this part of the service.

headings.title: SMTO-HTTP-0081 — The service refused access for this account
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0001 — SMTO can't tell whether a background job ran
documents.summary: A background job SMTO started on a computer may have started or even finished, but SMTO never got confirmation. Starting it again could do the same work twice.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0001 — SMTO can't tell whether a background job ran
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0002 — This risky step can't run in the background
documents.summary: SMTO tried to run a risky action, such as a delete or restart, as a background job. SMTO only runs risky actions as normal commands, where they can be checked first, so nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0002 — This risky step can't run in the background

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0003 — Another job is still using what this step needs
documents.summary: SMTO didn't run this step because a background job from this task is still working on the same files or resources. Running both at once could make them interfere.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0003 — Another job is still using what this step needs
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0004 — SMTO can't safely stop the job that's in the way
documents.summary: Your command hasn't started because another job is using what it needs. SMTO can't stop that job for you because it can't confirm the job's program is still running under its watch.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0004 — SMTO can't safely stop the job that's in the way

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0005 — The terminal can't open on this computer
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't open a live terminal on this computer. Gateways running directly on Windows don't support it yet, or the page sent a request the Gateway didn't understand.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0005 — The terminal can't open on this computer

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0006 — SMTO can't control that job from this task
documents.summary: SMTO tried to manage a job it can't confirm belongs to this task, or one started by an earlier attempt that it can only look at. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0006 — SMTO can't control that job from this task

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0007 — The Gateway's reply didn't match the job SMTO asked about
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway about a job, but the reply was about a different job or wasn't readable. SMTO set it aside so it wouldn't mix up results.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0007 — The Gateway's reply didn't match the job SMTO asked about

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0008 — SMTO asked for job output in the wrong way
documents.summary: SMTO tried to read part of a background job's output but phrased the request incorrectly. Nothing was changed, and SMTO usually corrects this on its next step.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0008 — SMTO asked for job output in the wrong way

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0009 — SMTO couldn't set up or change this timed wait
documents.summary: The task asked to pause until a time or an event, or you tried to shift a wait, but the request didn't give one clear, valid amount of time or event. No wait was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0009 — SMTO couldn't set up or change this timed wait

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0010 — The task tried to wait for something it hasn't seen
documents.summary: The agent asked to pause until a particular event happened, but that event doesn't appear in anything this task has produced. The wait wasn't set, so the task isn't paused.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0010 — The task tried to wait for something it hasn't seen

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0011 — A background command can't use input sent during the task
documents.summary: The agent tried to start a command as a background job and also hand it some input text directly. A background job can't keep input handed over that way, so SMTO refused it. The command did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0011 — A background command can't use input sent during the task

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0012 — A background time limit was set on a normal command
documents.summary: The agent gave a command a time limit that only applies to background jobs, but the command wasn't set to run in the background. SMTO refused it before starting, so the command did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0012 — A background time limit was set on a normal command

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0013 — The Gateway turned down a background job request
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) to start, read or stop a background job, but the request was incomplete. A refused start did not run; for other requests, the job's status is unknown.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0013 — The Gateway turned down a background job request

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0014 — The Gateway has no record of this background job
documents.summary: SMTO asked the Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) about a background job, but it has no saved record of it. That doesn't prove the job never ran; it may have run on another Gateway.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0014 — The Gateway has no record of this background job

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0015 — Only part of the job's output was shown
documents.summary: This reply shows only part of what the background job printed. The rest may still be in the job's saved log, so you can read it without running anything again.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0015 — Only part of the job's output was shown

documents.title: SMTO-JOB-0016 — The Gateway couldn't start this background job
documents.summary: The Gateway (the helper program that runs commands on a computer) couldn't take on this background job because its job service isn't working right now. The job did not start, so nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-JOB-0016 — The Gateway couldn't start this background job
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0001 — SMTO couldn't read the Kubernetes cluster or namespace name
documents.summary: SMTO tried to note which Kubernetes cluster and namespace (a named group inside the cluster) a command used, but a name or address in your Kubernetes settings isn't valid. The command wasn't blocked; SMTO just won't remember this cluster.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0001 — SMTO couldn't read the Kubernetes cluster or namespace name

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0002 — SMTO couldn't confirm it's reaching the right Kubernetes cluster
documents.summary: Before remembering a Kubernetes cluster, SMTO checks how your settings reach and trust it. These settings use a connection SMTO can't verify, such as an unencrypted address or a skipped certificate check. Your command wasn't blocked.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0002 — SMTO couldn't confirm it's reaching the right Kubernetes cluster

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0003 — Kubernetes sign-in details were found where they don't belong
documents.summary: An older version of SMTO reported Kubernetes sign-in details inside information that is shown openly. The current SMTO no longer makes this check, so the message most likely comes from an older record.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0003 — Kubernetes sign-in details were found where they don't belong

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0004 — SMTO couldn't use a saved Kubernetes cluster record
documents.summary: SMTO keeps a short record of which Kubernetes cluster a conversation used. That record's check code or settings file location is missing or damaged, so SMTO set it aside. Your cluster and commands weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0004 — SMTO couldn't use a saved Kubernetes cluster record

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0005 — The Kubernetes certificate in your settings is empty or too large
documents.summary: SMTO reads the cluster's certificate from your Kubernetes settings to confirm the cluster is genuine. That certificate is empty, in the wrong form, or larger than SMTO accepts, so SMTO couldn't record the cluster. Your command wasn't blocked.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0005 — The Kubernetes certificate in your settings is empty or too large

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0006 — SMTO couldn't read your Kubernetes settings file
documents.summary: SMTO reads your Kubernetes settings file to note which cluster a command used, but this file is set up in a way SMTO can't read with certainty, such as repeated entries or several files at once. Your command wasn't blocked.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0006 — SMTO couldn't read your Kubernetes settings file

documents.title: SMTO-K8S-0007 — SMTO set aside an incomplete Kubernetes cluster record
documents.summary: SMTO keeps a short note of which Kubernetes cluster, namespace and Gateway a conversation used. That note is incomplete, so SMTO won't reuse it. Your cluster and commands weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-K8S-0007 — SMTO set aside an incomplete Kubernetes cluster record

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0001 — The agent's note request used a number SMTO can't accept
documents.summary: The agent keeps short notes for this task in the Task Scratchpad. One of its note requests used a number SMTO can't accept, such as zero or a page size that's too big, so nothing was saved or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0001 — The agent's note request used a number SMTO can't accept

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0002 — The agent lost its place while listing its notes
documents.summary: The agent was going through its saved task notes page by page, but the marker it used for the next page doesn't belong to this list. Nothing was changed; the list just needs to start again from the first page.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0002 — The agent lost its place while listing its notes

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0003 — The agent used a note name SMTO can't accept
documents.summary: Each note in the Task Scratchpad needs a short name. The name the agent used had spaces, symbols or other characters SMTO doesn't allow, or was too long, so the note wasn't saved or read.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0003 — The agent used a note name SMTO can't accept

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0004 — The agent's note search had no usable search text
documents.summary: The agent searched its task notes, but the search text was empty, longer than 256 characters, or contained a hidden control character. Nothing was searched or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0004 — The agent's note search had no usable search text

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0005 — The agent tried to save a note that isn't plain text
documents.summary: Notes in the Task Scratchpad can only hold plain text. The agent tried to save something else, such as raw file data or text with hidden control characters, so the note wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0005 — The agent tried to save a note that isn't plain text

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0006 — A scratch note changed before the Agent could update it
documents.summary: The Agent tried to change or remove one of its scratch notes for this Task, but that note had already changed. SMTO left the note as it was instead of overwriting it.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0006 — A scratch note changed before the Agent could update it
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0007 — A scratch note was too large to save
documents.summary: The Agent tried to save one scratch note larger than 16 KB for this Task. That note wasn't saved, and the other notes are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0007 — A scratch note was too large to save

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0008 — This conversation's scratch notes are full
documents.summary: The Agent tried to save another scratch note, but this Task already holds the most notes it can (256 notes or 512 KB in total). The new note wasn't saved, and existing notes are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0008 — This conversation's scratch notes are full

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0009 — This work was deleted, so its scratch notes can't be used
documents.summary: The Agent tried to use scratch notes that belong to a Task or conversation that was deleted, for example while a Run was still going. Nothing was saved or read.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0009 — This work was deleted, so its scratch notes can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-KV-0010 — The Agent's scratch notes weren't ready for this Run
documents.summary: The Agent tried to use its scratch notes before SMTO had linked this Run to its Task. Nothing was saved or read.

headings.title: SMTO-KV-0010 — The Agent's scratch notes weren't ready for this Run

documents.title: SMTO-LEG-0001 — The license agreement changed while you were reviewing it
documents.summary: You tried to accept a version of the license agreement that is no longer the current one, so your acceptance wasn't recorded. SMTO reloads the current version for you to review.

headings.title: SMTO-LEG-0001 — The license agreement changed while you were reviewing it

documents.title: SMTO-LEG-0002 — Accept the license agreement to start new work
documents.summary: SMTO won't start new work until the current license agreement has been accepted on this server. Your request wasn't started, and nothing was run.

headings.title: SMTO-LEG-0002 — Accept the license agreement to start new work

documents.title: SMTO-LEG-0003 — SMTO's license agreement files don't match this version
documents.summary: SMTO found that the license agreement included with this installation was changed or doesn't match the copy it saved earlier, so it stopped instead of showing the wrong terms. Your past acceptance records were not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-LEG-0003 — SMTO's license agreement files don't match this version

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0001 — Model request timed out
documents.summary: SMTO waited for the model to answer, but no complete answer arrived within the time limit, so it stopped waiting. Steps that already finished in this task stay done.

headings.title: Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0002 — The selected model can't use SMTO's tools
documents.summary: To take actions, SMTO needs the model to reply in a special tool format. This model connection doesn't support that, so SMTO stopped instead of guessing from plain text.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0002 — The selected model can't use SMTO's tools

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0003 — Model server connection was refused
documents.summary: SMTO reached the computer where the model should be, but nothing there accepted the connection. Usually the model server isn't running or is on a different port.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0003 — Model server connection was refused

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0004 — Model server connection was reset
documents.summary: The connection to the model was cut off suddenly while SMTO was waiting for the answer. The part already received wasn't used, because it isn't a complete answer.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0004 — Model server connection was reset

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0005 — Model server connection closed
documents.summary: The model's answer stopped partway through because the connection ended. SMTO won't guess the missing part, so only this one model reply is lost.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0006 — Model endpoint name could not be resolved
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find the model server's computer by the name it was given. The name may be misspelled, or this network may not know it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0006 — Model endpoint name could not be resolved

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0007 — Model endpoint is unreachable
documents.summary: SMTO knows the model server's address, but this computer has no network path to it right now. This is a network problem, not a problem with the model or its key.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0008 — SMTO lost its connection to the model for an unknown reason
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't get a complete reply from the model because the connection failed, and the exact reason wasn't recorded. SMTO didn't act on any part of that reply.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0008 — SMTO lost its connection to the model for an unknown reason

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0009 — Model stream was malformed
documents.summary: Part of the model's reply arrived in a form SMTO couldn't read, so SMTO stopped that reply. Nothing from it was carried out, and steps the task already finished are unchanged.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0010 — Model stream contained invalid data
documents.summary: Part of the model's reply contained bytes that aren't readable text, so SMTO stopped that reply. Nothing from it was carried out, and earlier finished steps are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0010 — Model stream contained invalid data

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0011 — Model stream exceeded a transport safety limit
documents.summary: One piece of the model's reply was bigger than SMTO accepts at once (about 1 MB), so SMTO stopped the reply. Nothing from it was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0011 — Model stream exceeded a transport safety limit

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0012 — Model stream exceeded a transport safety limit
documents.summary: The model's reply grew past the most SMTO will collect for one reply (about 32 MB, including thinking you don't see). SMTO stopped it, and nothing from it was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0012 — Model stream exceeded a transport safety limit

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0013 — Model stream was malformed
documents.summary: The pieces of the model's reply didn't fit together into one clear answer or action, or the model server reported an error partway through. SMTO didn't carry out any of it.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0014 — Model response was interrupted
documents.summary: The model's reply stopped partway through. SMTO didn't act on the unfinished part, and steps the task had already finished stay done.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0015 — The model ran out of room before finishing its reply
documents.summary: The model hit its output limit while writing an answer or action, so the reply was cut off. SMTO didn't carry out the half-written action.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0015 — The model ran out of room before finishing its reply
