Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0016 — The model stopped making progress on its reply
documents.summary: The model went quiet partway through its reply and sent nothing useful for the allowed time (5 minutes by default). SMTO stopped waiting and didn't carry out any part of that reply.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0016 — The model stopped making progress on its reply

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0017 — The model used up its reply space without giving an answer
documents.summary: The model hit its output limit before writing any answer or action. This can happen when its hidden thinking uses up the space. SMTO had nothing it could use, so nothing was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0017 — The model used up its reply space without giving an answer

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0018 — The model got stuck repeating itself
documents.summary: The model kept repeating the same thinking, or the same data in an action it was writing, instead of finishing. SMTO stopped that reply before acting on it, so nothing from it was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0018 — The model got stuck repeating itself

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0019 — The model didn't finish its reply properly
documents.summary: The model's reply ended without the signal that it was complete, or a short setup step, such as choosing tools for a task, ran out of time. SMTO can't act on an unfinished reply, so nothing was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0019 — The model didn't finish its reply properly

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0020 — SMTO couldn't find a usable model at the model server
documents.summary: SMTO asked the model server which models it offers but got no usable list, or couldn't read the answer. SMTO won't quietly switch to another model, so the work can't start yet.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0020 — SMTO couldn't find a usable model at the model server

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0021 — This task was started with a different model than the one set now
documents.summary: A stopped task keeps the model it started with. The model now chosen in Settings is different, or the task never recorded one, so SMTO won't continue it with another model.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0021 — This task was started with a different model than the one set now

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0022 — The model service didn't accept SMTO's sign-in
documents.summary: The model service turned down SMTO's request because it couldn't confirm who was asking. Nothing from this request was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0022 — The model service didn't accept SMTO's sign-in

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0023 — The model service couldn't find the address SMTO used
documents.summary: SMTO reached the model service, but the address in SMTO's settings doesn't lead to a model there. This doesn't mean the whole service is down.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0023 — The model service couldn't find the address SMTO used

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0024 — The model service is limiting how many requests SMTO can send
documents.summary: The model service declined the request because a speed or usage limit was reached. Sending the same request again right away won't lift the limit.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0024 — The model service is limiting how many requests SMTO can send

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0025 — The model service had a problem on its side
documents.summary: The model service reported an internal error while handling SMTO's request. SMTO doesn't know which part of the service failed, and nothing from this request was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0025 — The model service had a problem on its side

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0026 — The model server couldn't arrange the conversation for its model
documents.summary: The model server turned the request down with a message about its chat format, the layout its model expects conversations in. The exact cause isn't confirmed, and nothing from this request was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0026 — The model server couldn't arrange the conversation for its model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0027 — The model server couldn't handle SMTO's tool instructions
documents.summary: The model server turned the request down with a message about how it reads the model's tool instructions. None of your tools ran and failed; nothing from this request was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0027 — The model server couldn't handle SMTO's tool instructions

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0028 — The model service didn't accept SMTO's list of tools
documents.summary: SMTO tells the model which actions it may take. The model service refused that list, so the model never answered and no action ran for this step.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0028 — The model service didn't accept SMTO's list of tools

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0029 — The model answered a background step in the wrong form
documents.summary: For a behind-the-scenes step, SMTO asked the model to fill in one specific form. The model sent back a different or broken answer, so SMTO set it aside and did not act on it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0029 — The model answered a background step in the wrong form

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0030 — The model service refused SMTO's request
documents.summary: The model service turned the request down without a reason SMTO recognizes. The model didn't answer, and no action ran for this step.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0030 — The model service refused SMTO's request

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0031 — SMTO couldn't use the model's answer
documents.summary: The model replied, but not in a form SMTO could use. This message comes from an older or outside record, so it doesn't say which part was wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0031 — SMTO couldn't use the model's answer

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0032 — Model returned an empty response
documents.summary: SMTO asked your model service for something and got nothing usable back. Either the service listed no models to choose from, or the model sent back a blank answer.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0032 — Model returned an empty response

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0033 — Model returned invalid JSON
documents.summary: SMTO needed the answer in an exact fill-in-the-blanks format. The model's reply was broken or incomplete in that format, so SMTO couldn't read it and did not act on it.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0034 — Model response did not match the expected schema
documents.summary: The model's answer was readable, but some details were wrong, such as a missing part, the wrong kind of value or a repeated entry. SMTO didn't use it, because it could make the next step go wrong.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0034 — Model response did not match the expected schema

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0035 — Model response could not be parsed
documents.summary: Something unexpected went wrong while SMTO was getting a structured answer from the model. This message is broad, so it doesn't show which part failed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0035 — Model response could not be parsed

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0036 — A model setting wasn't accepted
documents.summary: One of your model's settings has a value that SMTO or the model service won't accept, so the request didn't go through. Your saved settings weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0036 — A model setting wasn't accepted

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0037 — An older retry attempt ran out of time
documents.summary: This message comes from an older SMTO version that gave the model's retry a fixed time limit. Current SMTO keeps waiting as long as the model is making progress.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0037 — An older retry attempt ran out of time
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0038 — SMTO couldn't get a reply from the model
documents.summary: SMTO asked the model for its next step, but the request failed and SMTO couldn't tell why. The Run may have stopped; steps it finished earlier are not undone.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0038 — SMTO couldn't get a reply from the model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0039 — Model discovery failed
documents.summary: SMTO asked the model server which models it offers but didn't get a usable answer. No question was sent to the model, so nothing was run.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0040 — The model server isn't offering any models
documents.summary: The model server answered, but its list didn't name any model SMTO could use, so SMTO had nothing to pick automatically. No question was sent to the model.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0040 — The model server isn't offering any models

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0041 — The model's reply repeated the same detail twice
documents.summary: The model's reply listed the same piece of information twice, possibly with different values. SMTO didn't act on it, because it can't safely guess which one was meant.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0041 — The model's reply repeated the same detail twice

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0042 — The model replied in a format SMTO can't read
documents.summary: The model sent its reply in a form other than plain text, such as an image or an unknown block, which this model connection doesn't accept. SMTO didn't act on that reply.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0042 — The model replied in a format SMTO can't read

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0043 — The model's instructions for a tool couldn't be read
documents.summary: The model asked to use a tool, but the details it gave weren't one clear, readable set. SMTO didn't run that tool.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0043 — The model's instructions for a tool couldn't be read

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0044 — The model's tool instructions could be read two ways
documents.summary: The model sent its tool instructions in pieces, and those pieces fit together into two different sets of details. SMTO didn't run the tool rather than guess which one the model meant.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0044 — The model's tool instructions could be read two ways

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0045 — SMTO couldn't tell which tool the model picked
documents.summary: The model sent the tool's name in pieces, and those pieces could spell two different tools that both exist. SMTO didn't run either one, since picking the wrong tool could do the wrong thing.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0045 — SMTO couldn't tell which tool the model picked

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0046 — The model server sent back an error instead of a reply
documents.summary: SMTO asked the model for its next step, but the model server sent back an error or an empty response instead of an answer. SMTO didn't act on it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0046 — The model server sent back an error instead of a reply

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0047 — The model sent several answers at once
documents.summary: SMTO needs exactly one answer from the model to decide what to do next. This reply had several answers, or none in a usable shape, so SMTO didn't act on it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0047 — The model sent several answers at once

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0048 — The AI model sent back a reply with no answer in it
documents.summary: The AI model replied, but the reply was missing the actual answer SMTO reads, so SMTO stopped this step. Nothing in that reply was carried out.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0048 — The AI model sent back a reply with no answer in it

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0049 — The AI model described one action in two conflicting ways
documents.summary: The model's reply asked for an action using both an old and a new format at the same time. SMTO ran neither one rather than guess which was meant.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0049 — The AI model described one action in two conflicting ways

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0050 — The AI model asked for too many actions at once
documents.summary: In a single reply, the model asked for more actions than one step allows, or for none when one was required. SMTO ran none of them.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0050 — The AI model asked for too many actions at once

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0051 — The AI model sent an action SMTO couldn't identify
documents.summary: One of the actions in the model's reply was badly formed, for example missing its label or reusing another action's label. SMTO ran none of the actions in that reply.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0051 — The AI model sent an action SMTO couldn't identify

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0052 — The AI model asked for an action without naming it
documents.summary: The model's reply included an action but didn't say which tool to use. SMTO won't guess, so nothing from that reply was run.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0052 — The AI model asked for an action without naming it

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0053 — The AI model sent its list of actions in the wrong form
documents.summary: The part of the model's reply that lists its actions wasn't a proper list, so SMTO couldn't separate the actions. Nothing from that reply was run.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0053 — The AI model sent its list of actions in the wrong form

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0054 — The AI model ended its reply in a way SMTO doesn't recognize
documents.summary: The model's reply ended with a signal SMTO can't read, so SMTO couldn't tell whether the reply was complete. Nothing from that reply was run.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0054 — The AI model ended its reply in a way SMTO doesn't recognize

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0055 — SMTO couldn't tell which parts of the model's actions go together
documents.summary: The model sent its actions in pieces as it typed, without the numbers that show which piece belongs where. SMTO ran none of them rather than piece them together by guesswork.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0055 — SMTO couldn't tell which parts of the model's actions go together

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0056 — The AI model didn't use the action this step required
documents.summary: For this step, SMTO needed the model to use one specific action. The model answered with something else, such as plain text or a different action, so SMTO stopped the step.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0056 — The AI model didn't use the action this step required

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0057 — That model server action isn't available on this Gateway
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't do this model server action with the chosen program or on that computer, or another model server job was still busy there.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0057 — That model server action isn't available on this Gateway

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0058 — Provider unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO checked the model server program on that computer before starting it, but the program was missing, didn't respond properly, or is a kind SMTO can't start. Nothing was started.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0059 — SMTO couldn't find the model server program on that computer
documents.summary: The program needed to run this model server isn't installed where the Gateway looks for it, so nothing was started. Installing it on a different computer won't help.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0059 — SMTO couldn't find the model server program on that computer

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0060 — SMTO couldn't find the model server profile you named
documents.summary: Your request names a model server profile that isn't among the settings this task was given. SMTO won't swap in a different profile, so nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0060 — SMTO couldn't find the model server profile you named

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0061 — Your model server profile has a setting SMTO can't use
documents.summary: Something in the model server profile doesn't fit the program or the chosen computer, a key it points to wasn't included, or the profile changed after this task started. SMTO stopped instead of guessing a fix.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0061 — Your model server profile has a setting SMTO can't use

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0062 — Model not found
documents.summary: The model file or folder named in your model server profile isn't at that location on the Gateway's computer, so the model server wasn't started.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0063 — This model server profile doesn't say where the model files are
documents.summary: SMTO can't start this model server because no model files were chosen for it. SMTO never downloads a model just to start the server, so nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0063 — This model server profile doesn't say where the model files are

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0064 — SMTO couldn't use the network port set for this model server
documents.summary: Another program may already be using that port, or the address can't be used on that computer. SMTO didn't stop anything and didn't start the model server.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0064 — SMTO couldn't use the network port set for this model server

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0065 — This model server would be reachable from other computers
documents.summary: Your profile sets the model server to accept connections from other computers. SMTO won't do that until it's approved and protected with a key, so nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0065 — This model server would be reachable from other computers

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0066 — The model server didn't start
documents.summary: SMTO tried to start the model server, but it couldn't be launched, it stopped soon after starting, or the Gateway was about to restart. It may have run briefly first.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0066 — The model server didn't start

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0067 — The model server is taking too long to get ready
documents.summary: SMTO started the model server, but it wasn't ready before SMTO stopped waiting. It may still be loading, so starting another copy could make things worse.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0067 — The model server is taking too long to get ready

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0068 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from the local model server
documents.summary: SMTO asked the model server on the Gateway computer whether it was working, but got no usable answer in time. This was only a check; nothing was started, stopped or downloaded.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0068 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from the local model server

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0069 — Runtime not found
documents.summary: SMTO looked for that model server on the Gateway computer, but the Gateway has no record of it. SMTO won't guess and act on a different server that only looks similar.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0070 — SMTO can't stop or restart a model server it doesn't control
documents.summary: SMTO can only stop or restart model servers that the running Gateway started itself. It can't prove this one is its own, so it left it running to avoid interrupting someone else's work.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0070 — SMTO can't stop or restart a model server it doesn't control

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0071 — Stop failed
documents.summary: SMTO told the model server to stop, but it hadn't shut down a couple of seconds later. It may still be closing, or it may still be running.

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0072 — The model server's log isn't available in SMTO
documents.summary: SMTO still knows about this model server, but it doesn't have its log. SMTO keeps logs only while the Gateway that started the server keeps running, so a log may still exist on that computer.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0072 — The model server's log isn't available in SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0073 — The model server sent a reply SMTO couldn't use
documents.summary: SMTO got a reply from the model server or the Gateway, but it was too large, incomplete or in a form SMTO doesn't understand. SMTO didn't treat it as a success.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0073 — The model server sent a reply SMTO couldn't use

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0074 — The model you picked isn't served at the address SMTO would use
documents.summary: Before switching SMTO to this model, SMTO checked the model server from both the SMTO server and the Gateway. The model wasn't there, or the two checks saw different servers. Your current Main model hasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0074 — The model you picked isn't served at the address SMTO would use

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0075 — The model switch preview is out of date
documents.summary: Something changed since SMTO showed you the preview for switching models, or the preview is more than 10 minutes old. SMTO won't apply it, so a newer choice isn't overwritten.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0075 — The model switch preview is out of date

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0076 — SMTO couldn't switch to the local model with the current setup
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't safely point its Main model at this model server. Either the server's API key differs from the key Main uses, or SMTO has no address it can reach the server at. Your current Main model hasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0076 — SMTO couldn't switch to the local model with the current setup

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0077 — The model server couldn't finish the model download or removal
documents.summary: You asked to download or remove a model, and the model server said it couldn't do it. Part of a download may already be on the Gateway computer.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0077 — The model server couldn't finish the model download or removal

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0078 — The Gateway computer may be out of storage space for the model
documents.summary: While handling a model, the Gateway computer or its model server reported a storage-space problem. Part of a download may already be saved there.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0078 — The Gateway computer may be out of storage space for the model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0079 — The model server action was cancelled
documents.summary: The model server action was stopped before it finished. Depending on when it stopped, nothing may have changed, or a model server may have started and been stopped, or part of a model may have downloaded.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0079 — The model server action was cancelled

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0080 — SMTO doesn't know if the model server action finished
documents.summary: SMTO lost track of the model server action partway through. It may have finished, may still be running (a download can keep going), or may not have happened. Sending it again could do it twice.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0080 — SMTO doesn't know if the model server action finished

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0081 — An older thinking limit stopped this answer
documents.summary: An older SMTO version stopped the model when it thought longer than its thinking target. SMTO now treats that target as a guide and lets the model keep thinking. Work already finished was kept.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0081 — An older thinking limit stopped this answer

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0082 — SMTO couldn't turn off thinking for its retry
documents.summary: The model got stuck, so SMTO tried again with thinking turned off. This model connection wouldn't keep that setting, so SMTO stopped instead of sending the retry. No action from the stuck step ran.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0082 — SMTO couldn't turn off thinking for its retry

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0083 — An older SMTO version held back a model request
documents.summary: This message comes from an older SMTO version that could hold back model requests after an unclear connection result. That system has been removed, and the records of what the Run did are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0083 — An older SMTO version held back a model request

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0084 — An older Task couldn't use its Helper model
documents.summary: A Task set up to use the Helper model couldn't use it, because the Helper's settings had changed or its model couldn't be confirmed. Current SMTO versions no longer show this for new work.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0084 — An older Task couldn't use its Helper model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0085 — SMTO couldn't confirm your model works with it
documents.summary: SMTO sent your model one short test request, but the result didn't prove everything SMTO needs works. That doesn't mean the model is broken; tasks can still run and will report their own problems.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0085 — SMTO couldn't confirm your model works with it

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0086 — Your model's web address isn't valid
documents.summary: The address SMTO uses to reach your model service isn't a usable web address, so SMTO couldn't send any request to the model.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0086 — Your model's web address isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0087 — The model service won't let this account use the model
documents.summary: The model service got the request but refused permission. Your API key may be fine; the account, its access to this model, or a network rule may be blocking it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0087 — The model service won't let this account use the model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0088 — Your model account has run out of credit
documents.summary: The model service says this account has used up its allowance, such as its credits or spending limit. Waiting a few minutes won't fix it; more allowance has to be added.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0088 — Your model account has run out of credit

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0089 — The model service couldn't find that model name
documents.summary: The model service doesn't recognize the model name SMTO sent, so it couldn't answer. The name may be misspelled, or the model may have been removed, renamed or not shared with this account.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0089 — The model service couldn't find that model name

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0090 — Your model service has tool use turned off
documents.summary: Your model can answer in plain text, but its service refused the kind of request SMTO uses to carry out actions. SMTO can't do tasks with this model until that is switched on.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0090 — Your model service has tool use turned off

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0091 — This model service uses a request format SMTO can't use
documents.summary: The address set for this model leads to a service that expects a different kind of request than SMTO sends, so SMTO can't get answers from it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0091 — This model service uses a request format SMTO can't use

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0092 — SMTO couldn't confirm your model service's security certificate
documents.summary: SMTO stopped the connection because it couldn't confirm that the secure connection really belongs to your model service. No answer came back from the model.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0092 — SMTO couldn't confirm your model service's security certificate

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0093 — The secure connection to your model service failed
documents.summary: SMTO started a secure connection to your model service, but it broke before a full answer came back. This isn't a certificate problem; the connection itself failed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0093 — The secure connection to your model service failed

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0094 — The computer running your model ran out of memory
documents.summary: The model service said it didn't have enough memory to handle SMTO's request, so no answer came back. This happens on the computer that runs the model, not in SMTO.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0094 — The computer running your model ran out of memory

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0095 — Your model is still starting up
documents.summary: The model service is running but is still loading the model, so it can't answer yet. Large models can take several minutes to load.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0095 — Your model is still starting up

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0096 — This model's settings don't fit together
documents.summary: SMTO checked the saved settings for this model and found values that can't work, such as an answer size as large as the model's whole memory, or no model set up at all. Nothing was sent to the model.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0096 — This model's settings don't fit together

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0097 — The model didn't start answering in time
documents.summary: SMTO waited for the model to start its answer, but nothing arrived before the time limit, only signals that the connection was still open. No action ran, and earlier finished work is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0097 — The model didn't start answering in time

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0098 — The retry hit the total time limit you set
documents.summary: A total time limit is turned on for SMTO's retry attempts, and it ran out even though the model may still have been working. Earlier finished work is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0098 — The retry hit the total time limit you set

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0099 — SMTO's automatic retry for this step is used up
documents.summary: The model stalled or repeated itself, and SMTO's one automatic retry for this step already ran or was cut short. The task is paused, and work finished so far is saved.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0099 — SMTO's automatic retry for this step is used up

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0100 — The image model didn't send back a description
documents.summary: SMTO asked the image model to look at your picture, but the reply was empty or unusable. Nothing about the image was reported back.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0100 — The image model didn't send back a description

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0101 — The selected model can't read images
documents.summary: SMTO needs a model whose service confirms it accepts pictures, but the model chosen for image work hasn't confirmed that. The image wasn't sent to it.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0101 — The selected model can't read images

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0102 — SMTO couldn't reach your image model, and Main can't read images
documents.summary: The model set up to read images (Vision) couldn't be used, and your Main model, which SMTO tries next, can't read pictures. So the image wasn't looked at.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0102 — SMTO couldn't reach your image model, and Main can't read images

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0103 — SMTO couldn't prepare this image for the model
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't open the picture, or it was too large to send, so the image model never saw it. Your file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0103 — SMTO couldn't prepare this image for the model

documents.title: SMTO-LLM-0104 — Reading the image was stopped
documents.summary: SMTO stopped looking at the image because the task was stopped or given new instructions. No description of the image was produced; earlier results in the task are kept.

headings.title: SMTO-LLM-0104 — Reading the image was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0001 — SMTO has no entry for this error code
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to explain an error code, but this installation has no entry under that code. The code may be mistyped, or it may come from a different SMTO version.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0001 — SMTO has no entry for this error code

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0002 — This Manual page isn't available
documents.summary: The Manual link you opened points to a page this version of the Manual doesn't have. It may be an old bookmark, a mistyped link, or a page that was renamed.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0002 — This Manual page isn't available

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0003 — This Manual link isn't in a form SMTO recognizes
documents.summary: The page name in this Manual link uses characters or a length the Manual doesn't allow, so it couldn't look the page up. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0003 — This Manual link isn't in a form SMTO recognizes

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0004 — That link to the SMTO Manual isn't valid
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to open a Manual page with a reference it doesn't recognize, such as a mistyped, shortened or made-up link. Nothing was opened.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0004 — That link to the SMTO Manual isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0005 — That SMTO Manual page doesn't exist in this version
documents.summary: The link points to a Manual page that isn't in the Manual installed with this copy of SMTO. It may have been renamed or removed, or come from another version.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0005 — That SMTO Manual page doesn't exist in this version

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0006 — That section isn't on this SMTO Manual page
documents.summary: The Manual page exists, but the heading the link points to isn't on it. The heading may have been renamed in this version.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0006 — That section isn't on this SMTO Manual page

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0007 — The SMTO Manual changed while it was being read
documents.summary: SMTO was reading a long Manual page or list in parts, and the Manual was updated in between. The saved place no longer matches, so reading stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0007 — The SMTO Manual changed while it was being read

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0008 — SMTO lost its place reading the Manual
documents.summary: SMTO was reading a Manual page or list in parts, but the marker for the next part didn't match the request. The Manual itself is fine.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0008 — SMTO lost its place reading the Manual

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0009 — Some SMTO Manual reference pages are still being prepared
documents.summary: SMTO is still building some Manual pages, such as detailed error pages, in the background. The main Manual guides already work, and these pages will be ready shortly.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0009 — Some SMTO Manual reference pages are still being prepared

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0010 — Some SMTO Manual reference pages couldn't be built
documents.summary: SMTO tried to prepare its detailed reference pages, such as the error pages, but couldn't. The main Manual guides still work.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0010 — Some SMTO Manual reference pages couldn't be built

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0011 — SMTO Manual corpus is unavailable in this installation
documents.summary: SMTO's built-in Manual pages are missing from this installation, so SMTO can't look things up in its own Manual. Your conversations and settings aren't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0011 — SMTO Manual corpus is unavailable in this installation

documents.title: SMTO-MAN-0012 — The Agent's Manual lookup used options SMTO doesn't support
documents.summary: While working on your request, the Agent tried to look something up in the SMTO Manual, but asked for options the Manual doesn't support. The lookup didn't run, and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MAN-0012 — The Agent's Manual lookup used options SMTO doesn't support

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0001 — Memory couldn't accept a value the Agent sent
documents.summary: The Agent asked Memory to save, list or search, but one value it sent wasn't usable, such as a version number or how many results to show. Nothing in your memories was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0001 — Memory couldn't accept a value the Agent sent

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0002 — The memory list lost its place
documents.summary: The Agent asked Memory for the next page of a list, but the bookmark it used was damaged or came from a different list. No memories were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0002 — The memory list lost its place

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0003 — This memory's key isn't allowed
documents.summary: SMTO didn't save this memory because its key (the short name that identifies it) uses characters or a length SMTO doesn't accept. Nothing was saved or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0003 — This memory's key isn't allowed

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0004 — SMTO couldn't search memories with that text
documents.summary: The memory search text was empty, too long, or had no words SMTO could search for, so the search didn't run. Your saved memories weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0004 — SMTO couldn't search memories with that text

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0005 — SMTO couldn't save this memory's content
documents.summary: The memory's content includes something SMTO can't store, such as the special values NaN or Infinity. Nothing was saved, and any earlier version of this memory is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0005 — SMTO couldn't save this memory's content

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0006 — This memory changed before your change was saved
documents.summary: This memory was changed or deleted somewhere else, possibly by the agent, after you opened it, so SMTO didn't apply your change. The newer saved version was kept.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0006 — This memory changed before your change was saved
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0007 — This memory is too large to save
documents.summary: The memory's content is bigger than the limit of about 1 MB for one memory, so SMTO didn't save it. Any earlier version of this memory is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0007 — This memory is too large to save

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0008 — One of this memory's tags isn't allowed
documents.summary: SMTO didn't save this memory because a tag (a label that helps find it) has characters SMTO doesn't accept or is too long, or there are more than 32 tags. Nothing was saved or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0008 — One of this memory's tags isn't allowed

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0009 — SMTO couldn't open its saved memories
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't read or write the file where memories are kept, so this memory action didn't happen. Your saved memories weren't changed by this error.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0009 — SMTO couldn't open its saved memories

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0010 — The agent hasn't finished saving what you asked it to remember
documents.summary: You asked the agent to save everything it learned, but it tried to finish before completing that save. SMTO didn't accept the task as finished yet.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0010 — The agent hasn't finished saving what you asked it to remember

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0011 — The agent must read a memory fully before judging it
documents.summary: The agent tried to record whether a saved memory applies to your task before reading all of it, so SMTO didn't record that judgment. Nothing else changed, and the agent is told what to read next.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0011 — The agent must read a memory fully before judging it
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0012 — Choose one place for this file in Knowledge
documents.summary: Knowledge needs exactly one place for a new file: one collection or one conversation. This upload named neither, or both, so the file wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0012 — Choose one place for this file in Knowledge

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0013 — Knowledge can't open the selected conversation
documents.summary: Knowledge tried to use a conversation that no longer exists or was deleted, so it couldn't show or add sources for that conversation.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0013 — Knowledge can't open the selected conversation

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0014 — SMTO couldn't find any text to search in this file
documents.summary: The file was uploaded, but SMTO found no readable text in it, so nothing from it can be searched or used in answers. This often happens with blank files or with unclear scans and photos.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0014 — SMTO couldn't find any text to search in this file

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0015 — This file is bigger than Knowledge allows
documents.summary: The file is larger than the upload size limit set for Knowledge, so it wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0015 — This file is bigger than Knowledge allows

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0016 — SMTO can't sign in to the model that makes text searchable
documents.summary: Knowledge uses an embeddings model to turn your documents and memories into searchable data. Its saved connection is missing its key or no longer matches the assigned model, so this indexing or search couldn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0016 — SMTO can't sign in to the model that makes text searchable

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0017 — The model that makes documents searchable isn't running
documents.summary: Knowledge is set to use an embeddings model on a managed instance, but that instance isn't ready or now runs a different model. So SMTO couldn't index or search with it.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0017 — The model that makes documents searchable isn't running

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0018 — SMTO couldn't reach the model that makes text searchable
documents.summary: Knowledge sends text to an embeddings service to make it searchable. That service didn't answer, or answered with an error, so this document or search couldn't be processed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0018 — SMTO couldn't reach the model that makes text searchable

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0019 — Search data for your memories isn't there yet
documents.summary: SMTO has no search data for your memories under the current Knowledge settings. Your saved memories are kept; until the search data is rebuilt, SMTO finds them by simple keyword matching.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0019 — Search data for your memories isn't there yet

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0020 — Document search data is being rebuilt
documents.summary: SMTO found that search data for some documents was missing and has started rebuilding it from their saved copies. Searches of those documents won't work until it finishes.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0020 — Document search data is being rebuilt

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0021 — SMTO couldn't rebuild search data for some documents
documents.summary: Search data for some documents was missing, and SMTO's earlier try at rebuilding it from saved copies failed. Those documents can't be searched until they are indexed again.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0021 — SMTO couldn't rebuild search data for some documents

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0022 — Indexing stopped before it finished
documents.summary: SMTO stopped making this source searchable before it finished. This happens when indexing is cancelled, the file is replaced or deleted, its conversation is deleted, settings change, or SMTO shuts down.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0022 — Indexing stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0023 — SMTO couldn't safely read a stored file for this document
documents.summary: While preparing this document, SMTO found that a stored copy of the file, or an image taken from it, wasn't where it should be. It stopped rather than read from an unexpected place.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0023 — SMTO couldn't safely read a stored file for this document

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0024 — SMTO couldn't save the processed data for this document
documents.summary: While preparing this document for search, SMTO found its record had an unexpected ID, so it didn't save the processed data. Your original file wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0024 — SMTO couldn't save the processed data for this document

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0025 — The embeddings model sent back data SMTO can't use
documents.summary: Knowledge asked the embeddings model to turn text into search data, but the reply didn't have the expected size or shape. So this document or search couldn't be processed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0025 — The embeddings model sent back data SMTO can't use

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0026 — Knowledge's saved resource limits can't be read
documents.summary: The installation-wide limits for Knowledge, such as the maximum upload size, are saved in a file SMTO can't read or that holds values outside the allowed ranges. Uploads, indexing and searches that check these limits stop.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0026 — Knowledge's saved resource limits can't be read

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0027 — SMTO got a request for an unknown kind of Knowledge settings
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to change Knowledge settings for a category it doesn't have; only document and Memory settings exist. The settings weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0027 — SMTO got a request for an unknown kind of Knowledge settings

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0028 — This collection name can't be used
documents.summary: A Knowledge collection needs a name between 1 and 240 characters. The name you entered was blank, only spaces, or too long, so no collection was created.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0028 — This collection name can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0029 — SMTO couldn't search with that question
documents.summary: A search needs a question with real words in it, no longer than 8,192 characters. This one was blank, only spaces, or too long, so no search ran.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0029 — SMTO couldn't search with that question

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0030 — SMTO couldn't find that passage in the document
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to open a passage using a link it couldn't follow. The link was cut short, typed in the wrong form, or pointed past the end of the document. Your documents weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0030 — SMTO couldn't find that passage in the document

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0031 — Your Knowledge storage is full
documents.summary: Your Knowledge files have used up the storage space allowed for your account, so this new file wasn't saved. Files already in Knowledge are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0031 — Your Knowledge storage is full

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0032 — Smart memory matching is off for your current model
documents.summary: SMTO is set to hide weak memory matches, but it only knows the right cut-off for its standard matching model. With the model you chose, it skipped matching by meaning and used keyword matching instead.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0032 — Smart memory matching is off for your current model

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0033 — That Knowledge item no longer exists
documents.summary: You picked a collection, document or indexing job that has been deleted or replaced, often in another tab or by someone else. The page was showing an old list.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0033 — That Knowledge item no longer exists

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0034 — Knowledge is missing a program it needs
documents.summary: Knowledge uses a separate helper program to read documents and match memories. That program, or a part it needs, is missing on the server, so documents can't be processed or searched by meaning right now.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0034 — Knowledge is missing a program it needs

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0035 — Knowledge is not installed
documents.summary: The document and memory search part of SMTO hasn't been set up on this server, so documents can't be added or searched. Your conversations and other features still work.

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0036 — Knowledge search isn't available right now
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach its Knowledge search for this request, so it couldn't look in your documents. Your documents themselves weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0036 — Knowledge search isn't available right now

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0037 — The file changed after it was added
documents.summary: SMTO checks that a file is exactly the same as when it was added. This file's contents are different now, so SMTO won't use it, to avoid giving answers from the wrong version.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0037 — The file changed after it was added

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0038 — SMTO can't read this Knowledge document
documents.summary: SMTO went to open a document's saved copy and couldn't. Either the file is missing from the server, or the document isn't part of this conversation's sources anymore.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0038 — SMTO can't read this Knowledge document

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0039 — Too many collections attached to this conversation
documents.summary: A conversation can use up to 100 collections at once and leave out up to 10,000 documents. This change would have gone over a limit, so the conversation's sources were left as they were.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0039 — Too many collections attached to this conversation

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0040 — Knowledge can't read this type of file
documents.summary: Knowledge only reads certain kinds of files, such as PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files, text, web pages and pictures. This file is a different type, so it wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0040 — Knowledge can't read this type of file

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0041 — Knowledge vector service is unavailable
documents.summary: Knowledge keeps searchable copies of your documents and memories in a small database on the server. That database didn't answer, so searching and adding documents can't happen right now. This does not establish whether your files or other features are affected.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0041 — Knowledge vector service is unavailable

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0042 — Knowledge is busy processing other work
documents.summary: Knowledge's helpers were all busy, for example reading large documents. Your request waited too long and was stopped. Other work that was already running isn't stopped by this.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0042 — Knowledge is busy processing other work

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0043 — Knowledge's document helper stopped responding
documents.summary: Knowledge uses a helper program to read documents and prepare them for search. It stopped responding or took too long on this work, so the work was stopped. SMTO starts a fresh helper next time.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0043 — Knowledge's document helper stopped responding

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0044 — Knowledge needs to be repaired after a change
documents.summary: SMTO checked the Knowledge parts installed on the server and found they don't fully match this version of SMTO, often after an update. Knowledge may not work until the installation is repaired.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0044 — Knowledge needs to be repaired after a change

documents.title: SMTO-MEM-0045 — Choose either a file or a note to add
documents.summary: The Agent tried to add something to this conversation's Knowledge, but it gave both an attached file and a typed note, or neither. Nothing was added.

headings.title: SMTO-MEM-0045 — Choose either a file or a note to add

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0001 — SMTO couldn't find that monitor
documents.summary: A monitor (a background check that runs a command on a computer at set times) with that ID doesn't exist, so nothing was started, stopped or read. Your other monitors weren't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0001 — SMTO couldn't find that monitor

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0002 — SMTO couldn't start or create this monitor
documents.summary: Either the monitor is archived (kept only as a record and no longer able to run), or the new monitor's settings broke one of SMTO's safety rules. Nothing new was started.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0002 — SMTO couldn't start or create this monitor

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0003 — This monitor's settings aren't valid
documents.summary: SMTO didn't create the monitor because its settings are incomplete or unsupported, for example it points at more than one Gateway or has an unsafe command. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0003 — This monitor's settings aren't valid

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0004 — SMTO couldn't use a model to plan this monitor
documents.summary: SMTO tried to turn your description into a monitor but had no working model connection for that planning step, so it couldn't work out the monitor from your words.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0004 — SMTO couldn't use a model to plan this monitor

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0005 — This monitor has used up its model checks
documents.summary: This monitor has used all the model judgments it's allowed, so it can't ask the model to judge new readings. It keeps collecting readings, and earlier results are kept.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0005 — This monitor has used up its model checks

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0006 — Monitors aren't available right now
documents.summary: The agent tried to start, stop or check a monitor, but SMTO's monitor service wasn't connected to this task. Nothing was started or stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0006 — Monitors aren't available right now

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0007 — SMTO needs more detail to set up this monitor
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't work out which command the monitor should run from your description, so it didn't create the monitor. It lists the details it still needs.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0007 — SMTO needs more detail to set up this monitor

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0008 — This monitor has no command to run
documents.summary: The monitor's command was blank, so SMTO had nothing to run and didn't create the monitor.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0008 — This monitor has no command to run

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0009 — SMTO blocked a monitor command that could delete or change data
documents.summary: The monitor's command looks like one that could delete files, wipe data or shut a computer down. Because a monitor runs its command again and again, SMTO refused it and didn't create the monitor.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0009 — SMTO blocked a monitor command that could delete or change data

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0010 — This monitor command waits for someone to type
documents.summary: The monitor's command starts a program that waits for a person, such as an editor, a remote login or top. Monitors run unattended, so SMTO didn't create this one.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0010 — This monitor command waits for someone to type

documents.title: SMTO-MON-0011 — A continuous monitor needs a stop time
documents.summary: This monitor follows a command's output continuously (like watch or tail -f), but no time limit was set, so SMTO didn't start it.

headings.title: SMTO-MON-0011 — A continuous monitor needs a stop time

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0001 — There's no saved Model output for this step
documents.summary: SMTO doesn't have a saved copy of the raw text the Model wrote for this step, so there's nothing to show here. Older steps from before SMTO saved this text can't be recovered.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0001 — There's no saved Model output for this step

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0002 — SMTO couldn't find the activity record for this run
documents.summary: The step-by-step record for this run isn't in SMTO's saved history. It may have been deleted with its conversation, or your page is pointing at an old run.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0002 — SMTO couldn't find the activity record for this run

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0003 — This run was already started
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to start a prepared run that had already been started once, so it refused to start it again. This keeps the same work from running twice.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0003 — This run was already started

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0004 — SMTO couldn't find the details for this work
documents.summary: SMTO looked for the saved record of this work in the current conversation and didn't find it. Not finding the record doesn't mean the work failed or never ran.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0004 — SMTO couldn't find the details for this work

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0005 — SMTO found more than one matching piece of work
documents.summary: Several runs in this conversation fit what was asked for, and none is the one clear choice, so SMTO won't guess which to show. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0005 — SMTO found more than one matching piece of work

documents.title: SMTO-OBS-0006 — SMTO couldn't load the full output for this step
documents.summary: The complete output for this step couldn't be shown or copied here. Part of it may no longer be saved, or the page asked for it in a way SMTO doesn't support.

headings.title: SMTO-OBS-0006 — SMTO couldn't load the full output for this step

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0001 — This Task has too many steps for SMTO to read back at once
documents.summary: This Task recorded more steps or more data than SMTO reads back in one go (over 512 steps or about 4 MB). The Task's results weren't changed; only this action couldn't use them.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0001 — This Task has too many steps for SMTO to read back at once

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0002 — This Task can't be summarized yet
documents.summary: SMTO can only summarize a Task after it has finished and saved its results. This Task is still running, is waiting for you, or has no saved results, or its summary came back empty.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0002 — This Task can't be summarized yet

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0003 — SMTO couldn't format this result for display
documents.summary: The step finished and its result is saved, but SMTO couldn't arrange it into the formatted view on screen. The work itself isn't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0003 — SMTO couldn't format this result for display

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0004 — SMTO couldn't show this result because of a display fault
documents.summary: SMTO's built-in list of ways to show results has a missing or repeated entry, so it couldn't show this result. The step's saved result isn't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0004 — SMTO couldn't show this result because of a display fault

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0005 — Only part of this command's output was saved
documents.summary: The command printed more text than SMTO saves for one step, so the rest of its log was cut off. The command itself still ran; only the saved log is incomplete.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0005 — Only part of this command's output was saved

documents.title: SMTO-OUT-0006 — SMTO couldn't finish this Task's summary
documents.summary: Writing the summary for this Task failed or was cut short, for example by a restart. The Task's work and results are saved separately and weren't affected.

headings.title: SMTO-OUT-0006 — SMTO couldn't finish this Task's summary

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0001 — Your permission rules blocked this action
documents.summary: SMTO's own permission rules don't allow this action, so it was stopped before it ran. Changing file or folder permissions on the computer won't change this.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0001 — Your permission rules blocked this action
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0002 — This Task isn't allowed to use that tool
documents.summary: The Capabilities chosen for this Task leave out the tool the Agent tried to use, so SMTO stopped that step before it ran. Giving the computer more access won't change this.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0002 — This Task isn't allowed to use that tool

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0003 — This command's folder is outside the allowed area
documents.summary: The command was set to run in a folder that SMTO can't confirm is inside the area it's allowed to use, so the command didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0003 — This command's folder is outside the allowed area
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0004 — SMTO needs you to confirm this risky action
documents.summary: The Task wants to run an action that could delete data, change the system or interrupt a service. It's waiting for you to confirm this exact action; approving other actions doesn't cover it.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0004 — SMTO needs you to confirm this risky action

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0005 — Your earlier confirmation no longer covers this action
documents.summary: The confirmation for this risky action expired, was withdrawn, or no longer matches what's waiting to run, so SMTO didn't run the action.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0005 — Your earlier confirmation no longer covers this action

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0006 — SMTO can't override the job that is blocking your task
documents.summary: Your task is waiting because an earlier job may still be using the same thing it needs. SMTO refused to push ahead anyway, because this situation doesn't qualify for that. Your command has not started.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0006 — SMTO can't override the job that is blocking your task

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0007 — SMTO needs your clear go-ahead before pushing past a blocked job
documents.summary: SMTO can't tell whether an earlier job is still using what your task needs. Going ahead could let both change the same thing at once, so SMTO won't continue without a matching confirmation. Nothing has run yet.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0007 — SMTO needs your clear go-ahead before pushing past a blocked job

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0008 — The situation changed after you confirmed going ahead
documents.summary: You confirmed going ahead with a blocked task, but the earlier job's situation changed before SMTO could use your answer. SMTO won't apply an old answer to a new situation, so nothing has run.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0008 — The situation changed after you confirmed going ahead

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0009 — This Skill is switched off for this task
documents.summary: The Agent tried to use a Skill (a set of tools, such as Email or Files) that isn't allowed in this task's capability choices. None of that Skill's tools were used.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0009 — This Skill is switched off for this task

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0010 — SMTO can't use the computer this step asked for
documents.summary: A step tried to run on, or copy files between, Gateways (the helper programs SMTO uses on your computers) that aren't selected for this task, aren't available now, or can't do that. The step did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0010 — SMTO can't use the computer this step asked for

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0011 — A tool tried to ask the Model on its own, so SMTO stopped it
documents.summary: A tool tried to get an extra answer from the Model outside the task's normal steps. SMTO blocks this so every Model decision stays under the task's controls. It's a fault in that tool, not in your request.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0011 — A tool tried to ask the Model on its own, so SMTO stopped it

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0012 — SMTO couldn't save that permission for the waiting action
documents.summary: You chose to allow an action more broadly, but it didn't match the action still waiting for approval, or the conversation no longer exists. No permission was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0012 — SMTO couldn't save that permission for the waiting action

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0013 — Permissions were changed somewhere else before you saved
documents.summary: Someone else, or SMTO in another tab, changed these permission rules after you opened them. SMTO didn't save your edit, so that newer change wasn't erased.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0013 — Permissions were changed somewhere else before you saved

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0014 — This task has reached its limit on actions
documents.summary: Each task can take only a set number of actions, such as running commands. The next group of actions would have gone over that limit, so it didn't run. Earlier actions may already have made changes.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0014 — This task has reached its limit on actions

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0015 — An admin command can't run inside a group of commands
documents.summary: The Agent put a command that needs administrator rights (sudo) inside a group of commands. SMTO only runs such commands one at a time with their own approval, so the group was stopped before its commands ran.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0015 — An admin command can't run inside a group of commands

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0016 — A step needed a result from an earlier step that didn't finish
documents.summary: The Agent tried to pass the output of an earlier step into a new one, but SMTO has no complete, successful result for that earlier step. The new step didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0016 — A step needed a result from an earlier step that didn't finish

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0017 — The Agent's code or task list wasn't in the required layout
documents.summary: The Agent wrote a small Python program or a task checklist that isn't laid out the way SMTO requires, for example a checklist with more than 64 items. SMTO refused it before running anything.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0017 — The Agent's code or task list wasn't in the required layout

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0018 — A quick data calculation tried to do more than it's allowed
documents.summary: The Agent wrote a small data-processing program that tried to open files, run programs, use the network or other off-limits features. These quick calculations may only work on the data they're given, so it didn't run.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0018 — A quick data calculation tried to do more than it's allowed

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0019 — A quick data calculation was too big or took too long
documents.summary: The Agent's small data-processing step was given more than 4 MB of data, or ran past its short time limit, so it was stopped. These quick calculations only work on the data they're given; they don't change your files.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0019 — A quick data calculation was too big or took too long

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0020 — This task ran out of time and was paused
documents.summary: The task reached the time limit it was given, so SMTO paused it. Its progress is saved, but jobs it had already started may still be running in the background.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0020 — This task ran out of time and was paused

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0021 — This task used up its allowed number of Model decisions
documents.summary: Each task may ask the Model for only a set number of decisions. This one reached that limit and paused. Its work so far is saved, but it may not have finished checking or describing the result.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0021 — This task used up its allowed number of Model decisions

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0022 — Shell execution is disabled
documents.summary: Your account or this SMTO installation is set not to run shell commands (commands typed on a computer's command line). The step that needed one didn't run. Administrator rights on the computer don't change this.

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0023 — SMTO blocked a command that could seriously damage a computer
documents.summary: The command would shut down or restart a computer, wipe a disk or delete from the top of a drive, or it hid such an action inside a script SMTO couldn't check. SMTO blocked it before it ran.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0023 — SMTO blocked a command that could seriously damage a computer

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0024 — SMTO stopped a change that could throw away other work
documents.summary: The Agent tried a change that would delete, overwrite or reset existing work, such as unsaved code changes, files or a database table, which your request didn't ask for. SMTO blocked it, so that work is untouched.

headings.title: SMTO-POL-0024 — SMTO stopped a change that could throw away other work

documents.title: SMTO-POL-0025 — This request tried to switch off a rule that is always on
documents.summary: The request came with behavior settings that try to stop SMTO reusing information it has already checked in this task. That rule can't be switched off at any effort level, so SMTO didn't accept the request.
