headings.title: SMTO-RST-0022 — SMTO couldn't confirm your data was saved to disk

documents.title: SMTO-RST-0023 — An older SMTO version turned this work away to save memory
documents.summary: An earlier version of SMTO refused new work when it thought memory was running low. Current SMTO no longer has that limit, so this message only records something that happened before.

headings.title: SMTO-RST-0023 — An older SMTO version turned this work away to save memory

documents.title: SMTO-RST-0024 — SMTO's startup stalled while copying your saved data
documents.summary: While starting, SMTO copies your saved data into a work area, and that copy stopped moving for five seconds, so SMTO didn't finish starting. Your saved data was left as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-RST-0024 — SMTO's startup stalled while copying your saved data
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-RST-0025 — SMTO couldn't rebuild your saved data from its files
documents.summary: SMTO didn't finish starting because some files from your last save are missing or damaged. It kept all of them as they are and didn't switch to an older save on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-RST-0025 — SMTO couldn't rebuild your saved data from its files
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-RST-0026 — This SMTO version can't read the format of your saved data
documents.summary: Your saved data is stored in a format this version of SMTO can't read or convert, for example because a newer version saved it. SMTO stopped without changing the data.

headings.title: SMTO-RST-0026 — This SMTO version can't read the format of your saved data
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-RST-0027 — SMTO's saved data files don't agree with each other
documents.summary: SMTO stopped while starting because its saved files disagree about which save is the latest. It didn't guess, and it didn't change any of them.

headings.title: SMTO-RST-0027 — SMTO's saved data files don't agree with each other
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0001 — The time you asked for passed before the schedule was saved
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to do something at a set time, but that time had already passed by the time SMTO went to save it. No schedule was created and nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0001 — The time you asked for passed before the schedule was saved

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0002 — The schedules changed before SMTO could act on them
documents.summary: Either the list of schedules you picked to delete changed after you reviewed it, or a Run now couldn't start the schedule's task. In both cases nothing was deleted and no task was started.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0002 — The schedules changed before SMTO could act on them

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0003 — That time is skipped or repeated by a clock change
documents.summary: On the day you picked, the clocks change for daylight saving time, so that exact time either doesn't happen or happens twice. SMTO didn't save the schedule because it couldn't tell which moment you meant.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0003 — That time is skipped or repeated by a clock change

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0004 — SMTO couldn't understand the schedule's date and time
documents.summary: The date and time given for this schedule isn't in a form SMTO can read, or it names a date that doesn't exist. The schedule wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0004 — SMTO couldn't understand the schedule's date and time

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0005 — The schedule needs a time as well as a date
documents.summary: A date was given for this schedule but no clock time, so SMTO doesn't know when on that day to run it. The schedule wasn't saved, and nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0005 — The schedule needs a time as well as a date

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0006 — SMTO doesn't recognise the schedule's time zone
documents.summary: The time zone set for this schedule isn't one SMTO knows, perhaps because of a typo. The schedule wasn't saved or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0006 — SMTO doesn't recognise the schedule's time zone

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0007 — The schedule's repeat settings don't fit together
documents.summary: Some of the repeat options for this schedule contradict each other or are missing, such as a weekly repeat with no days picked or an end date before the start. The schedule wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0007 — The schedule's repeat settings don't fit together

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0008 — Some of the schedule's details are missing or not allowed
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't save or act on this schedule because a needed detail was missing or outside what's allowed, such as how often it repeats. Nothing was created, changed or deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0008 — Some of the schedule's details are missing or not allowed

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0009 — This prompt can't be scheduled as written
documents.summary: SMTO can schedule ordinary requests, but this prompt is empty, too long, starts with a / command, or asks SMTO to type in or use a saved private value. The schedule wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0009 — This prompt can't be scheduled as written

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0010 — The Gateway address for this schedule contains private details
documents.summary: The address of the Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) for this schedule includes private details like a password or token. SMTO won't keep those in a schedule, so it wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0010 — The Gateway address for this schedule contains private details

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0011 — An edited schedule can't take on new private values
documents.summary: You changed a saved schedule's text so that it types in a value or uses a saved password. Edits can't add private values to a schedule, so the change wasn't saved and the schedule still has its old text.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0011 — An edited schedule can't take on new private values

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0012 — This part of a saved schedule can't be changed
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to change where or with what permissions a saved schedule runs. Those choices are fixed when a schedule is created, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0012 — This part of a saved schedule can't be changed

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0013 — This schedule can't be paused or resumed anymore
documents.summary: Pause and Resume only work on a schedule that is still running or paused. This one has already been cancelled or has finished, so nothing about it was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0013 — This schedule can't be paused or resumed anymore

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0014 — SMTO couldn't start this schedule right now
documents.summary: The Agent tried to run a saved schedule right away, but the part of SMTO that starts scheduled runs wasn't available to it. No run was started.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0014 — SMTO couldn't start this schedule right now

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0015 — SMTO couldn't apply that schedule change
documents.summary: The request to look at or change a schedule was missing something or asked for a change SMTO doesn't allow, such as an edit with nothing in it. The schedule was not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0015 — SMTO couldn't apply that schedule change

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0016 — This prompt already has a running or paused schedule
documents.summary: SMTO allows only one running or paused schedule per prompt, and another one for this same prompt already exists. Your change was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0016 — This prompt already has a running or paused schedule

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0017 — This schedule has no future dates left
documents.summary: Based on its repeat pattern, start date and end setting, this schedule would never run again. SMTO didn't save it, so nothing will run from it.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0017 — This schedule has no future dates left

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0018 — A repeating schedule can't also have a fixed next time
documents.summary: This schedule repeats on a pattern, like every weekday at 9:00, so SMTO works out each run time itself. The change also tried to set a separate next time or gap between runs, so it was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0018 — A repeating schedule can't also have a fixed next time

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0019 — This schedule needs a future run time
documents.summary: A running schedule must have a next run time that is still ahead. This one has no next time, or its one-time date has already passed, so the change was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0019 — This schedule needs a future run time

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0020 — SMTO couldn't pin down the exact time for this schedule
documents.summary: When you ask for something at a set time, SMTO links the schedule to your original message and an exact time zone. That link was missing here, so no schedule was created.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0020 — SMTO couldn't pin down the exact time for this schedule

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0021 — Scheduling is disabled
documents.summary: Scheduling is turned off for this SMTO server, so new schedules can't be made and existing ones can't be run or changed. Your saved schedules are kept, not deleted.

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0022 — The Agent needs you to say exactly when
documents.summary: Your message mentioned a time that could mean more than one thing, so SMTO stopped the Agent from doing or scheduling anything until you say exactly when. That step did not run.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0022 — The Agent needs you to say exactly when

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0023 — The Agent tried to start before your requested wait was over
documents.summary: You asked the Agent to wait before doing the work, but it tried to start early. SMTO stopped that step before it ran and told the Agent to wait first.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0023 — The Agent tried to start before your requested wait was over

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0024 — The Agent's wait time didn't match what you asked
documents.summary: You asked the Agent to wait a certain time, but it tried to wait for a different length or until a different moment. SMTO stopped that wait and gave the Agent the correct time.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0024 — The Agent's wait time didn't match what you asked

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0025 — The Agent tried to do later work right now
documents.summary: You asked for this work to happen at a later time, but the Agent tried to do it now. SMTO stopped that step before it ran, so the work will happen when it is scheduled.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0025 — The Agent tried to do later work right now

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0026 — The Agent tried to wait instead of scheduling your later task
documents.summary: Your task is meant to run at a later time, so it needs a saved schedule that keeps working even if this conversation ends. The Agent tried to just wait inside this run, and SMTO stopped that.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0026 — The Agent tried to wait instead of scheduling your later task

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0027 — The schedule the Agent chose didn't match your request
documents.summary: The Agent tried to create a schedule with a different time, or a different kind of schedule, than you asked for. SMTO stopped it before anything was saved and told the Agent what you asked.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0027 — The schedule the Agent chose didn't match your request

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0028 — The Agent changed your task's wording when scheduling it
documents.summary: You asked for a task to run later, but the Agent tried to save it with different instructions, leaving something out or adding something new. SMTO stopped it before anything was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0028 — The Agent changed your task's wording when scheduling it

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0029 — The Agent changed the reminder message you asked for
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to remind you later with a certain message, but the Agent tried to save a different or missing message. SMTO stopped it before the reminder was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0029 — The Agent changed the reminder message you asked for

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0030 — The Agent couldn't reach SMTO's saved schedules
documents.summary: The Agent tried to create, view or change a schedule, but the place SMTO keeps schedules wasn't available to it. No schedule was created or changed by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0030 — The Agent couldn't reach SMTO's saved schedules

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0031 — This schedule was cancelled or deleted, so it wasn't made again
documents.summary: A schedule was already made for this request earlier and later cancelled or deleted. SMTO won't bring it back by itself, so no new schedule was created.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0031 — This schedule was cancelled or deleted, so it wasn't made again

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0032 — Too many attachments for a scheduled task
documents.summary: A scheduled task can bring along at most 16 attached files or items. This one had more, so the schedule was not created.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0032 — Too many attachments for a scheduled task

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0033 — SMTO couldn't accept the resource plan for this step
documents.summary: Before a step starts, SMTO plans which computer it will use and how much of that computer it may take. That plan didn't match the step, so SMTO rejected it and didn't start the step with it.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0033 — SMTO couldn't accept the resource plan for this step

documents.title: SMTO-SCH-0034 — SMTO couldn't start because a machine setup file has a mistake
documents.summary: SMTO reads an optional file, set up by an administrator, that says which Gateways run on the same computer. That file has a mistake, so SMTO stopped before starting. Your conversations and tasks were not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SCH-0034 — SMTO couldn't start because a machine setup file has a mistake

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0001 — SMTO is missing a part it needs to work with databases
documents.summary: SMTO's database tools need a piece of supporting software that isn't installed on the computer running SMTO. No database query was run.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0001 — SMTO is missing a part it needs to work with databases

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0002 — A Skill setting has a value SMTO can't accept
documents.summary: One of the settings for this Skill isn't in a form the Skill accepts, such as a number that's too big or a required box left empty. Your change wasn't saved, so the earlier settings are still in use.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0002 — A Skill setting has a value SMTO can't accept

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0003 — This Skill's settings are too large to save
documents.summary: The settings for this one Skill add up to more than SMTO can store (about 64 KB of text). Your change wasn't saved, and the settings already in use are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0003 — This Skill's settings are too large to save

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0004 — A Skill's API key needs a secure web address
documents.summary: SMTO reported that a Skill's API key could be sent to a web address that isn't secure. This is an older kind of message, so it doesn't prove SMTO checked the connection this time.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0004 — A Skill's API key needs a secure web address

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0005 — This Skill needs the name of a saved secret, not the secret itself
documents.summary: Skills keep API keys in Parameter Store, SMTO's protected place for secrets. This setting was filled in incorrectly or names a Parameter Store entry that doesn't exist, so your changes weren't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0005 — This Skill needs the name of a saved secret, not the secret itself

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0006 — SMTO can't find the saved API key this Skill points to
documents.summary: This Skill's settings point to a Parameter Store entry, or a field inside it, that isn't there now, for example because it was renamed or deleted. SMTO didn't use the key, so the provider that needs it wasn't contacted.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0006 — SMTO can't find the saved API key this Skill points to

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0007 — The saved API key for this Skill is empty or unusable
documents.summary: The Parameter Store field this Skill points to is empty, isn't plain text, or is much too long to be a key. SMTO didn't use it, and nothing was sent to the provider with it.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0007 — The saved API key for this Skill is empty or unusable

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0008 — These Skill settings come from a different version of SMTO
documents.summary: The saved settings for this Skill were made by a newer or older SMTO than the one running now, so SMTO won't read them. It hasn't changed or deleted them.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0008 — These Skill settings come from a different version of SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0009 — Two Skills have the same name, so SMTO needs the exact one
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to use a Skill by a name that more than one Skill shares. It didn't pick one by guessing, and nothing was run with either Skill.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0009 — Two Skills have the same name, so SMTO needs the exact one

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0010 — SMTO couldn't find the Skill that was asked for
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to use or set up a Skill it doesn't have under that name. It may have been mistyped, removed or renamed in an update. Nothing was run or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0010 — SMTO couldn't find the Skill that was asked for

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0011 — No connected Google account can use Google Calendar
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find a Google account it's allowed to use with Google Calendar, so it didn't contact Google. Your calendar wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0011 — No connected Google account can use Google Calendar

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0012 — Choose which Google account to use for Calendar
documents.summary: More than one of your connected Google accounts can use Google Calendar, and SMTO won't guess which one you meant. Nothing was sent to Google.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0012 — Choose which Google account to use for Calendar

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0013 — Your Google account hasn't allowed this Calendar access yet
documents.summary: Your Google account is connected, but it hasn't given SMTO permission for this kind of Calendar task, such as editing events. The task was stopped, so your calendar wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0013 — Your Google account hasn't allowed this Calendar access yet

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0014 — SMTO needs you to sign in to Google Calendar again
documents.summary: Google no longer accepts SMTO's saved sign-in for this account. This can happen after a password change, removed access or an expired approval. Your calendar wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0014 — SMTO needs you to sign in to Google Calendar again

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0015 — SMTO couldn't find that Google calendar
documents.summary: Google says this calendar doesn't exist or this account can't see it. It may have been deleted, unshared, or SMTO used the wrong account. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0015 — SMTO couldn't find that Google calendar

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0016 — This account isn't allowed to make that calendar change
documents.summary: Google refused the change because this account can only view that calendar, or because someone else organizes the event. Your calendar wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0016 — This account isn't allowed to make that calendar change

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0017 — SMTO couldn't find that calendar event
documents.summary: The event SMTO tried to use isn't in that calendar any more, or this account can't see it. It may have been deleted or cancelled. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0017 — SMTO couldn't find that calendar event

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0018 — SMTO couldn't tell which calendar event you meant
documents.summary: This message says several events could match your request, so SMTO couldn't tell which one to change. It comes from an older record, so check your calendar before assuming nothing changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0018 — SMTO couldn't tell which calendar event you meant

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0019 — SMTO couldn't prepare this calendar request
documents.summary: The details of this calendar request didn't fit together, so SMTO stopped before changing anything. For example, an edit didn't say what to change, or a guest was listed twice.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0019 — SMTO couldn't prepare this calendar request

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0020 — The calendar times don't make a valid time period
documents.summary: The start and end times SMTO was given don't describe one clear period. For example, the end is before the start, the time zone is missing, or the date range is too long. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0020 — The calendar times don't make a valid time period

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0021 — SMTO didn't recognize that time zone
documents.summary: The time zone in this calendar request isn't one SMTO recognizes, so it couldn't work out the times. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0021 — SMTO didn't recognize that time zone

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0022 — SMTO couldn't set up how this event repeats
documents.summary: The repeat pattern for this event wasn't one SMTO can use, or it was being changed on a single date instead of the whole series. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0022 — SMTO couldn't set up how this event repeats

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0023 — This calendar invitation has too many guests
documents.summary: SMTO can add at most 100 guests to one calendar event, and this request had more. No invitations were sent.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0023 — This calendar invitation has too many guests

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0024 — Google is limiting how fast SMTO can use your calendar
documents.summary: Google is temporarily refusing calendar requests because too many were sent in a short time, or a usage limit was reached. Google turned this one away, so it didn't happen.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0024 — Google is limiting how fast SMTO can use your calendar

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0025 — Google Calendar denied access
documents.summary: Google refused this calendar request for this account, and the reason isn't missing permission from SMTO's sign-in. Reconnecting alone may not help. Nothing was changed.

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0026 — This calendar event changed since SMTO last read it
documents.summary: Someone or something changed this event after SMTO looked at it, so SMTO stopped instead of overwriting their changes. Your edit wasn't applied.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0026 — This calendar event changed since SMTO last read it

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0027 — SMTO couldn't confirm whether your calendar change happened
documents.summary: SMTO sent the change to Google but couldn't confirm the result, so it may or may not have happened. Guests may also have been emailed. SMTO did not send it again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0027 — SMTO couldn't confirm whether your calendar change happened

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0028 — The calendar task stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The task was stopped, so SMTO didn't send its next request to Google. Anything finished before it stopped, such as an event already created, stays in your calendar.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0028 — The calendar task stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0029 — Google Calendar didn't send back a usable answer
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't get a reliable answer from Google Calendar. The connection may have dropped, or Google sent back something unexpected. This step didn't change your calendar.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0029 — Google Calendar didn't send back a usable answer

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0030 — Google Calendar refused this request
documents.summary: Google turned down this calendar request without a reason SMTO recognizes. Google refused it, so this change wasn't made.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0030 — Google Calendar refused this request

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0031 — Google Calendar reported a conflict with this event
documents.summary: Google Calendar refused this change because it clashes with something already on the calendar. Often the event was already created by an earlier attempt, so a second copy wasn't made.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0031 — Google Calendar reported a conflict with this event

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0032 — SMTO couldn't find you on this invitation's guest list
documents.summary: SMTO tried to accept or decline this invitation for you, but the Google account it used isn't listed as a guest on it. Your reply was not sent and nothing on the event changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0032 — SMTO couldn't find you on this invitation's guest list

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0033 — No Google account is connected for Google Drive
documents.summary: SMTO doesn't have a Google account it can use for Google Drive yet, so it couldn't do what you asked. Nothing in your Drive was touched.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0033 — No Google account is connected for Google Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0034 — SMTO needs to know which Google account to use for Drive
documents.summary: You have more than one Google account connected, and any of them could be used for Drive. SMTO won't guess, so it stopped without touching your files.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0034 — SMTO needs to know which Google account to use for Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0035 — SMTO doesn't have permission for this Drive file yet
documents.summary: Your Google account hasn't given SMTO the kind of Drive access this needs. By default SMTO only sees files it created or that you opened with it, and permission to read does not include permission to change.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0035 — SMTO doesn't have permission for this Drive file yet

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0036 — Your Google account needs to be reconnected for Drive
documents.summary: Google no longer accepts SMTO's permission to use this account, for example after a password change, removed access, or a disconnect. SMTO stopped before using your Drive.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0036 — Your Google account needs to be reconnected for Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0037 — SMTO couldn't find that file in Google Drive
documents.summary: Google Drive says the file doesn't exist for the account SMTO used. It may have been deleted, moved to a place this account can't see, or belong to a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0037 — SMTO couldn't find that file in Google Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0038 — More than one Drive file could match, so SMTO stopped
documents.summary: This message, from an older SMTO record, says more than one Drive file matched your request. A file name alone isn't a safe way to choose what to change, so SMTO needs the exact file.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0038 — More than one Drive file could match, so SMTO stopped

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0039 — SMTO couldn't find that shared drive
documents.summary: Google Drive says the shared drive doesn't exist for the account SMTO used. It may have been deleted or renamed away, or this account may not be a member.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0039 — SMTO couldn't find that shared drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0040 — Google Drive didn't allow this action
documents.summary: Google Drive refused this action for your account. Usually the account can view the file but not change, copy or download it, or the owner or your organization has restricted it.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0040 — Google Drive didn't allow this action

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0041 — Your Google account isn't a member of this shared drive
documents.summary: The file or folder is in a shared drive, and the Google account SMTO used isn't a member of it, so Google refused the request.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0041 — Your Google account isn't a member of this shared drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0042 — This Drive item can't be downloaded in that form
documents.summary: Google Docs, Sheets and Slides can't be downloaded as they are; they have to be saved as another file type. Folders and shortcuts can't be downloaded at all. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0042 — This Drive item can't be downloaded in that form

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0043 — This Drive file is too large to download
documents.summary: The file is bigger than SMTO or Google allows for this kind of download, so SMTO stopped and didn't keep a partial copy. Google limits saved copies of Docs, Sheets and Slides to about 10 MB.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0043 — This Drive file is too large to download

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0044 — SMTO couldn't open the file you want to upload to Drive
documents.summary: SMTO can only upload files saved in this conversation, and it couldn't open the one you chose. It may have come from somewhere else or no longer be available. Nothing was sent to Drive.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0044 — SMTO couldn't open the file you want to upload to Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0045 — The Drive upload was interrupted and can't be continued
documents.summary: Google ended the upload before SMTO finished sending the file, so it can't pick up where it left off. The file most likely wasn't finished in Drive, but check before uploading again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0045 — The Drive upload was interrupted and can't be continued

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0046 — The Drive upload stopped making progress
documents.summary: SMTO kept sending the next part of your file, but Google stopped accepting it, so SMTO gave up. The upload most likely didn't finish, but check Drive before trying again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0046 — The Drive upload stopped making progress

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0047 — The Drive file changed before SMTO could update it
documents.summary: Someone or something changed this file after SMTO last looked at it, so SMTO didn't apply its change. This avoids overwriting the newer edits.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0047 — The Drive file changed before SMTO could update it

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0048 — Google Drive asked SMTO to slow down

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0048 — Google Drive asked SMTO to slow down

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0049 — SMTO couldn't confirm whether your Drive change happened
documents.summary: SMTO sent a change to Google Drive but didn't get a clear answer back, and it couldn't confirm the result afterward. The change may or may not have been made.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0049 — SMTO couldn't confirm whether your Drive change happened

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0050 — The Google Drive task was stopped
documents.summary: The Drive task stopped part way, because it was stopped or took longer than 15 minutes. Stopping doesn't undo changes Drive already made, and an unfinished download isn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0050 — The Google Drive task was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0051 — SMTO couldn't carry out this Google Drive request as asked
documents.summary: SMTO stopped because the details of your Google Drive request didn't fit together, such as a missing file, a destination that isn't a usable folder, or an unclear move. Nothing in your Drive was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0051 — SMTO couldn't carry out this Google Drive request as asked

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0052 — Google Drive didn't send back a usable answer
documents.summary: SMTO asked Google Drive for information, but Google didn't answer, the connection dropped, or the answer was garbled. This happens while reading, so nothing in your Drive was changed by this step.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0052 — Google Drive didn't send back a usable answer

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0053 — Google Drive refused this request
documents.summary: Google Drive turned down what SMTO asked it to do and didn't say it was a sign-in, permission or missing-file problem. SMTO did not try the request again on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0053 — Google Drive refused this request

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0054 — Google Drive files can only be moved inside a conversation
documents.summary: To download a file from Google Drive or upload one to it, SMTO keeps the file inside a conversation. This request ran somewhere without one, so SMTO stopped before moving any file.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0054 — Google Drive files can only be moved inside a conversation

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0055 — SMTO couldn't save the file from Google Drive
documents.summary: SMTO got the file from Google Drive but couldn't store it in this conversation. This often happens when the conversation was deleted or the Run ended during the download. The file isn't saved in SMTO.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0055 — SMTO couldn't save the file from Google Drive

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0056 — A Google Drive file didn't arrive intact
documents.summary: SMTO checks every file it moves to or from Google Drive. This file came through different from what was expected, so SMTO threw it away instead of saving or uploading a damaged copy.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0056 — A Google Drive file didn't arrive intact

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0057 — SMTO doesn't know which Microsoft 365 account to use

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0057 — SMTO doesn't know which Microsoft 365 account to use

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0058 — Your Microsoft 365 account changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: The Microsoft 365 account SMTO was using was reconnected, edited or replaced partway through. SMTO stopped so it wouldn't act as the wrong account. An earlier step may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0058 — Your Microsoft 365 account changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0059 — The saved Microsoft 365 account details aren't usable
documents.summary: The saved entry SMTO was told to use either isn't a Microsoft 365 account or its saved details are damaged or incomplete. SMTO stopped before contacting Microsoft.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0059 — The saved Microsoft 365 account details aren't usable

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0060 — SMTO couldn't find a Microsoft 365 account it can use
documents.summary: SMTO looked for a connected Microsoft 365 account to do this, but the one named doesn't exist, or none of your accounts is signed in with permission for this kind of action. Nothing was done.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0060 — SMTO couldn't find a Microsoft 365 account it can use

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0061 — Microsoft 365 files can only be moved inside a conversation
documents.summary: To download or upload Outlook attachments or OneDrive files, SMTO keeps them inside a conversation. This request ran somewhere without one, so SMTO stopped before moving any file.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0061 — Microsoft 365 files can only be moved inside a conversation

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0062 — SMTO can't find the file you want to send to Microsoft 365

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0062 — SMTO can't find the file you want to send to Microsoft 365

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0063 — This email attachment is too large

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0063 — This email attachment is too large

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0064 — Free/busy lookup isn't available for personal Microsoft accounts
documents.summary: SMTO can only check free and busy times this way for work or school Microsoft accounts. The account used is a personal one, so SMTO stopped. Your calendar wasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0064 — Free/busy lookup isn't available for personal Microsoft accounts

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0065 — SMTO couldn't find that calendar or meeting
documents.summary: The meeting or calendar SMTO was asked to use isn't there for this Microsoft 365 account. It may have been deleted or moved, or it belongs to a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0065 — SMTO couldn't find that calendar or meeting

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0066 — SMTO can't tell whether your calendar change went through
documents.summary: SMTO asked Microsoft to change your calendar, but the answer was lost. The meeting may already have been created, changed or cancelled, and invitations or replies may already have gone out.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0066 — SMTO can't tell whether your calendar change went through

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0067 — SMTO couldn't find that contact

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0067 — SMTO couldn't find that contact

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0068 — The next page of Microsoft 365 results has expired
documents.summary: SMTO was fetching more results from an earlier Microsoft 365 search, but that search is too old, SMTO restarted, or the search details changed. Nothing in your account was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0068 — The next page of Microsoft 365 results has expired

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0069 — SMTO can't change attachments while editing a draft

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0069 — SMTO can't change attachments while editing a draft

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0070 — SMTO can only change an email that is still a draft
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to edit, delete or change attachments on an email draft, but that email is no longer a draft (for example, it was already sent). SMTO checked first and changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0070 — SMTO can only change an email that is still a draft

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0071 — SMTO was asked for a Microsoft 365 permission it doesn't know

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0071 — SMTO was asked for a Microsoft 365 permission it doesn't know

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0072 — SMTO can't tell if your OneDrive or SharePoint change worked
documents.summary: SMTO sent your file change to Microsoft, but the reply was lost or incomplete. The upload, move, copy, new folder or delete may or may not have happened, so SMTO won't repeat it on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0072 — SMTO can't tell if your OneDrive or SharePoint change worked

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0073 — SMTO couldn't find that OneDrive or SharePoint item
documents.summary: Microsoft says the file, folder or library SMTO asked for doesn't exist for this account. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted, or it belongs to someone else. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0073 — SMTO couldn't find that OneDrive or SharePoint item

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0074 — Your large file upload to OneDrive or SharePoint stopped partway
documents.summary: SMTO was sending a large file to OneDrive or SharePoint in pieces, and the transfer got out of step and stopped before the last piece. The file is most likely not there yet, but check before trying again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0074 — Your large file upload to OneDrive or SharePoint stopped partway

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0075 — Microsoft 365 turned down SMTO's request
documents.summary: Microsoft refused what SMTO asked it to do and gave an unusual reason SMTO doesn't recognize. SMTO can't be sure whether anything changed, so check before trying again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0075 — Microsoft 365 turned down SMTO's request

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0076 — Your Microsoft account isn't allowed to do this
documents.summary: Microsoft says the account connected to SMTO doesn't have permission for this email, calendar, contact or file. Microsoft refused the request, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0076 — Your Microsoft account isn't allowed to do this

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0077 — Microsoft 365 asked SMTO to slow down
documents.summary: Microsoft is limiting how many requests SMTO can make right now, so it refused this one. Nothing was changed by this request; you just need to wait before asking again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0077 — Microsoft 365 asked SMTO to slow down

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0078 — SMTO couldn't reach Microsoft 365 just now
documents.summary: SMTO lost contact with Microsoft or ran out of time while reading, downloading or signing in. This usually clears on its own. If you were changing something, check whether it happened before trying again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0078 — SMTO couldn't reach Microsoft 365 just now

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0079 — Microsoft 365 no longer accepts SMTO's sign-in

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0079 — Microsoft 365 no longer accepts SMTO's sign-in

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0080 — A different Microsoft account signed in than SMTO expected

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0080 — A different Microsoft account signed in than SMTO expected

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0081 — That file or folder name isn't allowed in OneDrive or SharePoint
documents.summary: The name SMTO was going to give a file or folder isn't allowed in OneDrive or SharePoint. SMTO stopped before sending anything, so nothing was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0081 — That file or folder name isn't allowed in OneDrive or SharePoint

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0082 — The repeat settings for this meeting aren't complete
documents.summary: You asked for a repeating calendar event, but the repeat details don't fit together, such as no weekdays chosen or no clear end. SMTO stopped before contacting Microsoft, so no event was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0082 — The repeat settings for this meeting aren't complete

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0083 — SMTO's Microsoft 365 request was incomplete or not accepted
documents.summary: The details SMTO prepared for Microsoft were missing something or weren't accepted, such as an email with no recipient. The request was stopped or refused, so nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0083 — SMTO's Microsoft 365 request was incomplete or not accepted

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0084 — The dates or times for this calendar request don't work
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't turn the dates and times into a clear time period, for example because the end is before the start, the time zone is missing, or the time is skipped when clocks change. Nothing was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0084 — The dates or times for this calendar request don't work

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0085 — SMTO doesn't recognize that time zone
documents.summary: The time zone given for this calendar request isn't one SMTO or Microsoft understands, so SMTO couldn't work out the times. Nothing was created or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0085 — SMTO doesn't recognize that time zone

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0086 — SMTO couldn't find that email or mail folder
documents.summary: Microsoft says the email, attachment or mail folder SMTO asked for doesn't exist in this account. It may have been permanently deleted, or it's in a different mailbox. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0086 — SMTO couldn't find that email or mail folder

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0087 — Your email may or may not have been sent

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0087 — Your email may or may not have been sent

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0088 — SMTO can't tell if your Microsoft 365 change was made

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0088 — SMTO can't tell if your Microsoft 365 change was made

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0089 — SMTO's Microsoft 365 app setup isn't valid

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0089 — SMTO's Microsoft 365 app setup isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0090 — SMTO can't find the Microsoft sign-in app setup
documents.summary: To connect a Microsoft account, SMTO needs a saved entry in Parameter Store that describes your Microsoft app setup (a Microsoft OAuth App entry). No entry exists under the name that was used, so nothing was sent to Microsoft.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0090 — SMTO can't find the Microsoft sign-in app setup

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0091 — SMTO couldn't open the local page Microsoft sign-in returns to
documents.summary: Microsoft sign-in sends you back to a small page that SMTO opens on the computer running SMTO. SMTO couldn't open it, usually because something else is already using that address. Nothing was sent to Microsoft.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0091 — SMTO couldn't open the local page Microsoft sign-in returns to

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0092 — The Microsoft sign-in took too long and expired
documents.summary: Each Microsoft sign-in link works for ten minutes. You came back after that, so SMTO didn't connect the account and saved nothing new.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0092 — The Microsoft sign-in took too long and expired

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0093 — Too many Microsoft sign-ins are still waiting to finish
documents.summary: Several Microsoft sign-in links were started and none have been finished yet. SMTO limits how many can wait at once, so it didn't start another one.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0093 — Too many Microsoft sign-ins are still waiting to finish

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0094 — The Microsoft 365 action was stopped before it finished
documents.summary: The Microsoft 365 action stopped because the run was cancelled, for example when Stop was selected. If it was sending, saving or uploading something, part of it may already have happened.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0094 — The Microsoft 365 action was stopped before it finished

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0095 — That Microsoft account name isn't in a form SMTO accepts
documents.summary: The name given for the Microsoft account or app isn't a valid saved-entry name, for example it has spaces or capital letters. SMTO didn't look anything up or contact Microsoft.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0095 — That Microsoft account name isn't in a form SMTO accepts

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0096 — SMTO couldn't reach your saved Microsoft 365 settings
documents.summary: Microsoft 365 needs SMTO's saved settings, called Parameter Store, to find your account. This action ran somewhere that couldn't reach them, so nothing was sent to Microsoft.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0096 — SMTO couldn't reach your saved Microsoft 365 settings

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0097 — The Microsoft 365 item changed before your edit was saved
documents.summary: Someone or something changed this email, event, contact or file after it was last read. To avoid overwriting that newer change, your edit was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0097 — The Microsoft 365 item changed before your edit was saved

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0098 — Replacing a OneDrive file needs its current version first
documents.summary: You asked to replace a file that already exists. SMTO only replaces a file after it has checked which version is there now, so nothing was uploaded.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0098 — Replacing a OneDrive file needs its current version first

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0099 — Microsoft sent back a reply SMTO couldn't safely use

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0099 — Microsoft sent back a reply SMTO couldn't safely use

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0100 — Your Microsoft 365 account needs to be connected again

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0100 — Your Microsoft 365 account needs to be connected again

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0101 — That Microsoft 365 change clashes with something already there

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0101 — That Microsoft 365 change clashes with something already there

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0102 — Microsoft 365 couldn't find that item
documents.summary: The item SMTO asked for isn't where it was expected in this Microsoft account. It may have been moved or deleted, or it belongs to a different account.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0102 — Microsoft 365 couldn't find that item

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0103 — That Microsoft 365 request is too large
documents.summary: SMTO has size limits for Microsoft 365 requests. This one asked for too many results, too many people, or too big a file, so SMTO stopped it.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0103 — That Microsoft 365 request is too large

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0104 — Your Microsoft account hasn't allowed this kind of access yet
documents.summary: When you connected this Microsoft account, you didn't allow the access this action needs, such as sending mail or changing files. SMTO didn't try the action.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0104 — Your Microsoft account hasn't allowed this kind of access yet

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0105 — This mail search mixes keywords with filters
documents.summary: Microsoft 365 mail search can either look for keywords or filter by things like sender and date, but not both at once. SMTO didn't run the search.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0105 — This mail search mixes keywords with filters

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0106 — SMTO can't access that SharePoint site
documents.summary: Either your Microsoft account doesn't have permission for this SharePoint site, or the document library chosen doesn't belong to that site. SMTO stopped before doing anything there.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0106 — SMTO can't access that SharePoint site

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0107 — That Microsoft account type isn't allowed for this connection
documents.summary: You signed in with a Microsoft account this connection doesn't accept, such as a personal account where only work or school accounts are allowed. The account was not connected.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0107 — That Microsoft account type isn't allowed for this connection

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0108 — Microsoft's sign-in reply was incomplete

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0108 — Microsoft's sign-in reply was incomplete

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0109 — The file didn't arrive complete or unchanged
documents.summary: When copying a file to or from OneDrive or SharePoint, the file's size or contents didn't match what was expected. SMTO stopped instead of using a damaged or changed file.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0109 — The file didn't arrive complete or unchanged

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0110 — SMTO can't find the Slack app setup it needs
documents.summary: To connect Slack, SMTO needs a saved Slack OAuth App entry holding your Slack app's details. The name used, or the one a saved Slack connection points to, doesn't exist. Nothing was sent to Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0110 — SMTO can't find the Slack app setup it needs

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0111 — Your Slack app setup in Parameter Store isn't valid
documents.summary: The saved Slack OAuth App entry is missing something or has a value Slack sign-in can't use, such as the wrong return address or no permissions chosen. SMTO didn't contact Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0111 — Your Slack app setup in Parameter Store isn't valid

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0112 — This Slack sign-in link is no longer valid

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0112 — This Slack sign-in link is no longer valid

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0113 — The Slack sign-in took too long and expired
documents.summary: Each Slack sign-in link lasts 10 minutes, and this one ran out before Slack sent you back. No Slack workspace was connected, and the link can't be used again.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0113 — The Slack sign-in took too long and expired

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0114 — Too many Slack sign-ins are waiting to be finished
documents.summary: SMTO can keep up to 32 unfinished Slack sign-in links at once, and that limit is reached, so no new link was made. Unfinished links expire after 10 minutes. No Slack connection was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0114 — Too many Slack sign-ins are waiting to be finished

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0115 — The Slack sign-in ended without giving permission
documents.summary: Slack came back without approving access, for example because Cancel was selected or Slack refused the request. SMTO got no access and saved nothing from this attempt.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0115 — The Slack sign-in ended without giving permission

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0116 — SMTO couldn't find a connected Slack workspace
documents.summary: This request needs a connected Slack workspace, but the one named doesn't exist, or none is connected yet (for example after it was disconnected). Nothing was sent to Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0116 — SMTO couldn't find a connected Slack workspace

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0117 — SMTO needs to know which Slack workspace to use
documents.summary: More than one Slack connection is saved, and this request didn't say which to use. One workspace can even have two: one acting as you and one as a bot. SMTO won't guess, so nothing was sent to Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0117 — SMTO needs to know which Slack workspace to use

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0118 — A saved Slack connection is damaged and can't be used
documents.summary: The saved Slack workspace entry in Parameter Store has missing or wrong details, perhaps from being edited by hand, or its name belongs to a different kind of entry. SMTO didn't use it or contact Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0118 — A saved Slack connection is damaged and can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0119 — Your Slack connection changed while SMTO was using it
documents.summary: The saved Slack connection or Slack app entry was edited, reconnected or disconnected partway through this request. SMTO stopped rather than carry on with changed details. Steps before the change may already have happened in Slack.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0119 — Your Slack connection changed while SMTO was using it

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0120 — This Slack sign-in belongs to a different account or workspace
documents.summary: SMTO didn't accept the Slack approval because the Slack workspace or account you approved doesn't match the one this saved connection is for. SMTO did not save it over your existing connection.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0120 — This Slack sign-in belongs to a different account or workspace

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0121 — Slack needs you to connect your account again

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0121 — Slack needs you to connect your account again

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0122 — Your Slack connection doesn't have permission for this

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0122 — Your Slack connection doesn't have permission for this

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0123 — This Slack request needs a connection made with your own account

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0123 — This Slack request needs a connection made with your own account

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0124 — Your Slack connection isn't a member of that channel

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0124 — Your Slack connection isn't a member of that channel

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0125 — Slack couldn't find that channel

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0125 — Slack couldn't find that channel

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0126 — That Slack channel is archived

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0126 — That Slack channel is archived

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0127 — Slack couldn't find that message

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0127 — Slack couldn't find that message

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0128 — Slack couldn't find that conversation thread
documents.summary: SMTO asked Slack for a thread by its first message, but Slack couldn't find that thread in the channel. Nothing was posted or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-SKL-0128 — Slack couldn't find that conversation thread

documents.title: SMTO-SKL-0129 — Slack won't let SMTO edit that message
documents.summary: Slack refused to edit the message. Usually the connected account didn't write it, or your workspace no longer allows edits after a set time. The message was not changed.

documents.title: SMTO-SSH-0002 — SMTO couldn't use the saved details for this SSH connection

headings.title: SMTO-SSH-0004 — SMTO couldn't read the remote computer's security key
