documents.summary: SMTO had trouble turning your request into steps it could carry out, and stopped. This message does not tell us what caused the problem, or whether any step already ran.

documents.title: SMTO-SYS-0004 — SMTO's own network connections failed, so the task stopped
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use network connections on the computer it runs on, often because that computer ran low on memory or on connections it can open at once. SMTO stopped the task; work already saved is still there.

headings.title: SMTO-SYS-0004 — SMTO's own network connections failed, so the task stopped

documents.title: SMTO-SYS-0005 — Connection failed
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't reach the AI model it uses to work on your request, so it stopped the task. Work the task already finished is kept.

documents.title: SMTO-SYS-0006 — Stop unconfirmed
documents.summary: You stopped the task, but SMTO couldn't confirm that work it started in the background actually ended. The task stays stopped, and saved results are still available.

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0001 — This task is waiting on other work that hasn't finished
documents.summary: SMTO can't move this task forward yet because work it depends on is stuck or still running, or an earlier task in this conversation is still going. Nothing new was started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0001 — This task is waiting on other work that hasn't finished

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0002 — SMTO tried to ask you a question while doing other things
documents.summary: The AI tried to ask you a question and start other actions in the same step. SMTO cancelled that whole step before any of it ran, and normally asks the AI to try again by itself.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0002 — SMTO tried to ask you a question while doing other things

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0003 — This task or conversation changed before your action went through
documents.summary: Something in this conversation changed after you started your action. For example, a task finished, a setting changed or new work arrived. SMTO didn't apply your action so it wouldn't act on outdated information.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0003 — This task or conversation changed before your action went through

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0004 — This command doesn't fit the task's current state
documents.summary: The command you used, such as /stop, /pause or /resume, doesn't apply right now. The task may have finished already, been replaced by a newer attempt, or not be in a state that allows it. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0004 — This command doesn't fit the task's current state

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0005 — A queued request changed before it could start
documents.summary: SMTO prepares queued requests ahead of time. The prepared version no longer matches this request, often because it was edited or is still being prepared, so SMTO didn't start it.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0005 — A queued request changed before it could start

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0006 — SMTO can't find this conversation
documents.summary: The conversation this action belongs to isn't available anymore. It may have been deleted, perhaps in another browser tab, or this page is showing an out-of-date list.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0006 — SMTO can't find this conversation

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0007 — SMTO can't find this run
documents.summary: The run this action points to (one attempt by the Agent at a task) is no longer available. It may have been deleted along with its task or conversation, or SMTO no longer keeps its details.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0007 — SMTO can't find this run

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0008 — Select a run
documents.summary: You tried to change a setting for one run, but SMTO wasn't told which run you meant. Nothing was changed.

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0009 — This run is busy, so its settings can't change yet
documents.summary: The Agent is in the middle of working on this run. SMTO only changes a run's settings at a safe pause point, so it refused the change instead of interrupting the work. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0009 — This run is busy, so its settings can't change yet

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0010 — A finished run's settings can't be changed
documents.summary: This run has already ended or been stopped, so its settings are kept as a record of how it ran. SMTO didn't change them.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0010 — A finished run's settings can't be changed

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0011 — These settings were changed somewhere else
documents.summary: Someone or something changed these settings after you opened them, perhaps in another tab. To avoid overwriting that newer change, SMTO didn't save yours.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0011 — These settings were changed somewhere else

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0012 — Your answer or follow-up couldn't be sent
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't accept the message you sent to the task. It was empty, too long, or sent in a way SMTO couldn't match to your earlier message. Your text wasn't sent to the Agent.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0012 — Your answer or follow-up couldn't be sent

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0013 — The previous task is still finishing
documents.summary: A task in this conversation is still running, stopping or paused, so SMTO didn't start your new request. SMTO can't tell from this message alone whether your earlier click already took effect.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0013 — The previous task is still finishing
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0014 — This task has newer work, so this action no longer applies
documents.summary: The task moved on since this page was loaded. It has already continued, been restarted, or been replaced by a newer attempt, so SMTO ignored an action aimed at the older one.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0014 — This task has newer work, so this action no longer applies

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0015 — This task was removed and can't be continued
documents.summary: The task you tried to continue or start has been removed, archived, or its conversation was deleted. SMTO can't pick it up again, so nothing new was started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0015 — This task was removed and can't be continued

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0016 — This action points to a task in a different place
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to act on a task, conversation or computer that doesn't belong to the work in front of you. To avoid acting on the wrong thing, it refused. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0016 — This action points to a task in a different place

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0017 — Task intent changed
documents.summary: What the task was asked to do changed after this action was prepared, for example by a steering message or an edited queued prompt. SMTO didn't apply the older version, so the task can follow your latest instructions.

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0018 — SMTO didn't recognize that way of stopping
documents.summary: A request to stop a task asked for a stopping method SMTO doesn't have, so the stop wasn't sent. The task may still be running.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0018 — SMTO didn't recognize that way of stopping

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0019 — This run is already stopping or finished
documents.summary: You tried to change how this run should stop, but it is already stopping or has ended. Its stop setting is kept as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0019 — This run is already stopping or finished

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0020 — This task can't be paused or resumed right now
documents.summary: The Pause or Resume you chose doesn't fit what the task is doing now. For example, it may have already finished, already continued, or not be paused. SMTO left the task as it was.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0020 — This task can't be paused or resumed right now

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0021 — SMTO couldn't apply this change to your conversations
documents.summary: The rename, pin or selection you sent wasn't in a form SMTO accepts. For example, the new name was blank or too long. Your conversations weren't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0021 — SMTO couldn't apply this change to your conversations

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0022 — SMTO couldn't run this conversation search
documents.summary: Your search of the conversation list was too long, used a sort or filter SMTO doesn't know, or would have taken too much work to finish. No results were shown, and nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0022 — SMTO couldn't run this conversation search

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0023 — SMTO can't find this task
documents.summary: The task this action points to isn't part of this conversation anymore. It may have been deleted, or the page is pointing at a task from another conversation. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0023 — SMTO can't find this task

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0024 — A queued task's saved settings don't match
documents.summary: When you queue a task, SMTO saves its settings so it runs as you asked. This task's saved settings are incomplete or no longer match, so SMTO didn't start it. An earlier copy may already have started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0024 — A queued task's saved settings don't match

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0025 — A queued task is linked to a different request
documents.summary: Each queued task is tied to one saved request and the task before it. This one no longer matches, often because the queue changed in another tab. The task may already have started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0025 — A queued task is linked to a different request

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0026 — SMTO is already running as many tasks as it can
documents.summary: SMTO is already working on the most tasks it is allowed to run at the same time, so it didn't start this one. Tasks that are already running keep going.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0026 — SMTO is already running as many tasks as it can

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0027 — That task button doesn't apply to the task right now
documents.summary: The task changed after the button was shown. It may have finished, stopped, paused or already started, so SMTO didn't carry out this action.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0027 — That task button doesn't apply to the task right now

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0028 — Manage this task from its own conversation
documents.summary: This task is waiting in a conversation's task list, so it can only be changed from that conversation. SMTO didn't change it.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0028 — Manage this task from its own conversation

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0029 — The task's question or approval has changed
documents.summary: By the time you replied, the task was asking something different or had already moved on, so SMTO didn't use your reply.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0029 — The task's question or approval has changed

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0030 — That long-running command can't be changed anymore
documents.summary: The command you tried to keep running or end has already finished, been replaced, or its task is stopping. SMTO didn't apply your choice, and that doesn't prove the command stopped.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0030 — That long-running command can't be changed anymore

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0031 — This needs an earlier Agent task, and none was found
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't find an Agent task behind the message or conversation you picked. Older messages, or ones that never ran as an Agent task, can't be used for this.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0031 — This needs an earlier Agent task, and none was found

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0032 — Workflows are turned off in this SMTO
documents.summary: Workflows, which are saved prompts you can run again later, are switched off for this installation, so SMTO couldn't save, preview, run or schedule one. Workflows you already saved are kept.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0032 — Workflows are turned off in this SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0033 — That workflow can't be found or saved
documents.summary: The workflow you picked no longer exists, perhaps because it was deleted, or the message you picked can't be saved as a workflow.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0033 — That workflow can't be found or saved

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0034 — This older workflow can't run as it was saved
documents.summary: This workflow was saved by an older version of SMTO and points at results from one past run. A new run has to produce its own results, so SMTO didn't start it.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0034 — This older workflow can't run as it was saved

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0035 — That task filter isn't recognized
documents.summary: SMTO was asked to show or clear tasks with a status it doesn't know, so it did nothing. No tasks were changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0035 — That task filter isn't recognized

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0036 — Your update to the running task is empty or too long
documents.summary: The update you sent to the running task was blank or longer than 24,000 characters, so SMTO didn't send it. Your text stays in the box.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0036 — Your update to the running task is empty or too long

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0037 — SMTO can't confirm or change your update to the task right now
documents.summary: Your update to the task may still be on its way or may already be in use, so SMTO can't promise it can be added, changed or withdrawn. The text you typed is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0037 — SMTO can't confirm or change your update to the task right now

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0038 — The Agent made a mistake updating its task plan
documents.summary: While planning, the Agent tried to save a step that was missing a description or pointed at something that doesn't exist. Its plan wasn't changed, and the Agent usually fixes this itself.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0038 — The Agent made a mistake updating its task plan

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0039 — The task you chose to wait for can't be used
documents.summary: The task picked in Depends on can't be used. It may be missing, be this same task, belong to another conversation, or create a loop. The new task wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0039 — The task you chose to wait for can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0040 — The Agent marked the wrong step as its current one
documents.summary: The Agent tried to mark a step as the one it is working on, but that step didn't exist or another step was already marked. Its plan wasn't changed, and the Agent usually fixes this itself.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0040 — The Agent marked the wrong step as its current one

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0041 — This conversation already has 32 tasks waiting
documents.summary: A conversation can hold up to 32 waiting tasks, and this one is full, so your new message wasn't added. The tasks already waiting are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0041 — This conversation already has 32 tasks waiting

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0042 — The waiting tasks changed before your change was applied
documents.summary: The list of waiting tasks changed, perhaps because a task started, finished or was edited elsewhere. SMTO didn't apply your change so it wouldn't act on the wrong task.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0042 — The waiting tasks changed before your change was applied

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0043 — The new order didn't match the tasks that are waiting
documents.summary: The new order you asked for left out a waiting task or listed one twice, usually because a task was added or started meanwhile. Nothing was reordered.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0043 — The new order didn't match the tasks that are waiting

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0044 — This step was skipped because the task was stopped
documents.summary: The task was stopped before this step began, so the step never ran and changed nothing. Steps that finished before the stop keep their results.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0044 — This step was skipped because the task was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0045 — This step is on hold while the task waits
documents.summary: The task is waiting for something, often your answer or approval, or a background job, so this step didn't start and changed nothing.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0045 — This step is on hold while the task waits

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0046 — This step was stopped before it started
documents.summary: This step was waiting for a free slot when the task was stopped, so SMTO cancelled it before it began. The step never ran, so nothing it would have done has happened.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0046 — This step was stopped before it started

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0047 — The task was stopped before these commands ran
documents.summary: You asked to stop the task while SMTO was getting a group of commands ready, so it did not start them. None of the commands in this group were run at this point.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0047 — The task was stopped before these commands ran

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0048 — SMTO lost its place in the conversation list or history
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't load the next part of a list or conversation because the marker it uses to remember where you were no longer matches. Your conversations themselves are not changed.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0048 — SMTO lost its place in the conversation list or history

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0049 — This saved workflow is in an old format SMTO can't run
documents.summary: This workflow was saved in an older format that SMTO keeps for reference only. SMTO didn't start it, so nothing ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0049 — This saved workflow is in an old format SMTO can't run

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0050 — A value given to this workflow isn't accepted
documents.summary: This workflow takes some input values, and at least one was missing, unexpected, or the wrong kind (for example text where a number is needed). SMTO didn't start the workflow.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0050 — A value given to this workflow isn't accepted

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0051 — SMTO couldn't confirm that your Stop request worked
documents.summary: You selected Stop, but SMTO couldn't confirm the result. The task may already be stopping, or it may still be running, so check before doing anything else.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0051 — SMTO couldn't confirm that your Stop request worked

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0052 — SMTO couldn't carry this conversation into a new one
documents.summary: You asked to continue this work in a new conversation, but the saved summary SMTO passes along from the earlier conversation is damaged or in a form it can't use. SMTO couldn't carry that history forward.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0052 — SMTO couldn't carry this conversation into a new one

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0053 — SMTO couldn't prepare this conversation to continue elsewhere
documents.summary: You asked to continue this work in a new conversation, but SMTO couldn't put together a usable summary of the earlier one. Your original conversation is unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0053 — SMTO couldn't prepare this conversation to continue elsewhere

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0054 — The Agent planned a step SMTO can't run
documents.summary: The Agent planned a set of steps, but one of them used a tool that isn't available here or included settings only SMTO itself may set. SMTO rejected the plan, so none of its steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0054 — The Agent planned a step SMTO can't run

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0055 — The Agent gave two planned steps the same name
documents.summary: The Agent planned several steps but labelled two of them the same way, or reused a label from earlier work in this task. SMTO rejected the new plan, so none of its new steps ran. Earlier steps are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0055 — The Agent gave two planned steps the same name

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0056 — The Agent pointed one step at two different computers
documents.summary: The Agent named two different Gateways (the helper programs SMTO uses to run work on a computer) for one step. SMTO couldn't tell which you meant, so it rejected the plan and none of its steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0056 — The Agent pointed one step at two different computers

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0057 — Linked-step planning was turned off for this task
documents.summary: The Agent tried to plan a set of linked steps that wait for each other, but that feature was off when this task started. SMTO rejected the plan, so none of its steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0057 — Linked-step planning was turned off for this task

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0058 — The Agent planned more steps than this task allows
documents.summary: The Agent planned more steps than this task allows, either at once or over the whole task. SMTO rejected the new plan, so none of its new steps ran. Earlier steps are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0058 — The Agent planned more steps than this task allows

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0059 — The Agent's plan has steps waiting on each other in a loop
documents.summary: The Agent planned steps that wait for one another, but some point to a step that doesn't exist, to themselves, or wait on each other in a circle. SMTO rejected the plan, so none of its steps ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0059 — The Agent's plan has steps waiting on each other in a loop

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0060 — This conversation's files are still needed by unfinished work
documents.summary: You asked to delete this conversation's files or all of its data, but a task in it hasn't finished and still needs them. Nothing was deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0060 — This conversation's files are still needed by unfinished work

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0061 — SMTO can't read which tasks this task waits for
documents.summary: SMTO saves a note of which earlier task each task waits for. That note is damaged for this task, so SMTO won't start it rather than guess the order.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0061 — SMTO can't read which tasks this task waits for

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0062 — The task you chose to wait for isn't in this conversation
documents.summary: Your message was set to run only after another task, but SMTO can't find that task in this conversation. It may have been deleted. Your message wasn't queued.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0062 — The task you chose to wait for isn't in this conversation

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0063 — This task is waiting for an earlier task that didn't succeed
documents.summary: This task was set to run only after another task finished successfully. That earlier task hasn't succeeded, or SMTO can't find it, so this task hasn't started.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0063 — This task is waiting for an earlier task that didn't succeed

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0064 — You can't delete this task because others wait on it
documents.summary: Another task in this conversation was set to run after this one, so SMTO keeps this task's history to show why. Nothing was deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0064 — You can't delete this task because others wait on it

documents.title: SMTO-TSK-0065 — The Agent's plan for several steps was rejected
documents.summary: The Agent asked to run a group of steps together, but the request for the whole group had a problem, so SMTO turned it down. None of the steps in that group ran.

headings.title: SMTO-TSK-0065 — The Agent's plan for several steps was rejected

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0001 — Browser request failed
documents.summary: Your browser couldn't reach the SMTO server, so the page got no reply. If you were saving or sending something, it may or may not have reached SMTO.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0002 — Invalid server response
documents.summary: The SMTO server sent a reply this page couldn't read. This often happens right after an update, when the page and the server are different versions. If you were saving something, it may already have been saved.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0003 — A required field is empty
documents.summary: A box on this form that must be filled in is empty, so SMTO didn't accept the form.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0003 — A required field is empty

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0004 — This file is too big to attach
documents.summary: The file is bigger than SMTO allows for one attachment (64 MB unless your administrator changed it). It wasn't added, and files you already attached are unaffected.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0004 — This file is too big to attach

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0005 — You can attach at most 16 items to one message
documents.summary: One message can include up to 16 attached files or context items. You've reached that limit, so the new item wasn't added. Items already attached stay attached.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0005 — You can attach at most 16 items to one message

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0006 — This update belongs to a different conversation or task
documents.summary: You moved to another conversation or task while something was still loading, so SMTO didn't apply it to the page you're on now. The command may still have done its work on the task it started from.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0006 — This update belongs to a different conversation or task

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0007 — A value in this form isn't in the right format
documents.summary: SMTO found a value in a form that it couldn't accept, so that form wasn't saved. This message doesn't say which field it was.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0007 — A value in this form isn't in the right format

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0008 — Your browser can't show SMTO notifications
documents.summary: SMTO can't show pop-up notifications from your browser right now. Your tasks keep running, and alerts still appear inside the SMTO page.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0008 — Your browser can't show SMTO notifications

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0009 — SMTO couldn't confirm your approval choice was saved
documents.summary: You made an approve or deny choice for a waiting task, but the page never got confirmation that SMTO saved it. It may or may not have been saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0009 — SMTO couldn't confirm your approval choice was saved
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0010 — No model is available to answer your message
documents.summary: SMTO didn't send your message because it has no working AI model chosen to answer it.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0010 — No model is available to answer your message

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0011 — SMTO couldn't copy this text
documents.summary: Your browser didn't let SMTO put this text on your clipboard. Nothing else was changed; you can still copy the text yourself.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0011 — SMTO couldn't copy this text

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0012 — This page doesn't know how to finish that command
documents.summary: You ran a command, but its last step is something this copy of the SMTO page can't do. That step wasn't carried out, though the command itself may already have run.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0012 — This page doesn't know how to finish that command

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0013 — SMTO couldn't save this conversation setting
documents.summary: A control under your message box tried to save a setting this page doesn't recognize. Nothing was saved, and your other conversation settings are unchanged.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0013 — SMTO couldn't save this conversation setting

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0014 — Your message can't be sent yet
documents.summary: SMTO didn't send your message because this conversation's settings or the computer it should run on aren't ready yet. Nothing was started.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0014 — Your message can't be sent yet

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0015 — Two login fields have the same name, or one has no name
documents.summary: In this connection's login settings, two values would be sent under the same name, or an extra login field is missing its name. The connection wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0015 — Two login fields have the same name, or one has no name

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0016 — A login field set to Number needs a number
documents.summary: One extra login field is set to hold a number, but its value is empty or isn't a usable number. The connection wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0016 — A login field set to Number needs a number

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0017 — A login field set to Boolean needs true or false
documents.summary: One extra login field is set to be a yes-or-no value, but it doesn't say exactly true or false. The connection wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0017 — A login field set to Boolean needs true or false

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0018 — A default header has no name or is listed twice
documents.summary: This connection's extra headers, the labeled values sent with every request, include one with no name or two with the same name. The connection wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0018 — A default header has no name or is listed twice

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0019 — Reveal the saved value before you edit this connection
documents.summary: This connection's settings are shown with secrets hidden, so they can't be edited or saved as they are. Your saved settings haven't been changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0019 — Reveal the saved value before you edit this connection

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0020 — This control isn't linked to a task
documents.summary: You used a control like Pause, Resume, Stop or a steering message, but the page didn't know which task it was for. Nothing was sent, and no task was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0020 — This control isn't linked to a task

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0021 — Open a conversation
documents.summary: You chose Export, but no saved conversation was open to export, so nothing was downloaded. A new chat isn't saved until you send its first message.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0022 — This model setting is switched on but has no number
documents.summary: You switched on one of the model's number settings but left its box empty. SMTO didn't accept the change and kept the previous value.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0022 — This model setting is switched on but has no number

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0023 — This model setting needs an ordinary number
documents.summary: The value you typed for one of the model's number settings can't be used as a normal number, for example because it's far too large. SMTO didn't accept the change.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0023 — This model setting needs an ordinary number

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0024 — This model setting needs a whole number
documents.summary: This model setting only accepts whole numbers, but the value you typed has a decimal part or is far too large. SMTO didn't accept the change.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0024 — This model setting needs a whole number

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0025 — This model setting's number is too high or too low
documents.summary: The number you entered for this model setting is outside the range it allows. SMTO didn't accept the change.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0025 — This model setting's number is too high or too low

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0026 — You can't add files while updating a running task
documents.summary: You're sending an update to a task that is already running, so SMTO has turned off adding files and saved context. Nothing you already sent was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0026 — You can't add files while updating a running task

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0027 — Start the conversation before adding saved context
documents.summary: Saved context and results get linked into a specific conversation. This conversation hasn't been created yet, so SMTO had nowhere to link them. Nothing was added or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0027 — Start the conversation before adding saved context

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0028 — SMTO couldn't show how many task slots are free
documents.summary: The counter for free task slots received numbers that didn't add up, so it now says "unavailable". This only affects the counter. It doesn't start, stop or change any task.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0028 — SMTO couldn't show how many task slots are free

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0029 — The Settings page didn't load completely
documents.summary: Part of the Settings page didn't download, so it can't load or save your settings right now. Your saved settings haven't been changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0029 — The Settings page didn't load completely

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0030 — This link points to a setting that isn't available
documents.summary: You opened Settings from a link that should jump to one setting, but that setting isn't on this page in this version of SMTO. Nothing was changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0030 — This link points to a setting that isn't available

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0031 — Your message is empty or too long to queue
documents.summary: SMTO can only line up a message that has some text and is no longer than 24,000 characters. This one was empty or too long, so it wasn't added and your queue didn't change.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0031 — Your message is empty or too long to queue

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0032 — A message starting with / can't be queued
documents.summary: Text that starts with a slash (/) is treated as an SMTO command, not a request for the Agent, so it can't wait in the queue. Your queue didn't change.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0032 — A message starting with / can't be queued

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0033 — An older saved queue couldn't be used
documents.summary: SMTO found an old saved copy of your message queue that it couldn't read. It can't tell whether those messages were already sent, so it didn't send them again.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0033 — An older saved queue couldn't be used
Do not confuse with / related errors

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0034 — SMTO couldn't read the value you typed
documents.summary: This box expects a value written in a strict format, with brackets, quotation marks and commas in exact places. Something in it didn't follow that format, so your change wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0034 — SMTO couldn't read the value you typed

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0035 — This box needs a list in square brackets
documents.summary: This box expects a list of items inside square brackets. What you typed was valid but wasn't a list, so the parameter wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0035 — This box needs a list in square brackets

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0036 — This value needs at least one named item
documents.summary: A saved value is stored as one or more named items, like a name followed by its value. What you typed had no named items, so the parameter wasn't saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0036 — This value needs at least one named item

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0037 — Give this parameter a name before saving
documents.summary: Every saved parameter needs a name, called its Key, so you and the Agent can find it later. The Key box is empty, so nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0037 — Give this parameter a name before saving

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0038 — Hidden dots can't be saved as a password or key
documents.summary: The value you're saving contains dots (••••) that SMTO uses to hide secrets on screen. Saving them would replace your real password or key with dots, so SMTO stopped. Your saved value hasn't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0038 — Hidden dots can't be saved as a password or key

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0039 — Save your connection changes before showing the raw value
documents.summary: You changed this connection's settings but haven't saved them yet. SMTO won't open the raw saved value now, because your unsaved changes would be lost or mixed up. Nothing was saved or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0039 — Save your connection changes before showing the raw value

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0040 — This saved connection's details are damaged
documents.summary: This parameter is meant to hold the details for connecting to a web service, but those details are incomplete or in an older layout. SMTO can't show the usual connection form, so you'll need to fix the saved details.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0040 — This saved connection's details are damaged

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0041 — SMTO doesn't recognize these permission settings
documents.summary: Your permission settings decide what the Agent may do without asking you. These settings contain an option this version of SMTO doesn't understand, so it didn't use or save them.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0041 — SMTO doesn't recognize these permission settings

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0042 — There are too many permission rules in one list
documents.summary: Permission settings can hold up to 32 rules for Skills and up to 128 rules each for tools and for commands. One of these lists is full, so your new rule wasn't added. Your saved rules haven't changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0042 — There are too many permission rules in one list

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0043 — A permission rule names something SMTO doesn't have
documents.summary: One of your permission rules is broken, or it refers to a Skill or tool that isn't installed in SMTO any more. SMTO won't save settings that contain it.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0043 — A permission rule names something SMTO doesn't have

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0044 — Command rules can't include specific options or file names
documents.summary: A saved command rule can only name a program and one of its known actions, such as "git commit". It can't include extra options, file names or other details, so this rule wasn't added.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0044 — Command rules can't include specific options or file names

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0045 — Two permission rules give different answers for the same thing
documents.summary: Your permission settings contain two rules for the same Skill, tool or command, and they disagree, for example one says Allow and the other says Deny. SMTO can't tell which you mean, so it didn't use them.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0045 — Two permission rules give different answers for the same thing

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0046 — Individual permission rules only work with Custom permissions
documents.summary: These permissions include rules for specific Skills, tools or commands, but the chosen setting is Ask, Allow or Deny, which can't hold such rules. Nothing was saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0046 — Individual permission rules only work with Custom permissions

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0047 — SMTO couldn't change the Gateways for this message
documents.summary: You picked a Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to run commands on a computer) with @, but SMTO couldn't add it to or remove it from this message's targets. Your Gateway choices stayed as they were.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0047 — SMTO couldn't change the Gateways for this message

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0048 — UI assets are missing
documents.summary: SMTO's Directory page, the page SMTO shows first when you open its main address, can't be shown because one of its installed page files is missing. Your saved conversations and settings are not affected.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0049 — Palette launcher unavailable
documents.summary: You ran the command that opens the SMTO Command Palette, but your computer didn't confirm that a web browser opened it. Nothing was sent to SMTO.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0050 — That shortcut can't be used to open the Command Palette
documents.summary: The shortcut you typed isn't allowed, either because it isn't written the right way or because your browser or SMTO already uses it. Your old shortcut still works.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0050 — That shortcut can't be used to open the Command Palette

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0051 — Server update needs a restart
documents.summary: SMTO was updated, but the server is still running the older version, so memory indexing progress can't be shown yet. Showing this message doesn't change your memories or earlier work.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0051 — Server update needs a restart

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0052 — This page needs to reload
documents.summary: The SMTO server was updated after you opened this page, so the page is out of date and can't show the new memory indexing progress. Reloading the page fixes this.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0052 — This page needs to reload

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0053 — Indexing progress is unavailable
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't show memory indexing progress because the server didn't send it in a form this page understands. This usually means the server is older than this page. Memory and search may still be working.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0054 — SMTO couldn't check one part of the system
documents.summary: SMTO tried to check the status of one part of the system but got no answer. That doesn't mean the part is broken, and the other checks still count.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0054 — SMTO couldn't check one part of the system

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0055 — This status check isn't available on this server
documents.summary: The page asked the server for a status check the server doesn't have. This usually means the page and the server are different versions. Nothing was checked or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0055 — This status check isn't available on this server

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0056 — SMTO's sign-in isn't set up on this server
documents.summary: SMTO can't check anyone's username and password because its sign-in setup on the server is missing or can't be read. Nobody can sign in until it's fixed. This check doesn't change your conversations or tasks.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0056 — SMTO's sign-in isn't set up on this server

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0057 — Sign in to continue
documents.summary: Your browser isn't signed in to SMTO any more, so the server didn't accept this request. Sign-ins end after 12 hours, when you sign out, or when your password is changed or reset.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0058 — Choose a new password
documents.summary: Your account is still using a temporary password from an administrator. You need to choose your own password before SMTO opens your workspace.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0059 — Only an administrator can do this
documents.summary: Your account is a regular user account. This action changes how SMTO is set up for everyone, so only an administrator can do it. SMTO didn't change anything.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0059 — Only an administrator can do this

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0060 — Account access changed
documents.summary: This page was opened for one SMTO account, but your browser is now signed in as a different account, often from another tab. SMTO refused this request so that one account's work doesn't land in another account's workspace.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0061 — SMTO couldn't confirm this save came from your page
documents.summary: SMTO blocked a save because it couldn't confirm the request came from your current signed-in page. This usually happens when the page is older than your latest sign-in. This change was not saved.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0061 — SMTO couldn't confirm this save came from your page

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0062 — Sign-in was not accepted
documents.summary: SMTO didn't accept that username and password together. For security it doesn't say which part was wrong, and a disabled account shows the same message.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0063 — Too many sign-in attempts, so wait a minute
documents.summary: SMTO has paused sign-in for about a minute because there were several failed attempts for this account or from this computer. The pause protects the account from password guessing.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0063 — Too many sign-in attempts, so wait a minute

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0064 — Current password is incorrect
documents.summary: The password you typed in Current password doesn't match your account, so SMTO didn't change your password. Your existing password still works.

documents.title: SMTO-UI-0065 — Your password changed while this change was being saved
documents.summary: Another password change from this same browser, for example in a second tab, finished first. SMTO didn't apply this one, so the password from that other change is the one in effect now.

headings.title: SMTO-UI-0065 — Your password changed while this change was being saved

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0001 — SMTO's web reader can't open addresses on a private network
documents.summary: The address points to a computer on a home, office or local network, not the public internet. SMTO's web reader only opens public websites, so it stopped before connecting. Nothing was read.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0001 — SMTO's web reader can't open addresses on a private network

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0002 — That web address can't be used
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't use the web address it was given because it isn't a complete http or https address, it is too long, or it has a username or password written into it. Nothing was read.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0002 — That web address can't be used

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0003 — The search service refused SMTO's search
documents.summary: SMTO sent your web search to the search service set up for it, but the service refused it (access denied). The refusal didn't say exactly why, so no search results came back.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0003 — The search service refused SMTO's search

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0004 — The search server is reachable but won't send results to SMTO
documents.summary: SMTO reached your search server, but the server says the results format SMTO needs is switched off. No search results came back.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0004 — The search server is reachable but won't send results to SMTO

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0005 — The search service sent back something SMTO can't read
documents.summary: The search service replied, but its answer was too large or wasn't a list of search results (for example an error page). SMTO didn't use it, so no search results came back.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0005 — The search service sent back something SMTO can't read

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0006 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from the search service
documents.summary: SMTO tried to send your web search to the search service set up for it, but couldn't connect or got an error back instead of results. No search results came back.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0006 — SMTO couldn't get an answer from the search service

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0007 — Only part of the web page arrived
documents.summary: SMTO started downloading the page or document, but the connection ended before all of it arrived. SMTO didn't use the partial copy as if it were complete.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0007 — Only part of the web page arrived

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0008 — That web address keeps sending SMTO somewhere else
documents.summary: When SMTO opened the address, the site sent it on to another address more than five times in a row, so SMTO stopped following. Nothing was read.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0008 — That web address keeps sending SMTO somewhere else

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0009 — SMTO can't unpack the way this site sent the page
documents.summary: The website sent the page squeezed in a format SMTO's web reader can't unpack safely. SMTO didn't try to read the scrambled data, so nothing was read.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0009 — SMTO can't unpack the way this site sent the page

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0010 — SMTO's web reader can't read this kind of file
documents.summary: The address returned something other than a web page, plain text or PDF, such as an image, video or download file, or an error in a form SMTO can't read. SMTO didn't use it.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0010 — SMTO's web reader can't read this kind of file

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0011 — The search service took too long to answer
documents.summary: SMTO sent your web search to the search service, but no complete answer came back within the time allowed. No search results came back from that service.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0011 — The search service took too long to answer

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0012 — No working web search provider is available
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't search the web because no search provider is set up and turned on, the chosen provider can't be found, or the search server refused the connection. Nothing was searched.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0012 — No working web search provider is available

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0013 — The search server refused SMTO's connection test
documents.summary: SMTO's test search was refused by the search server (access denied). That refusal alone doesn't show why; the results format may be switched off, or the server may be blocking SMTO.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0013 — The search server refused SMTO's connection test

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0014 — The Web search settings have a mistake
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't accept the Web search settings because a provider entry has a problem, such as a bad address or name, or the default provider isn't turned on. The settings weren't used.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0014 — The Web search settings have a mistake

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0015 — These Web search settings are from a different SMTO version
documents.summary: The saved Web search settings use a format or a search provider type that this version of SMTO doesn't know. SMTO didn't change your saved settings.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0015 — These Web search settings are from a different SMTO version

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0016 — SMTO couldn't find the website you asked it to read
documents.summary: SMTO looked up the website's name, but the network returned no address for it, so the page was not read. Nothing was downloaded or changed.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0016 — SMTO couldn't find the website you asked it to read

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0017 — Web search isn't set up yet
documents.summary: SMTO tried to search the web, but no search service is turned on and chosen, so no search was sent. Reading a specific web address can still work.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0017 — Web search isn't set up yet

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0018 — An older research record mentions missing research setup
documents.summary: This message comes from an older saved record. Today's SMTO sets up research automatically when Web Research is used, so it does not prove your current answer was blocked.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0018 — An older research record mentions missing research setup

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0019 — Your request changed after the research was gathered
documents.summary: SMTO collected research for an earlier version of your request, and the request has since changed. It won't use the old research as proof for the new request, but what it already read is still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0019 — Your request changed after the research was gathered

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0020 — The answer pointed to a source SMTO never read
documents.summary: The answer named or linked a source that SMTO has no record of reading, so it can't be shown as proof. The pages SMTO did read are still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0020 — The answer pointed to a source SMTO never read

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0021 — A search result snippet can't prove this fact
documents.summary: The answer tried to prove a fact using only a search result preview, not the actual page. SMTO needs to read the page itself before stating the fact as checked.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0021 — A search result snippet can't prove this fact

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0022 — The answer cited a note that isn't in SMTO's research
documents.summary: The answer pointed to a piece of supporting information that SMTO never recorded, so it can't show that part as proven. The research SMTO did gather is still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0022 — The answer cited a note that isn't in SMTO's research

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0023 — SMTO couldn't match the answer's sources to a page it actually read
documents.summary: SMTO keeps a record of every page it reads. The sources in this answer don't line up with a finished, unchanged record, so SMTO won't present them as proven.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0023 — SMTO couldn't match the answer's sources to a page it actually read

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0024 — A value in the answer doesn't match what the source said
documents.summary: A number or quote in the answer differs from what SMTO recorded from the page, or a calculated total doesn't add up. SMTO won't show that value as confirmed.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0024 — A value in the answer doesn't match what the source said

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0025 — The answer used a fact SMTO's research doesn't contain
documents.summary: Part of the answer refers to an item or detail that isn't in the research SMTO gathered. SMTO won't swap in a different fact on its own.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0025 — The answer used a fact SMTO's research doesn't contain

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0026 — SMTO couldn't confirm a detail the answer stated as fact
documents.summary: The answer stated a detail as certain, but SMTO's research never confirmed it. SMTO will only show it as unconfirmed, not as fact.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0026 — SMTO couldn't confirm a detail the answer stated as fact

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0027 — Your sources disagree about this detail
documents.summary: The pages SMTO read give different answers for this detail, so it can't be stated as one settled fact. Both versions are still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0027 — Your sources disagree about this detail

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0028 — This result hasn't been shown to meet all your requirements
documents.summary: An item in the answer hasn't been proven to match every must-have requirement in your request, such as a location, price or model. SMTO won't list it as a match.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0028 — This result hasn't been shown to meet all your requirements

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0029 — The answer didn't use the sources or number of results you asked for
documents.summary: Your request asked for particular sources or a certain number of results, and the answer doesn't meet that yet. SMTO won't present it as complete.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0029 — The answer didn't use the sources or number of results you asked for

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0030 — An older record warns the item you named may have been swapped
documents.summary: This message comes from an older saved record. It warns that a product or reference you named may have been replaced with a similar one. Today's SMTO asks you instead of swapping.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0030 — An older record warns the item you named may have been swapped

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0031 — The cited source does not establish what the answer says
documents.summary: A statement in the answer has a source attached, but that source doesn't say the same thing. SMTO won't show a citation that doesn't back up its statement.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0031 — The cited source does not establish what the answer says

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0032 — Part of the answer says more than SMTO's research shows
documents.summary: Some of the answer goes beyond what the pages SMTO read actually show. SMTO won't present that part as checked.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0032 — Part of the answer says more than SMTO's research shows

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0033 — SMTO only saw part of a page, so it can't say "that's all"
documents.summary: The answer says something like "these are all of them" or "none exist", but SMTO only read part of a page. Seeing part of a page can't prove nothing else is there.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0033 — SMTO only saw part of a page, so it can't say "that's all"

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0034 — The answer came without links to its research
documents.summary: The Model finished its answer but didn't say which of SMTO's research supports each statement, so SMTO can't check it yet. The research gathered so far is still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0034 — The answer came without links to its research

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0035 — The answer's links to its research were mixed up
documents.summary: The Model labelled its statements in a way SMTO couldn't follow: a label was broken, repeated, or didn't match one place in the answer. The research itself is still saved.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0035 — The answer's links to its research were mixed up

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0036 — SMTO couldn't fully check its research answer
documents.summary: SMTO tried to correct its research answer so every point was backed by a page it read, but the correction didn't work. The answer you got may be incomplete and should say what it couldn't confirm.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0036 — SMTO couldn't fully check its research answer

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0037 — This website needs SMTO's browser to be read
documents.summary: An earlier try to read this website was blocked, asked for a sign-in, or showed a page that only works in a real browser. SMTO didn't try the same kind of read again, and what it already found is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0037 — This website needs SMTO's browser to be read

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0038 — SMTO reached its limit for web searches or page reads
documents.summary: Each research task may only do a set number of web searches, page reads and browser steps. SMTO used them up for this kind of step, so it didn't do another one. Everything it already found is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0038 — SMTO reached its limit for web searches or page reads

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0039 — SMTO looked up a research note that doesn't exist
documents.summary: While researching, SMTO tried to open one of its own notes with a label that doesn't match anything, or to ask you about something already settled. Nothing new was fetched and nothing was lost.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0039 — SMTO looked up a research note that doesn't exist

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0040 — SMTO needs to pick one specific research result
documents.summary: SMTO tried to open its notes using a website's label, but that website held several results, or it gave two labels that disagree. It didn't guess which one was meant, and nothing new was fetched.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0040 — SMTO needs to pick one specific research result

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0041 — SMTO hasn't used the browser you asked for yet
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to check this with the browser, but its answer wasn't based on a page it actually viewed in the browser, so SMTO didn't accept that answer yet. What it already found is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0041 — SMTO hasn't used the browser you asked for yet

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0042 — The browser you asked for isn't available
documents.summary: You asked SMTO to use the browser, but the computer it's working on can't run the browser right now. SMTO will answer without it and say so, rather than pretend it checked.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0042 — The browser you asked for isn't available

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0043 — Research completion correction failed
documents.summary: SMTO's attempt to fix its research answer didn't produce a usable result, so it stopped trying. The work it already did is kept, and its answer may be marked as partial.

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0044 — SMTO already tried this exact search or page
documents.summary: SMTO tried to repeat a web search or page read it had already done in this task. It didn't repeat it; the earlier result, even if it failed, is kept and should be used instead.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0044 — SMTO already tried this exact search or page

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0045 — A website asked SMTO to wait before reading it again
documents.summary: The website said it was getting too many requests and asked SMTO to pause, usually for about a minute and never more than an hour. SMTO didn't contact it again yet, and anything it already read is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0045 — A website asked SMTO to wait before reading it again

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0046 — This research task has reached its maximum number of lookups
documents.summary: One research task can record at most 512 web searches, page reads and browser steps. This task has hit that fixed limit, so SMTO can't look anything else up in it, but everything it found is kept.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0046 — This research task has reached its maximum number of lookups

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0047 — SMTO can't ask you for more research steps right now
documents.summary: SMTO tried to ask your permission to do more web searches or page reads, but it can't ask yet: it still has unused steps you approved, another question is waiting for you, or it has already asked too many times.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0047 — SMTO can't ask you for more research steps right now

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0048 — This request for more research steps no longer matches
documents.summary: Either SMTO asked for extra research steps in a way that isn't allowed, or a Continue research answer was for a request that's out of date because the task changed. Nothing was approved and no extra lookups happened.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0048 — This request for more research steps no longer matches

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0049 — You declined more research steps for this task
documents.summary: You chose Don't allow when SMTO asked to do more searches, page reads or browser steps of this kind. SMTO respects that and won't ask for the same kind again in this task.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0049 — You declined more research steps for this task

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0050 — SMTO is already waiting for your answer about more research
documents.summary: SMTO has already asked whether it may do more web searches or page reads, and that question is still open. It didn't ask twice, and it won't do those extra lookups until you answer.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0050 — SMTO is already waiting for your answer about more research

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0051 — This PDF is too big for SMTO to download
documents.summary: The PDF is larger than SMTO allows for one downloaded file (at most 64 MB, or less if your administrator set a lower limit). SMTO stopped the download and didn't keep a partial copy.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0051 — This PDF is too big for SMTO to download

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0052 — The link didn't return a real PDF
documents.summary: SMTO expected a PDF, but what the website sent isn't a PDF file. It's often a web page, a sign-in page or an error page instead. SMTO didn't save it.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0052 — The link didn't return a real PDF

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0053 — SMTO couldn't save a downloaded PDF for this task
documents.summary: SMTO couldn't store the PDF in this task's files, so it can't read or quote it. This can happen when the server's disk is full, the task's file space is used up, or the task was closed or deleted.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0053 — SMTO couldn't save a downloaded PDF for this task

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0054 — The PDF download was stopped
documents.summary: The task was stopped while SMTO was downloading a PDF, so the download ended early. SMTO didn't keep the unfinished file.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0054 — The PDF download was stopped

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0055 — SMTO couldn't match a quote to the PDF it came from
documents.summary: SMTO's answer used text from a PDF, but that text doesn't line up with the exact copy, page or spot in the document SMTO downloaded. So SMTO didn't accept the answer as checked yet.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0055 — SMTO couldn't match a quote to the PDF it came from

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0056 — SMTO needs to know exactly which item you mean
documents.summary: Your question names a specific item, but the web research only found similar ones, not that exact item. SMTO held back a final answer so it wouldn't give you facts about the wrong thing.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0056 — SMTO needs to know exactly which item you mean

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0057 — SMTO's follow-up question offered an option it hadn't found
documents.summary: SMTO tried to ask which item you meant, but one of the choices it listed came from neither your message nor its research. That question was stopped before it reached you, and no new web searches were made.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0057 — SMTO's follow-up question offered an option it hadn't found

documents.title: SMTO-WEB-0058 — SMTO's main model can't look at pictures of this page
documents.summary: SMTO turned a document page into a picture, but the main model it uses can only read text, not pictures. Anything shown only in diagrams or charts on that page can't be confirmed.

headings.title: SMTO-WEB-0058 — SMTO's main model can't look at pictures of this page
